function ahReadConfig(A) {
  var found = ahFind("Configure Aetherheart");
  if (!found || !found.card.entry) return;
  var e = found.card.entry, prev = A.settings.preset;
  var p = ahVal(e, "Preset");
  if (p) {
    var np = p.split(/\s|\|/)[0].toLowerCase();
    if (np && np !== prev) ahApplyPreset(A, np, true);
    else A.settings.preset = np || prev;
  }
  var r = ahVal(e, "Rating"); if (r) A.settings.rating = r.split(/\s|\|/)[0];
  var pairs = [
    ["Script","scriptEnabled"],["Inventory","inventoryEnabled"],["Currency","currencyEnabled"],
    ["Time","timeEnabled"],["Bills","billsEnabled"],["Narration System","narrationSystem"],
    ["Silent Mode","silentMode"],["RP System","rpSystem"],["Inner Thoughts","innerThoughts"],
    ["Inner Opinions","innerOpinions"],["Card Creator","cardCreator"],["Scheduling","scheduling"],
    ["Bounty Board","bountyBoard"],["Job Board","jobBoard"],["Quests","quests"],["Story Splice","storySplice"]
  ];
  for (var i=0;i<pairs.length;i++){ var v=ahOnOff(e,pairs[i][0]); if(v!==null) A.settings[pairs[i][1]]=v; }
  var cn=ahVal(e,"Currency name"); if(cn) A.currencyName=cn.split(/\n/)[0].trim();
  var cs=ahVal(e,"Currency symbol"); if(cs) A.currencySymbol=cs.split(/\n/)[0].trim();
}

function ahReadRP(A) {
  var found = ahFind("RP System");
  if (!found || !found.card.entry) {
    if (A.settings.rpSystem && !A.settings.vitals) { A.settings.vitals = true; A.settings.survival = true; }
    return;
  }
  var e = found.card.entry;
  var pairs = [["Vitals","vitals"],["Survival","survival"],["Leveling","leveling"],["Skills","skills"],
    ["Abilities","abilities"],["Powers","powers"],["Loot","loot"],["Ammo","ammo"],["d20","d20"],
    ["Fuel","fuel"],["Reputation","reputation"],["Jail","jail"],["Momentum","momentum"],
    ["Deus Ex","deusEx"],["Anti-Deus Ex","antiDeusEx"]];
  for (var i=0;i<pairs.length;i++){ var v=ahOnOff(e,pairs[i][0]); if(v!==null) A.settings[pairs[i][1]]=v; }
  var fn=ahVal(e,"Fuel Name"); if(fn) A.settings.fuelName=fn.split(/\n/)[0].trim();
  var mm=ahVal(e,"Magic Mode");
  if(mm){ mm=mm.toLowerCase(); if(mm.indexOf("wizard")===0) A.settings.magicMode="wizarding";
    else if(mm.indexOf("sorc")===0) A.settings.magicMode="sorcery"; }
  if(!A.settings.leveling){ A.settings.skills=false; A.settings.abilities=false; A.settings.powers=false; A.settings.loot=false; }
}

function ahReadTime(A) {
  var found = ahFind("Configure Time");
  if (!found || !found.card.entry) return;
  var e = found.card.entry;
  var tpt=ahVal(e,"Time/Turn"); if(tpt) A.time.timePerTurn=tpt.split(/\s/)[0];
  var y=ahVal(e,"Year"); if(y&&!isNaN(parseInt(y,10))) A.time.year=parseInt(y,10);
  var mo=ahVal(e,"Month"); if(mo&&!isNaN(parseInt(mo,10))) A.time.month=parseInt(mo,10);
  var d=ahVal(e,"Day"); if(d&&!isNaN(parseInt(d,10))) A.time.day=parseInt(d,10);
  var h=ahVal(e,"Hour"); if(h&&!isNaN(parseFloat(h))) A.time.hour=parseFloat(h);
}

function ahReadNarration(A) {
  var found = ahFind("Narration");
  if (!found || !found.card.entry) return;
  var e = found.card.entry;
  var v;
  v=ahOnOff(e,"Narrate Player"); if(v!==null) A.settings.narratePlayer=v;
  v=ahOnOff(e,"Present Tense"); if(v!==null) A.settings.presentTense=v;
  v=ahOnOff(e,"Story Splice"); if(v!==null) A.settings.storySplice=v;
}

function ahSync(A) {
  try { ahReadConfig(A); } catch(e){}
  try { ahReadRP(A); } catch(e){}
  try { ahReadTime(A); } catch(e){}
  try { ahReadNarration(A); } catch(e){}
}

function ahAdvance(A, mins) {
  if (!A.settings.timeEnabled) return;
  var t=A.time, total=Math.floor((t.hour||0)*60)+(mins||0), days=Math.floor(total/1440);
  total=total%1440; t.hour=total/60; t.day=(t.day||1)+days;
  while(t.day>30){t.day-=30;t.month++;} while(t.month>12){t.month-=12;t.year++;}
}

function ahTickSurvival(A, mins) {
  if (!A.settings.survival) return;
  var f=Math.max(1,Math.floor((mins||5)/5));
  A.survival.hunger=Math.min(100,(A.survival.hunger||0)+f);
  A.survival.thirst=Math.min(100,(A.survival.thirst||0)+f+1);
  A.survival.tiredness=Math.min(100,(A.survival.tiredness||0)+Math.floor(f/2));
}

function ahParseMins(A) {
  var str=(A.time&&A.time.timePerTurn)||"5m";
  var m=String(str).match(/^(\d+)\s*(m|min|h)?/i);
  if(!m) return 5;
  var n=parseInt(m[1],10);
  return ((m[2]||"m").toLowerCase().indexOf("h")===0)?n*60:n;
}

function ahInvAdd(A, cat, name, qty) {
  if (!A.inventory[cat]) A.inventory[cat]={};
  var perm=/#/.test(name)||/\b(armor|sword|gun|rifle|blade|vest|plate)\b/i.test(name);
  var clean=String(name).replace(/#/g,"").trim();
  if(perm) A.inventory[cat][clean+" #"]=1;
  else A.inventory[cat][clean]=(A.inventory[cat][clean]||0)+(qty||1);
}

function ahLedger(A, note, amount) {
  A.ledger=A.ledger||[];
  A.ledger.push((amount>=0?"+":"")+amount+"  "+note);
  if(A.ledger.length>40) A.ledger=A.ledger.slice(-30);
  A.balance=(A.balance||0)+amount;
}

function ahHandleAdds(text, A) {
  var msgs=[], lines=text.split(/\n/);
  lines.forEach(function(line){
    var m;
    m=line.match(/\[ADD BOUNTY:\s*([^\]|]+)\|\s*([^\]|]+)\|\s*([^\]]+)\]/i);
    if(m){ A.bounties.push({name:m[1].trim(),condition:m[2].trim(),reward:m[3].trim(),taken:false}); msgs.push("Bounty: "+m[1].trim()); }
    m=line.match(/\[ADD JOB:\s*([^\]|]+)\|\s*([^\]|]+)\|\s*([^\]]+)\]/i);
    if(m){ A.jobs.push({title:m[1].trim(),pay:m[2].trim(),desc:m[3].trim()}); msgs.push("Job: "+m[1].trim()); }
    m=line.match(/\[ADD QUEST:\s*([^\]|]+)(?:\|\s*([^\]]+))?\]/i);
    if(m && A.quests.length<5){ A.quests.push({title:m[1].trim(),progress:0,desc:(m[2]||"").trim()}); msgs.push("Quest: "+m[1].trim()); }
    m=line.match(/\[ADD:\s*([^\]|]+)\|\s*([^\]|]+)\|\s*([^\]|]+)\|\s*([^\]|]+)\|\s*([^\]]+)\]/i);
    if(m){
      var key=m[2].trim();
      if(!A.schedule[key]) A.schedule[key]=[];
      A.schedule[key].push({name:m[1].trim(),start:m[3].trim(),end:m[4].trim(),desc:m[5].trim(),on:true});
      msgs.push("Schedule: "+m[1].trim());
    }
    m=line.match(/\[SPLICE ON:\s*([^\]]+)\]/i);
    if(m){ var n=m[1].trim(); if(A.splices.indexOf(n)<0) A.splices.push(n); msgs.push("Splice ON "+n); }
    m=line.match(/\[SPLICE OFF:\s*([^\]]+)\]/i);
    if(m){ A.splices=A.splices.filter(function(s){return s.toLowerCase()!==m[1].trim().toLowerCase();}); msgs.push("Splice OFF"); }
    if(/\[SPLICE CLEAR\]/i.test(line)){ A.splices=[]; msgs.push("Splices cleared"); }
  });
  return msgs;
}

function ahHandleSpeech(text, A) {
  var t=text.toLowerCase(), msgs=[], m;
  if(A.settings.bountyBoard){
    if(/bounty board|wanted posters/.test(t)) msgs.push("Bounty Board checked");
    m=t.match(/take (?:the )?bounty on ([a-z0-9\s\-']{2,40})/);
    if(m){
      var name=m[1].trim();
      A.bounties.push({name:name,condition:"Either",reward:"TBD",taken:true});
      if(A.settings.quests && A.quests.length<5) A.quests.push({title:"Bounty: "+name,progress:0});
      msgs.push("Bounty taken: "+name);
    }
    m=t.match(/turn in (?:the )?bounty on ([a-z0-9\s\-']{2,40})/);
    if(m){ if(A.settings.currencyEnabled) ahLedger(A,"Bounty "+m[1].trim(),50); msgs.push("Bounty turned in"); }
  }
  if(A.settings.jobBoard){
    if(/job board|look for work/.test(t)) msgs.push("Job Board checked");
    if(/take (?:the )?job|accept (?:the )?job/.test(t)) msgs.push("Job accepted");
    if(/complete (?:the )?job|finish (?:the )?job/.test(t)){
      if(A.settings.currencyEnabled) ahLedger(A,"Job pay",25);
      msgs.push("Job completed");
    }
  }
  if(A.settings.vitals && /\b(rest|sleep|camp)\b/.test(t)){
    A.vitals.stamina=A.vitals.maxStamina;
    A.vitals.mp=Math.min(A.vitals.maxMp,A.vitals.mp+Math.floor(A.vitals.maxMp*0.3));
    if(A.settings.survival) A.survival.tiredness=Math.max(0,A.survival.tiredness-40);
    ahAdvance(A,360); msgs.push("Rested");
  }
  if(A.settings.fuel && /\b(refuel|fill up|recharge)\b/.test(t)){ A.fuel=100; msgs.push((A.settings.fuelName||"Fuel")+" restored"); }
  if(A.settings.currencyEnabled){
    if(/check (my )?(balance|wallet|money)/.test(t)) msgs.push("Balance: "+(A.currencySymbol||"G")+(A.balance||0));
    m=t.match(/(?:buy|purchase)\s+(?:a |an |the )?([a-z0-9\s\-']{2,40})(?:\s+for\s+(\d+))?/);
    if(m){
      var price=m[2]?parseInt(m[2],10):10;
      if((A.balance||0)>=price){ ahLedger(A,"Bought "+m[1].trim(),-price); ahInvAdd(A,"other",m[1].trim(),1); msgs.push("Bought "+m[1].trim()); }
      else msgs.push("Cannot afford");
    }
  }
  if(A.settings.inventoryEnabled){
    m=t.match(/\b(?:take|grab|pick up|loot)\s+(?:the\s+)?([a-z0-9\s\-']{2,40})/);
    if(m){ ahInvAdd(A,"other",m[1].trim(),1); msgs.push("Took "+m[1].trim()); }
    m=t.match(/\b(?:equip|wear|put on)\s+(?:the\s+)?([a-z0-9\s\-']{2,40})/);
    if(m){
      var item=m[1].trim();
      if(/armor|vest|mail|plate|helmet/i.test(item)) A.equipped.armor=item;
      else if(/sword|gun|rifle|pistol|bow|knife|blade|staff/i.test(item)) A.equipped.weapon=item;
      else A.equipped.clothes=item;
      msgs.push("Equipped "+item);
    }
  }
  if(A.settings.d20){
    m=text.match(/roll for (attack|saving|ability check|initiative)/i);
    if(m) msgs.push("d20 "+m[1]+" → "+(Math.floor(Math.random()*20)+1));
  }
  if(A.settings.leveling && /\b(defeat|killed|slain|victory|quest complete)\b/.test(t)){
    A.xp+=( /quest complete/.test(t)?100:50);
    while(A.xp>=A.xpToNext){ A.xp-=A.xpToNext; A.level++; A.xpToNext=Math.floor(A.xpToNext*1.35);
      A.vitals.maxHp+=5; A.vitals.hp=A.vitals.maxHp; msgs.push("Level up! "+A.level); }
  }
  return msgs;
}

function ahHandleCardCmd(text, A) {
  var m=text.match(/^\/card\s+(character|location|other)?\s*(.+)$/i);
  if(!m) return false;
  var type=(m[1]||"other"); type=type.charAt(0).toUpperCase()+type.slice(1).toLowerCase();
  var rest=m[2].trim().split(/\s+/);
  if(!m[1] && rest.length&&/^(character|location|other)$/i.test(rest[0])){ type=rest.shift(); type=type.charAt(0).toUpperCase()+type.slice(1).toLowerCase(); }
  var title=rest[0]||"Untitled", details=rest.slice(1).join(" ");
  var entry="";
  if(A.settings.innerThoughts) entry+="{title: "+title+"}\n";
  if(type==="Character") entry+="Name: "+title+"\nAppearance: \nPersonality: \nBackground: \n"+(details?"Notes: "+details+"\n":"");
  else entry+="Name: "+title+"\nDescription: "+(details||"")+"\n";
  ahWrite(title, entry, AH_CAT+" (Card Creator)");
  ahMsg(A, "Card created: "+title+" ("+type+")");
  return true;
}

function ahUpdateCards(A) {
  if(!A.presetSeeded) ahApplyPreset(A, A.settings.preset, true);
  ahWrite("Configure Aetherheart", ahBuildConfigure(A), AH_CAT);
  ahWrite("Help", ahBuildHelp(), AH_CAT);
  ahWrite("Keywords", ahBuildKeywords(), AH_CAT);
  ahWrite("Status", ahBuildStatus(A), AH_CAT);
  if(A.settings.timeEnabled){
    ahWrite("Configure Time", ahBuildTime(A), AH_CAT);
    ahWrite("Events", ahBuildEvents(), AH_CAT);
    ahWrite("Holidays", ahBuildHolidays(), AH_CAT);
  }
  if(A.settings.scheduling) ahWrite("Schedule Time Blocks", ahBuildSchedule(A), AH_CAT+" (Scheduling)");
  if(A.settings.rpSystem){
    ahWrite("RP System", ahBuildRP(A), AH_CAT+" (RP System)");
    if(A.settings.vitals||A.settings.survival) ahWrite("Vitals", ahBuildVitals(A), AH_CAT+" (RP System)");
    if(A.settings.leveling) ahWrite("Character Sheet", ahBuildSheet(A), AH_CAT+" (RP System)");
    ahWrite("Were / Mer", ahBuildWereMer(), AH_CAT+" (RP System)");
  }
  if(A.settings.innerThoughts) ahWrite("Inner Thoughts", ahBuildThoughts(A), AH_CAT+" (Characters)");
  if(A.settings.innerOpinions) ahWrite("Inner Opinions", ahBuildOpinions(A), AH_CAT+" (Characters)");
  if(A.settings.bountyBoard) ahWrite("Bounty Board", ahBuildBounty(A), AH_CAT);
  if(A.settings.jobBoard) ahWrite("Job Board", ahBuildJob(A), AH_CAT);
  if(A.settings.quests) ahWrite("Quests", ahBuildQuests(A), AH_CAT);
  if(A.settings.inventoryEnabled) ahWrite("Inventory", ahBuildInventory(A), AH_CAT);
  if(A.settings.currencyEnabled) ahWrite("Ledger", ahBuildLedger(A), AH_CAT);
  if(A.settings.cardCreator) ahWrite("Card Creator", ahBuildCardCreator(), AH_CAT+" (Card Creator)");
  if(A.settings.narrationSystem){
    ahWrite("Narration", ahBuildNarration(A), AH_CAT+" (Narration)");
    ahWrite("Pose Definitions", ahBuildPoses(), AH_CAT+" (Narration)");
    ahWrite("Speech Patterns", ahBuildSpeech(), AH_CAT+" (Narration)");
  }
  if(A.settings.storySplice) ahWrite("Story Splice", ahBuildSplice(A), AH_CAT+" (Narration)");
  if(A.settings.sleeveJump||A.settings.shift||A.settings.isekai) ahWrite("Jump Status", ahBuildJumps(A), AH_CAT);
}

function ahInject(A) {
  try {
    if(!state.memory) state.memory={};
    var parts=[], t=A.time;
    if(A.settings.timeEnabled) parts.push(ahMonth(t.month)+" "+t.day+", "+t.year+" "+ahHour(t.hour));
    if(A.settings.vitals) parts.push("HP "+A.vitals.hp+"/"+A.vitals.maxHp+" MP "+A.vitals.mp+"/"+A.vitals.maxMp+" STA "+A.vitals.stamina+"/"+A.vitals.maxStamina);
    if(A.settings.currencyEnabled) parts.push((A.currencySymbol||"G")+(A.balance||0));
    state.memory.frontMemory = parts.length ? ("[Status: "+parts.join(" | ")+"]") : "";
    var notes=[];
    if(A.settings.informationFirewall) notes.push("Characters only know in-world knowledge. No meta or script awareness.");
    if(A.settings.standardRules) notes.push("Keep pronouns consistent. Avoid purple prose, sentient glowing objects, psychic aftershock spam.");
    if(A.settings.narratePlayer) notes.push("Narrate NPCs only; do not write the player character's actions or dialogue.");
    if(A.settings.presentTense) notes.push("Write in present tense.");
    else notes.push("Write in past tense.");
    if(A.settings.storySplice && A.splices && A.splices.length) notes.push("Narrative flavor only from: "+A.splices.join(", ")+". Do not change plot.");
    if(A.settings.deusEx) notes.push("Deus Ex active: outcomes strongly favor the player.");
    if(A.settings.antiDeusEx) notes.push("No sudden unexplained rescues or free power-ups.");
    if(A.settings.rating){
      var r=String(A.settings.rating).toUpperCase();
      if(r==="E") notes.push("Content rating E: everyone-friendly.");
      else if(r==="TEEN"||r==="T") notes.push("Content rating Teen.");
      else if(r==="NSFW"||r==="M") notes.push("Content rating mature allowed.");
      else notes.push("Content unrated.");
    }
    // replace each turn — do not stack
    state.memory.authorsNote = notes.join(" ");
  } catch(e){}
}

function onInput_Aetherheart(text) {
  var A=ahEnsure();
  ahSync(A);
  if(!A.settings.scriptEnabled) return text;
  try {
    var cmd=text.trim().toLowerCase();
    if(cmd==="/help")){ state.message=ahBuildHelp(); return text; }
    if(cmd==="/status")){ state.message=ahBuildStatus(A); return text; }
    if(cmd==="/keywords")){ state.message=ahBuildKeywords(); return text; }
    if(cmd==="/balance")){ state.message="Balance: "+(A.currencySymbol||"G")+(A.balance||0); return text; }
    if(cmd==="/inventory")){ state.message=ahBuildInventory(A); return text; }
    if(cmd==="/time")){ var t=A.time; state.message=ahMonth(t.month)+" "+t.day+", Year "+t.year+" | "+ahHour(t.hour); return text; }
    if(cmd.indexOf("/ah ")===0){
      if(cmd==="/ah enable")) A.settings.scriptEnabled=true;
      if(cmd==="/ah disable")) A.settings.scriptEnabled=false;
      if(cmd==="/ah toggle")) A.settings.scriptEnabled=!A.settings.scriptEnabled;
      ahMsg(A,"Script "+(A.settings.scriptEnabled?"ON":"OFF")); return text;
    }
    if(ahHandleCardCmd(text,A)){ ahUpdateCards(A); return text; }
    var mins=ahParseMins(A);
    ahAdvance(A,mins);
    ahTickSurvival(A,mins);
    var msgs=[].concat(ahHandleAdds(text,A), ahHandleSpeech(text,A));
    msgs.forEach(function(m){ ahMsg(A,m); });
    ahUpdateCards(A);
  } catch(e){ try{ state.message="AH Input: "+(e.message||e);}catch(e2){} }
  return text;
}

function onOutput_Aetherheart(text) {
  var A=ahEnsure();
  try {
    ahSync(A);
    if(!A.settings.scriptEnabled) return text;
    ahInject(A);
    ahUpdateCards(A);
    if(A.settings.vitals && A.vitals.hp<=0) text=ahBuildGameOver();
  } catch(e){ try{ state.message="AH Output: "+(e.message||e);}catch(e2){} }
  return text;
}

function ahPresetDefaults(preset) {
  var p = (preset || "fantasy").toLowerCase();
  var t = {
    fantasy: { name: "Gold", symbol: "G", fuel: "Stamina", year: 632 },
    western: { name: "Dollar", symbol: "$", fuel: "Fuel", year: 1875 },
    "1920s": { name: "Dollar", symbol: "$", fuel: "Fuel", year: 1927 },
    modern: { name: "Dollar", symbol: "$", fuel: "Fuel", year: 2026 },
    cyberpunk: { name: "Credit", symbol: "¢", fuel: "Energy", year: 2077 },
    "sci-fi": { name: "Credit", symbol: "¢", fuel: "Energy", year: 2488 },
    wasteland: { name: "Cap", symbol: "C", fuel: "Fuel", year: 2287 }
  };
  return t[p] || t.fantasy;
}

function ahApplyPreset(A, preset, force) {
  var d = ahPresetDefaults(preset);
  A.settings.preset = (preset || "fantasy").toLowerCase();
  if (force || !A.presetSeeded) {
    A.currencyName = d.name;
    A.currencySymbol = d.symbol;
    A.settings.fuelName = d.fuel;
    if (A.time) A.time.year = d.year;
    A.presetSeeded = true;
  }
}

function ahFind(title) {
  try {
    if (typeof storyCards === "undefined" || !storyCards) return null;
    for (var i = 0; i < storyCards.length; i++) {
      if (storyCards[i] && storyCards[i].title === title) {
        return { card: storyCards[i], index: i };
      }
    }
  } catch (e) {}
  return null;
}

function ahWrite(title, entry, type) {
  type = type || "Aetherheart";
  try {
    var found = ahFind(title);
    if (found) {
      try {
        found.card.entry = entry;
        found.card.keys = title;
        found.card.title = title;
        if (type) found.card.type = type;
      } catch (e1) {}
      try {
        if (typeof updateStoryCard === "function") {
          updateStoryCard(found.index, title, entry, type, title, "");
        }
      } catch (e2) {}
      return;
    }
    if (typeof addStoryCard === "function") {
      try {
        addStoryCard(title, entry, type, title);
      } catch (e3) {
        try {
          addStoryCard(title, entry, type);
        } catch (e4) {}
      }
    }
  } catch (e) {}
}

function ahMsg(A, msg) {
  try {
    if (!msg) return;
    if (A && A.settings && A.settings.silentMode) return;
    state.message = (state.message ? state.message + "\n" : "") + "[SYSTEM] " + msg;
  } catch (e) {}
}

function ahMonth(m) {
  var n = ["January","February","March","April","May","June","July","August","September","October","November","December"];
  return n[(m || 1) - 1] || "Unknown";
}

function ahHour(h) {
  var hr = Math.floor(h || 0);
  var ap = hr >= 12 ? "PM" : "AM";
  var d = hr % 12 === 0 ? 12 : hr % 12;
  return d + ":00 " + ap;
}

function ahOnOff(block, key) {
  if (!block) return null;
  var re = new RegExp(key + "\\s*:\\s*(ON|OFF)", "i");
  var m = block.match(re);
  if (!m) return null;
  return m[1].toUpperCase() === "ON";
}

function ahVal(block, key) {
  if (!block) return null;
  var re = new RegExp(key + "\\s*:\\s*([^\\n]+)", "i");
  var m = block.match(re);
  return m ? m[1].trim() : null;
}

function ahBuildStatus(A) {
  var lines = [];
  var t = A.time;
  if (A.settings.timeEnabled) {
    lines.push(ahMonth(t.month) + " " + t.day + ", Year " + t.year + " | " + ahHour(t.hour));
  }
  if (A.settings.vitals) {
    var v = A.vitals;
    lines.push("HP " + v.hp + "/" + v.maxHp + " MP " + v.mp + "/" + v.maxMp + " STA " + v.stamina + "/" + v.maxStamina);
  }
  if (A.settings.currencyEnabled) {
    lines.push("Balance " + (A.currencySymbol || "G") + (A.balance || 0));
  }
  return "== STATUS ==\n" + (lines.length ? lines.join("\n") : "(no active meters)");
}

function ahBuildBounty(A) {
  var lines = ["== BOUNTY BOARD ==", ""];
  var list = A.bounties || [];
  if (!list.length) lines.push("(no bounties)");
  else {
    for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
      lines.push((i + 1) + ". " + list[i].name + " — " + (list[i].condition || "Either"));
    }
  }
  lines.push("", "[ADD BOUNTY: Name | Dead/Alive/Either | reward]");
  lines.push("Speech: check the bounty board, take the bounty on X");
  return lines.join("\n");
}

  var list = A.jobs || [];

      lines.push((i + 1) + ". " + list[i].title + " — " + (list[i].pay || "?"));

    }
  }
  return lines.join("\n");
}

function ahReadConfig(A) {
  var found = ahFind("Configure Aetherheart");
  if (!found || !found.card || !found.card.entry) return;
  var e = found.card.entry;
  var prev = A.settings.preset;
  var p = ahVal(e, "Preset");
  if (p) {
    var np = p.split(/\s|\|/)[0].toLowerCase();
    if (np && np !== prev) ahApplyPreset(A, np, true);
    else A.settings.preset = np || prev;
  }
  var r = ahVal(e, "Rating");
  if (r) A.settings.rating = r.split(/\s|\|/)[0];
  var pairs = [
    ["Script", "scriptEnabled"],
    ["Inventory", "inventoryEnabled"],
    ["Currency", "currencyEnabled"],
    ["Time", "timeEnabled"],
    ["Narration System", "narrationSystem"],
    ["Silent Mode", "silentMode"],
    ["RP System", "rpSystem"],
    ["Inner Thoughts", "innerThoughts"],
    ["Inner Opinions", "innerOpinions"],
    ["Card Creator", "cardCreator"],
    ["Scheduling", "scheduling"],
    ["Bounty Board", "bountyBoard"],
    ["Job Board", "jobBoard"],
    ["Quests", "quests"],
    ["Story Splice", "storySplice"]
  ];
  for (var i = 0; i < pairs.length; i++) {
    var v = ahOnOff(e, pairs[i][0]);
    if (v !== null) A.settings[pairs[i][1]] = v;
  }
  var cn = ahVal(e, "Currency name");
  if (cn) A.currencyName = cn.split(/\n/)[0].trim();
  var cs = ahVal(e, "Currency symbol");
  if (cs) A.currencySymbol = cs.split(/\n/)[0].trim();
}

function ahReadRP(A) {
  var found = ahFind("RP System");
  if (!found || !found.card || !found.card.entry) {
    if (A.settings.rpSystem) {
      A.settings.vitals = true;
      A.settings.survival = true;
    }
    return;
  }
  var e = found.card.entry;
  var pairs = [
    ["Vitals", "vitals"],
    ["Survival", "survival"],
    ["Leveling", "leveling"],
    ["d20", "d20"],
    ["Fuel", "fuel"]
  ];
  for (var i = 0; i < pairs.length; i++) {
    var v = ahOnOff(e, pairs[i][0]);
    if (v !== null) A.settings[pairs[i][1]] = v;
  }
  var fn = ahVal(e, "Fuel Name");
  if (fn) A.settings.fuelName = fn.split(/\n/)[0].trim();
}

function ahSync(A) {
  ahReadConfig(A);
  ahReadRP(A);
}

function ahUpdateCards(A) {
  if (!A.presetSeeded) ahApplyPreset(A, A.settings.preset, true);
  ahWrite("Configure Aetherheart", ahBuildConfigure(A), "Aetherheart");
  ahWrite("Help", ahBuildHelp(), "Aetherheart");
  ahWrite("Status", ahBuildStatus(A), "Aetherheart");
  if (A.settings.timeEnabled) {
    ahWrite("Configure Time", ahBuildTime(A), "Aetherheart");
    ahWrite("Events", "== EVENTS ==\n[ADD EVENT: Name | start | end | description]\n\n(none yet)", "Aetherheart");
    ahWrite("Holidays", "== HOLIDAYS ==\n[ADD: Name | Month Day]\n\n(none yet)", "Aetherheart");
  }
  if (A.settings.scheduling) {
    ahWrite("Schedule Time Blocks", "== SCHEDULE ==\n[ADD: name | Day/Week/Weekend/Holiday | start | end | desc]", "Aetherheart");
  }
  if (A.settings.rpSystem) {
    ahWrite("RP System", ahBuildRP(A), "Aetherheart");
    if (A.settings.vitals || A.settings.survival) {
      ahWrite("Vitals", ahBuildVitals(A), "Aetherheart");
    }
  }
  if (A.settings.innerThoughts) ahWrite("Inner Thoughts", ahBuildThoughts(), "Aetherheart");
  if (A.settings.innerOpinions) ahWrite("Inner Opinions", ahBuildOpinions(), "Aetherheart");
  if (A.settings.bountyBoard) ahWrite("Bounty Board", ahBuildBounty(A), "Aetherheart");
  if (A.settings.jobBoard) ahWrite("Job Board", ahBuildJob(A), "Aetherheart");
  if (A.settings.quests) ahWrite("Quests", ahBuildQuests(A), "Aetherheart");
  if (A.settings.inventoryEnabled) ahWrite("Inventory", ahBuildInventory(A), "Aetherheart");
  if (A.settings.currencyEnabled) ahWrite("Ledger", ahBuildLedger(A), "Aetherheart");
  if (A.settings.cardCreator) {
    ahWrite("Card Creator", "== CARD CREATOR ==\n/card Character Title details\n/card Location Title details", "Aetherheart");
  }
  if (A.settings.narrationSystem) {
    ahWrite("Narration", "== NARRATION ==\nNarrate Player: OFF\nPresent Tense: ON\nStory Splice: OFF", "Aetherheart");
  }
  if (A.settings.storySplice) {
    ahWrite("Story Splice", "== STORY SPLICE ==\n[SPLICE ON: Name]\nWestern, Noir, Sitcom, Deadpool Break, Confessional Cutaway", "Aetherheart");
  }
}

function ahParseMins(A) {
  var str = (A.time && A.time.timePerTurn) || "5m";
  var m = String(str).match(/^(\d+)/);
  return m ? parseInt(m[1], 10) : 5;
}

function ahAdvance(A, mins) {
  if (!A.settings.timeEnabled) return;
  var t = A.time;
  var total = Math.floor((t.hour || 0) * 60) + (mins || 0);
  var days = Math.floor(total / 1440);
  total = total % 1440;
  t.hour = total / 60;
  t.day = (t.day || 1) + days;
  while (t.day > 30) { t.day -= 30; t.month++; }
  while (t.month > 12) { t.month -= 12; t.year++; }
}

function ahInject(A) {
  try {
    if (!state.memory) state.memory = {};
    var parts = [];
    if (A.settings.timeEnabled && A.time) {
      parts.push(ahMonth(A.time.month) + " " + A.time.day + ", " + A.time.year + " " + ahHour(A.time.hour));
    }
    if (A.settings.vitals && A.vitals) {
      parts.push("HP " + A.vitals.hp + "/" + A.vitals.maxHp);
    }
    state.memory.frontMemory = parts.length ? ("[Status: " + parts.join(" | ") + "]") : "";
    var notes = [];
    if (A.settings.informationFirewall) {
      notes.push("Characters only know in-world knowledge.");
    }
    if (A.settings.standardRules) {
      notes.push("Keep pronouns consistent. Avoid purple prose.");
    }
    state.memory.authorsNote = notes.join(" ");
  } catch (e) {}
}

function onInput_Aetherheart(text) {
  try {
    var A = ahEnsure();
    ahSync(A);
    if (!A.settings.scriptEnabled) return text;
    if (!text) return text;

    var cmd = String(text).trim().toLowerCase();
    if (cmd === "/help") {
      state.message = ahBuildHelp();
      return text;
    }
    if (cmd === "/status") {
      state.message = ahBuildStatus(A);
      return text;
    }
    if (cmd === "/balance") {
      state.message = "Balance: " + (A.currencySymbol || "G") + (A.balance || 0);
      return text;
    }
    if (cmd === "/time") {
      var t = A.time;
      state.message = ahMonth(t.month) + " " + t.day + ", Year " + t.year + " | " + ahHour(t.hour);
      return text;
    }
    if (cmd === "/inventory") {
      state.message = ahBuildInventory(A);
      return text;
    }
    if (cmd === "/ah enable") {
      A.settings.scriptEnabled = true;
      ahMsg(A, "Script ON");
      return text;
    }
    if (cmd === "/ah disable") {
      A.settings.scriptEnabled = false;
      ahMsg(A, "Script OFF");
      return text;
    }
    if (cmd === "/ah toggle") {
      A.settings.scriptEnabled = !A.settings.scriptEnabled;
      ahMsg(A, "Script " + (A.settings.scriptEnabled ? "ON" : "OFF"));
      return text;
    }

    var low = String(text).toLowerCase();
    ahAdvance(A, ahParseMins(A));

    if (A.settings.vitals && /\b(rest|sleep|camp)\b/.test(low)) {
      A.vitals.stamina = A.vitals.maxStamina;
      ahMsg(A, "Rested");
    }
    if (A.settings.bountyBoard && /bounty board|wanted posters/.test(low)) {
      ahMsg(A, "Bounty Board checked");
    }
    if (A.settings.jobBoard && /job board|look for work/.test(low)) {
      ahMsg(A, "Job Board checked");
    }
    if (A.settings.d20) {
      var m = String(text).match(/roll for (attack|saving|ability check|initiative)/i);
      if (m) {
        ahMsg(A, "d20 " + m[1] + " -> " + (Math.floor(Math.random() * 20) + 1));
      }
    }

    ahUpdateCards(A);
  } catch (e) {
    try {
      state.message = "AH Input: " + (e && e.message ? e.message : String(e));
    } catch (e2) {}
  }
  return text;
}

function onContext_Aetherheart(text) {
  try {
    var A = ahEnsure();
    ahSync(A);
    if (A.settings.scriptEnabled) ahInject(A);
  } catch (e) {}
  return text;
}

function onOutput_Aetherheart(text) {
  try {
    var A = ahEnsure();
    ahSync(A);
    if (!A.settings.scriptEnabled) return text;

    ahUpdateCards(A);
  } catch (e) {
    try {
      state.message = "AH Output: " + (e && e.message ? e.message : String(e));
    } catch (e2) {}
  }
  return text;
}

var AH_TYPE = "Aetherheart";

function ahEnsure() {
  if (!state.aether) {
    state.aether = {
      settings: {
        scriptEnabled: true, preset: "fantasy", rating: "E",
        inventoryEnabled: false, currencyEnabled: false, timeEnabled: false,
        billsEnabled: false, currencyContext: false, narrationSystem: false,
        silentMode: false, rpSystem: false, vitals: false, survival: false,
        leveling: false, skills: false, abilities: false, powers: false,
        loot: false, d20: false, fuel: false, fuelName: "Stamina", ammo: false,
        reputation: false, jail: false, momentum: false, deusEx: false,
        antiDeusEx: false, bountyBoard: false, jobBoard: false, quests: false,
        innerThoughts: false, innerOpinions: false, cardCreator: false,
        scheduling: false, storySplice: false, isekai: false, shift: false,
        sleeveJump: false, standardRules: true, informationFirewall: true,
        magicMode: "sorcery", narratePlayer: false, presentTense: true

function ahApplyPreset(A, preset, force) {
  var pack = ahPresetPack(preset);
  A.settings.preset = (preset || "fantasy").toLowerCase();
  if (force || !A.presetSeeded) {
    A.currencyName = pack.currencyName;
    A.currencySymbol = pack.currencySymbol;
    A.settings.fuelName = pack.fuelName;
    A.balance = pack.balance;
    if (A.time) A.time.year = pack.year;
    A.goods = pack.goods.slice();
    A.holidays = pack.holidays.slice();
    A.bills = pack.bills.slice();
    A.income = pack.income.slice();
    A.presetSeeded = true;
  }
}

function ahFind(title) {
  try {
    if (typeof storyCards === "undefined" || !storyCards) return null;
    for (var i = 0; i < storyCards.length; i++) {
      if (storyCards[i] && storyCards[i].title === title) return { card: storyCards[i], index: i };
    }
  } catch (e) {}
  return null;
}

function ahWrite(title, entry, type) {
  type = type || AH_TYPE;
  try {
    var found = ahFind(title);
    if (found) {
      try {
        found.card.entry = entry;
        found.card.keys = title;
        found.card.title = title;
        found.card.type = type;
      } catch (e1) {}
      try {
        if (typeof updateStoryCard === "function") updateStoryCard(found.index, title, entry, type, title, "");
      } catch (e2) {}
      return true;
    }
    if (typeof addStoryCard === "function") {
      try { addStoryCard(title, entry, type, title); return true; }
      catch (e3) { try { addStoryCard(title, entry, type); return true; } catch (e4) {} }
    }
  } catch (e) {}
  return false;
}

function ahMsg(A, msg) {
  try {
    if (!msg) return;
    if (A && A.settings && A.settings.silentMode) return;
    state.message = (state.message ? state.message + "\n" : "") + "[SYSTEM] " + msg;
  } catch (e) {}
}

function ahMonth(m) {
  var n = ["January","February","March","April","May","June","July","August","September","October","November","December"];
  return n[(m || 1) - 1] || "Unknown";
}

function ahHour(h) {
  var hr = Math.floor(h || 0);
  var ap = hr >= 12 ? "PM" : "AM";
  var d = hr % 12 === 0 ? 12 : hr % 12;
  return d + ":00 " + ap;
}

function ahOnOff(block, key) {
  if (!block) return null;
  var re = new RegExp(key.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&") + "\\s*:\\s*(ON|OFF)", "i");
  var m = block.match(re);
  if (!m) return null;
  return m[1].toUpperCase() === "ON";
}

function ahVal(block, key) {
  if (!block) return null;
  var re = new RegExp(key.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&") + "\\s*:\\s*([^\\n]+)", "i");
  var m = block.match(re);
  return m ? m[1].trim() : null;
}

function ahBuildInventory(A) {
  function sec(title, obj) {
    var ks = Object.keys(obj || {});
    var out = title + "\n";
    if (!ks.length) return out + "(none)\n";
    for (var i = 0; i < ks.length; i++) out += ks[i] + (obj[ks[i]] > 1 ? " x" + obj[ks[i]] : "") + "\n";
    return out;
  }
  var inv = A.inventory || {};
  var eq = A.equipped || {};
  return "== INVENTORY ==\n" + sec("-- CLOTHES --", inv.clothes) + "\n" + sec("-- ARMOR --", inv.armor) + "\n" + sec("-- WEAPONS --", inv.weapons) + "\n" + sec("-- AMMO --", inv.ammo) + "\n" + sec("-- OTHER --", inv.other) + "\n" +
    "Equipped: W:" + (eq.weapon || "—") + " A:" + (eq.armor || "—") + " C:" + (eq.clothes || "—") + "\n\n[Speech: give, take, equip, unequip, reload, buy]\n[Armor/weapons permanent with #]";
}

function ahReadConfig(A) {
  var found = ahFind("Configure Aetherheart");
  if (!found || !found.card || !found.card.entry) return;
  var e = found.card.entry;
  var prev = A.settings.preset;
  var p = ahVal(e, "Preset");
  if (p) {
    var np = p.split(/\s|\|/)[0].toLowerCase();
    if (np && np !== prev) ahApplyPreset(A, np, true);
    else A.settings.preset = np || prev;
  }
  var r = ahVal(e, "Rating");
  if (r) A.settings.rating = r.split(/\s|\|/)[0];
  var pairs = [
    ["Script", "scriptEnabled"], ["Inventory", "inventoryEnabled"], ["Currency", "currencyEnabled"],
    ["Time", "timeEnabled"], ["Bills", "billsEnabled"], ["Currency context", "currencyContext"],
    ["Narration System", "narrationSystem"], ["Silent Mode", "silentMode"], ["RP System", "rpSystem"],
    ["Inner Thoughts", "innerThoughts"], ["Inner Opinions", "innerOpinions"], ["Card Creator", "cardCreator"],
    ["Scheduling", "scheduling"], ["Bounty Board", "bountyBoard"], ["Job Board", "jobBoard"],
    ["Quests", "quests"], ["Story Splice", "storySplice"]
  ];
  for (var i = 0; i < pairs.length; i++) {
    var v = ahOnOff(e, pairs[i][0]);
    if (v !== null) A.settings[pairs[i][1]] = v;
  }
  var cn = ahVal(e, "Currency name");
  if (cn) A.currencyName = cn.split(/\n/)[0].trim();
  var cs = ahVal(e, "Currency symbol");
  if (cs) A.currencySymbol = cs.split(/\n/)[0].trim();
}

function ahReadRP(A) {
  var found = ahFind("RP System");
  if (!found || !found.card || !found.card.entry) {
    if (A.settings.rpSystem) {
      A.settings.vitals = true;
      A.settings.survival = true;
    }
    return;
  }
  var e = found.card.entry;
  var pairs = [
    ["Vitals", "vitals"], ["Survival", "survival"], ["Leveling", "leveling"],
    ["Skills", "skills"], ["Abilities", "abilities"], ["Powers", "powers"],
    ["Loot", "loot"], ["Ammo", "ammo"], ["d20", "d20"], ["Fuel", "fuel"],
    ["Reputation", "reputation"], ["Jail", "jail"], ["Momentum", "momentum"],
    ["Deus Ex", "deusEx"], ["Anti-Deus Ex", "antiDeusEx"]
  ];
  for (var i = 0; i < pairs.length; i++) {
    var v = ahOnOff(e, pairs[i][0]);
    if (v !== null) A.settings[pairs[i][1]] = v;
  }
  var fn = ahVal(e, "Fuel Name");
  if (fn) A.settings.fuelName = fn.split(/\n/)[0].trim();
  var mm = ahVal(e, "Magic Mode");
  if (mm) {
    mm = mm.toLowerCase();
    if (mm.indexOf("wizard") === 0) A.settings.magicMode = "wizarding";
    else if (mm.indexOf("sorc") === 0) A.settings.magicMode = "sorcery";
  }
  if (!A.settings.leveling) {
    A.settings.skills = false;
    A.settings.abilities = false;
    A.settings.powers = false;
    A.settings.loot = false;
  }
}

function ahReadTime(A) {
  var found = ahFind("Configure Time");
  if (!found || !found.card || !found.card.entry) return;
  var e = found.card.entry;
  var tpt = ahVal(e, "Time/Turn");
  if (tpt) A.time.timePerTurn = tpt.split(/\s/)[0];
  var y = ahVal(e, "Year");
  if (y && !isNaN(parseInt(y, 10))) A.time.year = parseInt(y, 10);
  var mo = ahVal(e, "Month");
  if (mo && !isNaN(parseInt(mo, 10))) A.time.month = parseInt(mo, 10);
  var d = ahVal(e, "Day");
  if (d && !isNaN(parseInt(d, 10))) A.time.day = parseInt(d, 10);
  var h = ahVal(e, "Hour");
  if (h && !isNaN(parseFloat(h))) A.time.hour = parseFloat(h);
}

function ahSync(A) {
  try { ahReadConfig(A); } catch (e) {}
  try { ahReadRP(A); } catch (e) {}
  try { ahReadTime(A); } catch (e) {}
}

function ahParseMins(A) {
  var str = (A.time && A.time.timePerTurn) || "5m";
  var m = String(str).match(/^(\d+)\s*(m|min|h|hr|hrs)?/i);
  if (!m) return 5;
  var n = parseInt(m[1], 10);
  var u = (m[2] || "m").toLowerCase();
  if (u.indexOf("h") === 0) return n * 60;
  return n;
}

function ahAdvance(A, mins) {
  if (!A.settings.timeEnabled) return;
  var t = A.time;
  var total = Math.floor((t.hour || 0) * 60) + (mins || 0);
  var days = Math.floor(total / 1440);
  total = total % 1440;
  t.hour = total / 60;
  t.day = (t.day || 1) + days;
  while (t.day > 30) { t.day -= 30; t.month++; }
  while (t.month > 12) { t.month -= 12; t.year++; }
}

function ahTickSurvival(A, mins) {
  if (!A.settings.survival) return;
  var f = Math.max(1, Math.floor((mins || 5) / 5));
  A.survival.hunger = Math.min(100, (A.survival.hunger || 0) + f);
  A.survival.thirst = Math.min(100, (A.survival.thirst || 0) + f + 1);
  A.survival.tiredness = Math.min(100, (A.survival.tiredness || 0) + Math.floor(f / 2));
}

function ahInvAdd(A, cat, name, qty) {
  if (!A.inventory[cat]) A.inventory[cat] = {};
  var perm = /#/.test(name) || /\b(armor|sword|gun|rifle|blade|vest|plate)\b/i.test(name);
  var clean = String(name).replace(/#/g, "").trim();
  if (perm) A.inventory[cat][clean + " #"] = 1;
  else A.inventory[cat][clean] = (A.inventory[cat][clean] || 0) + (qty || 1);
}

function ahLedger(A, note, amount) {
  A.ledger = A.ledger || [];
  A.ledger.push((amount >= 0 ? "+" : "") + amount + "  " + note);
  if (A.ledger.length > 40) A.ledger = A.ledger.slice(-30);
  A.balance = (A.balance || 0) + amount;
}

function ahHandleAdds(text, A) {
  var msgs = [];
  var lines = String(text).split(/\n/);
  for (var i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
    var line = lines[i];
    var m;
    m = line.match(/\[ADD BOUNTY:\s*([^\]|]+)\|\s*([^\]|]+)\|\s*([^\]]+)\]/i);
    if (m) {
      A.bounties.push({ name: m[1].trim(), condition: m[2].trim(), reward: m[3].trim(), taken: false });
      msgs.push("Bounty posted: " + m[1].trim());
    }
    m = line.match(/\[ADD JOB:\s*([^\]|]+)\|\s*([^\]|]+)\|\s*([^\]]+)\]/i);
    if (m) {
      A.jobs.push({ title: m[1].trim(), pay: m[2].trim(), desc: m[3].trim() });
      msgs.push("Job posted: " + m[1].trim());
    }
    m = line.match(/\[ADD QUEST:\s*([^\]|]+)(?:\|\s*([^\]]+))?\]/i);
    if (m && A.quests.length < 5) {
      A.quests.push({ title: m[1].trim(), progress: 0, desc: (m[2] || "").trim() });
      msgs.push("Quest: " + m[1].trim());
    }
    m = line.match(/\[SPLICE ON:\s*([^\]]+)\]/i);
    if (m) {
      var n = m[1].trim();
      if (A.splices.indexOf(n) < 0) A.splices.push(n);
      msgs.push("Splice ON: " + n);
    }
    m = line.match(/\[SPLICE OFF:\s*([^\]]+)\]/i);
    if (m) {
      var off = m[1].trim().toLowerCase();
      A.splices = A.splices.filter(function (s) { return s.toLowerCase() !== off; });
      msgs.push("Splice OFF");
    }
    if (/\[SPLICE CLEAR\]/i.test(line)) {
      A.splices = [];
      msgs.push("Splices cleared");
    }
  }
  return msgs;
}

function ahHandleSpeech(text, A) {
  var t = String(text).toLowerCase();
  var msgs = [];
  var m;

  if (A.settings.bountyBoard) {
    if (/bounty board|wanted posters/.test(t)) msgs.push("Bounty Board checked");
    m = t.match(/take (?:the )?bounty on ([a-z0-9\s\-']{2,40})/);
    if (m) {
      var name = m[1].trim();
      A.bounties.push({ name: name, condition: "Either", reward: "TBD", taken: true });
      if (A.settings.quests && A.quests.length < 5) {
        A.quests.push({ title: "Bounty: " + name, progress: 0 });
      }
      msgs.push("Bounty taken: " + name);
    }
    m = t.match(/turn in (?:the )?bounty on ([a-z0-9\s\-']{2,40})/);
    if (m) {
      if (A.settings.currencyEnabled) ahLedger(A, "Bounty " + m[1].trim(), 50);
      msgs.push("Bounty turned in");
    }
  }

  if (A.settings.jobBoard) {
    if (/job board|look for work/.test(t)) msgs.push("Job Board checked");
    if (/take (?:the )?job|accept (?:the )?job/.test(t)) msgs.push("Job accepted");
    if (/complete (?:the )?job|finish (?:the )?job/.test(t)) {
      if (A.settings.currencyEnabled) ahLedger(A, "Job pay", 25);
      msgs.push("Job completed");
    }
  }

  if (A.settings.vitals && /\b(rest|sleep|camp)\b/.test(t)) {
    A.vitals.stamina = A.vitals.maxStamina;
    A.vitals.mp = Math.min(A.vitals.maxMp, A.vitals.mp + Math.floor(A.vitals.maxMp * 0.3));
    if (A.settings.survival) A.survival.tiredness = Math.max(0, A.survival.tiredness - 40);
    ahAdvance(A, 360);
    msgs.push("Rested");
  }

  if (A.settings.fuel && /\b(refuel|fill up|recharge)\b/.test(t)) {
    A.fuel = 100;
    msgs.push((A.settings.fuelName || "Fuel") + " restored");
  }

  if (A.settings.currencyEnabled) {
    if (/check (my )?(balance|wallet|money)/.test(t)) {
      msgs.push("Balance: " + (A.currencySymbol || "G") + (A.balance || 0));
    }
    m = t.match(/(?:buy|purchase)\s+(?:a |an |the )?([a-z0-9\s\-']{2,40})(?:\s+for\s+(\d+))?/);
    if (m) {
      var price = m[2] ? parseInt(m[2], 10) : 10;
      if ((A.balance || 0) >= price) {
        ahLedger(A, "Bought " + m[1].trim(), -price);
        ahInvAdd(A, "other", m[1].trim(), 1);
        msgs.push("Bought " + m[1].trim());
      } else {
        msgs.push("Cannot afford");
      }
    }
  }

  if (A.settings.inventoryEnabled) {
    m = t.match(/\b(?:take|grab|pick up|loot)\s+(?:the\s+)?([a-z0-9\s\-']{2,40})/);
    if (m) {
      ahInvAdd(A, "other", m[1].trim(), 1);
      msgs.push("Took " + m[1].trim());
    }
    m = t.match(/\b(?:equip|wear|put on)\s+(?:the\s+)?([a-z0-9\s\-']{2,40})/);
    if (m) {
      var item = m[1].trim();
      if (/armor|vest|mail|plate|helmet/i.test(item)) A.equipped.armor = item;
      else if (/sword|gun|rifle|pistol|bow|knife|blade|staff/i.test(item)) A.equipped.weapon = item;
      else A.equipped.clothes = item;
      msgs.push("Equipped " + item);
    }
  }

  if (A.settings.d20) {
    m = String(text).match(/roll for (attack|saving|ability check|initiative)/i);
    if (m) {
      msgs.push("d20 " + m[1] + " → " + (Math.floor(Math.random() * 20) + 1));
    }
  }

  return msgs;
}

function ahHandleCardCmd(text, A) {
  var m = String(text).match(/^\/card\s+(character|location|other)?\s*(.+)$/i);
  if (!m) return false;
  var type = (m[1] || "other");
  type = type.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + type.slice(1).toLowerCase();
  var rest = m[2].trim().split(/\s+/);
  if (!m[1] && rest.length && /^(character|location|other)$/i.test(rest[0])) {
    type = rest.shift();
    type = type.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + type.slice(1).toLowerCase();
  }
  var title = rest[0] || "Untitled";
  var details = rest.slice(1).join(" ");
  var entry = "";
  if (A.settings.innerThoughts) entry += "{title: " + title + "}\n";
  if (type === "Character") {
    entry += "Name: " + title + "\nAppearance: \nPersonality: \nBackground: \n";
    if (details) entry += "Notes: " + details + "\n";
  } else {
    entry += "Name: " + title + "\nDescription: " + (details || "") + "\n";
  }
  ahWrite(title, entry, AH_TYPE);
  ahMsg(A, "Card created: " + title + " (" + type + ")");
  return true;
}

function ahUpdateCards(A) {
  if (!A.presetSeeded) ahApplyPreset(A, A.settings.preset, true);

  ahWrite("Configure Aetherheart", ahBuildConfigure(A), AH_TYPE);
  ahWrite("Help", ahBuildHelp(), AH_TYPE);
  ahWrite("Keywords", ahBuildKeywords(), AH_TYPE);

  if (A.settings.timeEnabled) {
    ahWrite("Configure Time", ahBuildTime(A), AH_TYPE);
    ahWrite("Events", ahBuildEvents(A), AH_TYPE);
    ahWrite("Holidays", ahBuildHolidays(A), AH_TYPE);
  }
  if (A.settings.scheduling) ahWrite("Schedule Time Blocks", ahBuildSchedule(A), AH_TYPE);
  if (A.settings.currencyEnabled) {
    ahWrite("Prices & Goods", ahBuildGoods(A), AH_TYPE);
    ahWrite("Ledger", ahBuildLedger(A), AH_TYPE);
  }
  if (A.settings.billsEnabled) ahWrite("Bills", ahBuildBills(A), AH_TYPE);
  if (A.settings.inventoryEnabled) ahWrite("Inventory", ahBuildInventory(A), AH_TYPE);
  if (A.settings.rpSystem) {
    ahWrite("RP System", ahBuildRP(A), AH_TYPE);
    if (A.settings.vitals || A.settings.survival) ahWrite("Vitals", ahBuildVitals(A), AH_TYPE);
    if (A.settings.leveling) ahWrite("Character Sheet", ahBuildSheet(A), AH_TYPE);
  }
  if (A.settings.innerThoughts) ahWrite("Inner Thoughts", ahBuildThoughts(A), AH_TYPE);
  if (A.settings.innerOpinions) ahWrite("Inner Opinions", ahBuildOpinions(A), AH_TYPE);
  if (A.settings.bountyBoard) ahWrite("Bounty Board", ahBuildBounty(A), AH_TYPE);
  if (A.settings.jobBoard) ahWrite("Job Board", ahBuildJob(A), AH_TYPE);
  if (A.settings.quests) ahWrite("Quests", ahBuildQuests(A), AH_TYPE);
  if (A.settings.cardCreator) ahWrite("Card Creator", ahBuildCardCreator(), AH_TYPE);
  if (A.settings.narrationSystem) ahWrite("Narration", ahBuildNarration(A), AH_TYPE);
  if (A.settings.storySplice) ahWrite("Story Splice", ahBuildSplice(A), AH_TYPE);
}

function ahInject(A) {
  try {
    if (!state.memory) state.memory = {};
    var parts = [];
    if (A.settings.timeEnabled && A.time) {
      parts.push(ahMonth(A.time.month) + " " + A.time.day + ", " + A.time.year + " " + ahHour(A.time.hour));
    }
    if (A.settings.vitals && A.vitals) {
      parts.push("HP " + A.vitals.hp + "/" + A.vitals.maxHp + " MP " + A.vitals.mp + "/" + A.vitals.maxMp + " STA " + A.vitals.stamina + "/" + A.vitals.maxStamina);
    }
    if (A.settings.currencyEnabled && A.settings.currencyContext) {
      parts.push((A.currencySymbol || "G") + (A.balance || 0));
    }
    state.memory.frontMemory = parts.length ? ("[Status: " + parts.join(" | ") + "]") : "";

    var notes = [];
    if (A.settings.informationFirewall) notes.push("Characters only know in-world knowledge. No meta or script awareness.");
    if (A.settings.standardRules) notes.push("Keep pronouns consistent. Avoid purple prose and sentient glowing objects.");
    if (A.settings.narratePlayer) notes.push("Narrate NPCs only; do not write the player character's actions or dialogue.");
    if (A.settings.presentTense) notes.push("Write in present tense.");
    else notes.push("Write in past tense.");
    if (A.settings.storySplice && A.splices && A.splices.length) {
      notes.push("Narrative flavor only from: " + A.splices.join(", ") + ". Do not change plot.");
    }
    var r = String(A.settings.rating || "E").toUpperCase();
    if (r === "E") notes.push("Content rating E.");
    else if (r === "TEEN" || r === "T") notes.push("Content rating Teen.");
    else if (r === "NSFW" || r === "M") notes.push("Mature content allowed.");
    else notes.push("Unrated content.");
    state.memory.authorsNote = notes.join(" ");
  } catch (e) {}
}

function onInput_Aetherheart(text) {
  try {
    var A = ahEnsure();
    ahSync(A);
    if (!A.settings.scriptEnabled) return text;
    if (text === undefined || text === null) return "";

    var cmd = String(text).trim().toLowerCase();
    if (cmd === "/help") { state.message = ahBuildHelp(); return text; }
    if (cmd === "/keywords") { state.message = ahBuildKeywords(); return text; }
    if (cmd === "/balance") {
      state.message = "Balance: " + (A.currencySymbol || "G") + (A.balance || 0);
      return text;
    }
    if (cmd === "/time") {
      var t = A.time;
      state.message = ahMonth(t.month) + " " + t.day + ", Year " + t.year + " | " + ahHour(t.hour);
      return text;
    }
    if (cmd === "/inventory") { state.message = ahBuildInventory(A); return text; }
    if (cmd === "/ledger") { state.message = ahBuildLedger(A); return text; }
    if (cmd === "/ah enable") { A.settings.scriptEnabled = true; ahMsg(A, "Script ON"); return text; }
    if (cmd === "/ah disable") { A.settings.scriptEnabled = false; ahMsg(A, "Script OFF"); return text; }
    if (cmd === "/ah toggle") {
      A.settings.scriptEnabled = !A.settings.scriptEnabled;
      ahMsg(A, "Script " + (A.settings.scriptEnabled ? "ON" : "OFF"));
      return text;
    }

    if (ahHandleCardCmd(text, A)) {
      ahUpdateCards(A);
      return text;
    }

    var mins = ahParseMins(A);
    ahAdvance(A, mins);
    ahTickSurvival(A, mins);

    var msgs = [].concat(ahHandleAdds(text, A), ahHandleSpeech(text, A));
    for (var i = 0; i < msgs.length; i++) ahMsg(A, msgs[i]);

    ahUpdateCards(A);
  } catch (e) {
    try { state.message = "AH Input: " + (e && e.message ? e.message : String(e)); } catch (e2) {}
  }
  return text;
}

function onContext_Aetherheart(text) {
  try {
    var A = ahEnsure();
    ahSync(A);
    if (A.settings.scriptEnabled) ahInject(A);
  } catch (e) {}
  return text;
}

function onOutput_Aetherheart(text) {
  try {
    var A = ahEnsure();
    ahSync(A);
    if (!A.settings.scriptEnabled) return text;
    ahInject(A);
    ahUpdateCards(A);
    if (A.settings.vitals && A.vitals && A.vitals.hp <= 0) {
      text = "GAME OVER\nYour story has ended.\n[ Restart ] [ Load ] [ Journal ]";
    }
  } catch (e) {
    try { state.message = "AH Output: " + (e && e.message ? e.message : String(e)); } catch (e2) {}
  }
  return text;
}

// AETHERHEART — LIBRARY (functions only — no modifier, no top-level boot)
var AH_TYPE = "Aetherheart";

function ahEnsure() {
  if (!state.aether) {
    state.aether = {
      settings: {
        scriptEnabled: true, preset: "fantasy", rating: "E",
        inventoryEnabled: false, currencyEnabled: false, timeEnabled: false,
        billsEnabled: false, currencyContext: false, narrationSystem: false,
        silentMode: false, rpSystem: false, vitals: false, survival: false,
        leveling: false, skills: false, abilities: false, powers: false,
        loot: false, d20: false, fuel: false, fuelName: "Stamina", ammo: false,
        reputation: false, jail: false, momentum: false, deusEx: false,
        antiDeusEx: false, bountyBoard: false, jobBoard: false, quests: false,
        innerThoughts: false, innerOpinions: false, cardCreator: false,
        scheduling: false, storySplice: false, isekai: false, shift: false,
        sleeveJump: false, standardRules: true, informationFirewall: true,
        magicMode: "sorcery", narratePlayer: false, presentTense: true
      },
      time: { year: 632, month: 4, day: 12, hour: 8, timePerTurn: "5m" },
      vitals: { hp: 100, maxHp: 100, mp: 50, maxMp: 50, stamina: 100, maxStamina: 100 },
      survival: { hunger: 0, thirst: 0, tiredness: 0 },
      stats: { STR: 10, DEX: 10, CON: 10, INT: 10, WIS: 10, CHA: 10 },
      fuel: 100, level: 1, xp: 0, xpToNext: 1000, balance: 100,
      currencyName: "Gold", currencySymbol: "G",
      inventory: { clothes: {}, armor: {}, weapons: {}, ammo: {}, other: {} },
      equipped: { weapon: null, armor: null, clothes: null },
      ledger: [], bounties: [], jobs: [], quests: [], schedule: {},
      thoughts: {}, opinions: {}, splices: [], journal: [],
      reputation: { law: 0, social: 0, heat: 0, bounty: 0 },
      goods: [], holidays: [], events: [], bills: [], income: [],
      presetSeeded: false
    };
    ahApplyPreset(state.aether, "fantasy", true);
  }
  if (state.aether.settings.preset === "fantasy" && state.aether.currencyName === "Dollar") {
    ahApplyPreset(state.aether, "fantasy", true);
  }
  return state.aether;
}

function ahApplyPreset(A, preset, force) {
  var pack = ahPresetPack(preset);
  A.settings.preset = (preset || "fantasy").toLowerCase();
  if (force || !A.presetSeeded) {
    A.currencyName = pack.currencyName;
    A.currencySymbol = pack.currencySymbol;
    A.settings.fuelName = pack.fuelName;
    A.balance = pack.balance;
    if (A.time) A.time.year = pack.year;
    A.goods = pack.goods.slice();
    A.holidays = pack.holidays.slice();
    A.bills = pack.bills.slice();
    A.income = pack.income.slice();
    A.presetSeeded = true;
  }
}

function ahFind(title) {
  try {
    if (typeof storyCards === "undefined" || !storyCards) return null;
    for (var i = 0; i < storyCards.length; i++) {
      if (storyCards[i] && storyCards[i].title === title) return { card: storyCards[i], index: i };
    }
  } catch (e) {}
  return null;
}

function ahWrite(title, entry, type) {
  type = type || AH_TYPE;
  try {
    var found = ahFind(title);
    if (found) {
      try {
        found.card.entry = entry;
        found.card.keys = title;
        found.card.title = title;
        found.card.type = type;
      } catch (e1) {}
      try {
        if (typeof updateStoryCard === "function") updateStoryCard(found.index, title, entry, type, title, "");
      } catch (e2) {}
      return true;
    }
    if (typeof addStoryCard === "function") {
      try { addStoryCard(title, entry, type, title); return true; }
      catch (e3) { try { addStoryCard(title, entry, type); return true; } catch (e4) {} }
    }
  } catch (e) {}
  return false;
}

function ahMsg(A, msg) {
  try {
    if (!msg) return;
    if (A && A.settings && A.settings.silentMode) return;
    state.message = (state.message ? state.message + "\n" : "") + "[SYSTEM] " + msg;
  } catch (e) {}
}

function ahMonth(m) {
  var n = ["January","February","March","April","May","June","July","August","September","October","November","December"];
  return n[(m || 1) - 1] || "Unknown";
}

function ahHour(h) {
  var hr = Math.floor(h || 0);
  var ap = hr >= 12 ? "PM" : "AM";
  var d = hr % 12 === 0 ? 12 : hr % 12;
  return d + ":00 " + ap;
}

function ahOnOff(block, key) {
  if (!block) return null;
  var re = new RegExp(key.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&") + "\\s*:\\s*(ON|OFF)", "i");
  var m = block.match(re);
  if (!m) return null;
  return m[1].toUpperCase() === "ON";
}

function ahVal(block, key) {
  if (!block) return null;
  var re = new RegExp(key.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&") + "\\s*:\\s*([^\\n]+)", "i");
  var m = block.match(re);
  return m ? m[1].trim() : null;
}

function ahBuildInventory(A) {
  function sec(title, obj) {
    var ks = Object.keys(obj || {}), out = title + "\n";
    if (!ks.length) return out + "(none)\n";
    for (var i = 0; i < ks.length; i++) out += ks[i] + (obj[ks[i]] > 1 ? " x" + obj[ks[i]] : "") + "\n";
    return out;
  }
  var inv = A.inventory || {}, eq = A.equipped || {};
  return "== INVENTORY ==\n" + sec("-- CLOTHES --", inv.clothes) + "\n" + sec("-- ARMOR --", inv.armor) + "\n" +
    sec("-- WEAPONS --", inv.weapons) + "\n" + sec("-- AMMO --", inv.ammo) + "\n" + sec("-- OTHER --", inv.other) + "\n" +
    "Equipped: W:" + (eq.weapon || "—") + " A:" + (eq.armor || "—") + " C:" + (eq.clothes || "—") +
    "\n\n[Speech: give, take, equip, unequip, reload, buy]\n[Armor/weapons permanent with #]";
}

  else {
    var start = Math.max(0, led.length - 12);
    for (var i = start; i < led.length; i++) lines.push(led[i]);
  }
  lines.push("", "[Auto-updates on pay / buy / bounty / job]");
  return lines.join("\n");
}

function ahReadConfig(A) {
  var found = ahFind("Configure Aetherheart");
  if (!found || !found.card || !found.card.entry) return;
  var e = found.card.entry, prev = A.settings.preset;
  var p = ahVal(e, "Preset");
  if (p) {
    var np = p.split(/\s|\|/)[0].toLowerCase();
    if (np && np !== prev) ahApplyPreset(A, np, true);
    else A.settings.preset = np || prev;
  }
  var r = ahVal(e, "Rating");
  if (r) A.settings.rating = r.split(/\s|\|/)[0];
  var pairs = [
    ["Script","scriptEnabled"],["Inventory","inventoryEnabled"],["Currency","currencyEnabled"],
    ["Time","timeEnabled"],["Bills","billsEnabled"],["Currency context","currencyContext"],
    ["Narration System","narrationSystem"],["Silent Mode","silentMode"],["RP System","rpSystem"],
    ["Inner Thoughts","innerThoughts"],["Inner Opinions","innerOpinions"],["Card Creator","cardCreator"],
    ["Scheduling","scheduling"],["Bounty Board","bountyBoard"],["Job Board","jobBoard"],
    ["Quests","quests"],["Story Splice","storySplice"]
  ];
  for (var i = 0; i < pairs.length; i++) {
    var v = ahOnOff(e, pairs[i][0]);
    if (v !== null) A.settings[pairs[i][1]] = v;
  }
  var cn = ahVal(e, "Currency name"); if (cn) A.currencyName = cn.split(/\n/)[0].trim();
  var cs = ahVal(e, "Currency symbol"); if (cs) A.currencySymbol = cs.split(/\n/)[0].trim();
}

function ahReadRP(A) {
  var found = ahFind("RP System");
  if (!found || !found.card || !found.card.entry) {
    if (A.settings.rpSystem) { A.settings.vitals = true; A.settings.survival = true; }
    return;
  }
  var e = found.card.entry;
  var pairs = [
    ["Vitals","vitals"],["Survival","survival"],["Leveling","leveling"],["Skills","skills"],
    ["Abilities","abilities"],["Powers","powers"],["Loot","loot"],["Ammo","ammo"],["d20","d20"],
    ["Fuel","fuel"],["Reputation","reputation"],["Jail","jail"],["Momentum","momentum"],
    ["Deus Ex","deusEx"],["Anti-Deus Ex","antiDeusEx"]
  ];
  for (var i = 0; i < pairs.length; i++) {
    var v = ahOnOff(e, pairs[i][0]);
    if (v !== null) A.settings[pairs[i][1]] = v;
  }
  var fn = ahVal(e, "Fuel Name"); if (fn) A.settings.fuelName = fn.split(/\n/)[0].trim();
  var mm = ahVal(e, "Magic Mode");
  if (mm) {
    mm = mm.toLowerCase();
    if (mm.indexOf("wizard") === 0) A.settings.magicMode = "wizarding";
    else if (mm.indexOf("sorc") === 0) A.settings.magicMode = "sorcery";
  }
  if (!A.settings.leveling) {
    A.settings.skills = false; A.settings.abilities = false; A.settings.powers = false; A.settings.loot = false;
  }
}

function ahReadTime(A) {
  var found = ahFind("Configure Time");
  if (!found || !found.card || !found.card.entry) return;
  var e = found.card.entry;
  var tpt = ahVal(e, "Time/Turn"); if (tpt) A.time.timePerTurn = tpt.split(/\s/)[0];
  var y = ahVal(e, "Year"); if (y && !isNaN(parseInt(y, 10))) A.time.year = parseInt(y, 10);
  var mo = ahVal(e, "Month"); if (mo && !isNaN(parseInt(mo, 10))) A.time.month = parseInt(mo, 10);
  var d = ahVal(e, "Day"); if (d && !isNaN(parseInt(d, 10))) A.time.day = parseInt(d, 10);
  var h = ahVal(e, "Hour"); if (h && !isNaN(parseFloat(h))) A.time.hour = parseFloat(h);
}

function ahSync(A) {
  try { ahReadConfig(A); } catch (e) {}
  try { ahReadRP(A); } catch (e) {}
  try { ahReadTime(A); } catch (e) {}
}

function ahParseMins(A) {
  var str = (A.time && A.time.timePerTurn) || "5m";
  var m = String(str).match(/^(\d+)\s*(m|min|h|hr|hrs)?/i);
  if (!m) return 5;
  var n = parseInt(m[1], 10);
  if (((m[2] || "m").toLowerCase()).indexOf("h") === 0) return n * 60;
  return n;
}

function ahAdvance(A, mins) {
  if (!A.settings.timeEnabled) return;
  var t = A.time;
  var total = Math.floor((t.hour || 0) * 60) + (mins || 0);
  var days = Math.floor(total / 1440);
  total = total % 1440;
  t.hour = total / 60;
  t.day = (t.day || 1) + days;
  while (t.day > 30) { t.day -= 30; t.month++; }
  while (t.month > 12) { t.month -= 12; t.year++; }
}

function ahTickSurvival(A, mins) {
  if (!A.settings.survival) return;
  var f = Math.max(1, Math.floor((mins || 5) / 5));
  A.survival.hunger = Math.min(100, (A.survival.hunger || 0) + f);
  A.survival.thirst = Math.min(100, (A.survival.thirst || 0) + f + 1);
  A.survival.tiredness = Math.min(100, (A.survival.tiredness || 0) + Math.floor(f / 2));
}

function ahInvAdd(A, cat, name, qty) {
  if (!A.inventory[cat]) A.inventory[cat] = {};
  var perm = /#/.test(name) || /\b(armor|sword|gun|rifle|blade|vest|plate)\b/i.test(name);
  var clean = String(name).replace(/#/g, "").trim();
  if (perm) A.inventory[cat][clean + " #"] = 1;
  else A.inventory[cat][clean] = (A.inventory[cat][clean] || 0) + (qty || 1);
}

function ahLedger(A, note, amount) {
  A.ledger = A.ledger || [];
  A.ledger.push((amount >= 0 ? "+" : "") + amount + "  " + note);
  if (A.ledger.length > 40) A.ledger = A.ledger.slice(-30);
  A.balance = (A.balance || 0) + amount;
}

function ahHandleAdds(text, A) {
  var msgs = [], lines = String(text).split(/\n/);
  for (var i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
    var line = lines[i], m;
    m = line.match(/\[ADD BOUNTY:\s*([^\]|]+)\|\s*([^\]|]+)\|\s*([^\]]+)\]/i);
    if (m) { A.bounties.push({ name: m[1].trim(), condition: m[2].trim(), reward: m[3].trim(), taken: false }); msgs.push("Bounty posted: " + m[1].trim()); }
    m = line.match(/\[ADD JOB:\s*([^\]|]+)\|\s*([^\]|]+)\|\s*([^\]]+)\]/i);
    if (m) { A.jobs.push({ title: m[1].trim(), pay: m[2].trim(), desc: m[3].trim() }); msgs.push("Job posted: " + m[1].trim()); }
    m = line.match(/\[ADD QUEST:\s*([^\]|]+)(?:\|\s*([^\]]+))?\]/i);
    if (m && A.quests.length < 5) { A.quests.push({ title: m[1].trim(), progress: 0, desc: (m[2] || "").trim() }); msgs.push("Quest: " + m[1].trim()); }
    m = line.match(/\[SPLICE ON:\s*([^\]]+)\]/i);
    if (m) { var n = m[1].trim(); if (A.splices.indexOf(n) < 0) A.splices.push(n); msgs.push("Splice ON: " + n); }
    m = line.match(/\[SPLICE OFF:\s*([^\]]+)\]/i);
    if (m) { var off = m[1].trim().toLowerCase(); A.splices = A.splices.filter(function (s) { return s.toLowerCase() !== off; }); msgs.push("Splice OFF"); }
    if (/\[SPLICE CLEAR\]/i.test(line)) { A.splices = []; msgs.push("Splices cleared"); }
  }
  return msgs;
}

function ahHandleSpeech(text, A) {
  var t = String(text).toLowerCase(), msgs = [], m;
  if (A.settings.bountyBoard) {
    if (/bounty board|wanted posters/.test(t)) msgs.push("Bounty Board checked");
    m = t.match(/take (?:the )?bounty on ([a-z0-9\s\-']{2,40})/);
    if (m) {
      var name = m[1].trim();
      A.bounties.push({ name: name, condition: "Either", reward: "TBD", taken: true });
      if (A.settings.quests && A.quests.length < 5) A.quests.push({ title: "Bounty: " + name, progress: 0 });
      msgs.push("Bounty taken: " + name);
    }
    m = t.match(/turn in (?:the )?bounty on ([a-z0-9\s\-']{2,40})/);
    if (m) { if (A.settings.currencyEnabled) ahLedger(A, "Bounty " + m[1].trim(), 50); msgs.push("Bounty turned in"); }
  }
  if (A.settings.jobBoard) {
    if (/job board|look for work/.test(t)) msgs.push("Job Board checked");
    if (/take (?:the )?job|accept (?:the )?job/.test(t)) msgs.push("Job accepted");
    if (/complete (?:the )?job|finish (?:the )?job/.test(t)) {
      if (A.settings.currencyEnabled) ahLedger(A, "Job pay", 25);
      msgs.push("Job completed");
    }
  }
  if (A.settings.vitals && /\b(rest|sleep|camp)\b/.test(t)) {
    A.vitals.stamina = A.vitals.maxStamina;
    A.vitals.mp = Math.min(A.vitals.maxMp, A.vitals.mp + Math.floor(A.vitals.maxMp * 0.3));
    if (A.settings.survival) A.survival.tiredness = Math.max(0, A.survival.tiredness - 40);
    ahAdvance(A, 360);
    msgs.push("Rested");
  }
  if (A.settings.fuel && /\b(refuel|fill up|recharge)\b/.test(t)) {
    A.fuel = 100; msgs.push((A.settings.fuelName || "Fuel") + " restored");
  }
  if (A.settings.currencyEnabled) {
    if (/check (my )?(balance|wallet|money)/.test(t)) msgs.push("Balance: " + (A.currencySymbol || "G") + (A.balance || 0));
    m = t.match(/(?:buy|purchase)\s+(?:a |an |the )?([a-z0-9\s\-']{2,40})(?:\s+for\s+(\d+))?/);
    if (m) {
      var price = m[2] ? parseInt(m[2], 10) : 10;
      if ((A.balance || 0) >= price) {
        ahLedger(A, "Bought " + m[1].trim(), -price);
        ahInvAdd(A, "other", m[1].trim(), 1);
        msgs.push("Bought " + m[1].trim());
      } else msgs.push("Cannot afford");
    }
  }
  if (A.settings.inventoryEnabled) {
    m = t.match(/\b(?:take|grab|pick up|loot)\s+(?:the\s+)?([a-z0-9\s\-']{2,40})/);
    if (m) { ahInvAdd(A, "other", m[1].trim(), 1); msgs.push("Took " + m[1].trim()); }
    m = t.match(/\b(?:equip|wear|put on)\s+(?:the\s+)?([a-z0-9\s\-']{2,40})/);
    if (m) {
      var item = m[1].trim();
      if (/armor|vest|mail|plate|helmet/i.test(item)) A.equipped.armor = item;
      else if (/sword|gun|rifle|pistol|bow|knife|blade|staff/i.test(item)) A.equipped.weapon = item;
      else A.equipped.clothes = item;
      msgs.push("Equipped " + item);
    }
  }
  if (A.settings.d20) {
    m = String(text).match(/roll for (attack|saving|ability check|initiative)/i);
    if (m) msgs.push("d20 " + m[1] + " → " + (Math.floor(Math.random() * 20) + 1));
  }
  return msgs;
}

function ahHandleCardCmd(text, A) {
  var m = String(text).match(/^\/card\s+(character|location|other)?\s*(.+)$/i);
  if (!m) return false;
  var type = (m[1] || "other");
  type = type.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + type.slice(1).toLowerCase();
  var rest = m[2].trim().split(/\s+/);
  if (!m[1] && rest.length && /^(character|location|other)$/i.test(rest[0])) {
    type = rest.shift();
    type = type.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + type.slice(1).toLowerCase();
  }
  var title = rest[0] || "Untitled", details = rest.slice(1).join(" "), entry = "";
  if (A.settings.innerThoughts) entry += "{title: " + title + "}\n";
  if (type === "Character") {
    entry += "Name: " + title + "\nAppearance: \nPersonality: \nBackground: \n";
    if (details) entry += "Notes: " + details + "\n";
  } else entry += "Name: " + title + "\nDescription: " + (details || "") + "\n";
  ahWrite(title, entry, AH_TYPE);
  ahMsg(A, "Card created: " + title + " (" + type + ")");
  return true;
}

function ahUpdateCards(A) {
  if (!A.presetSeeded) ahApplyPreset(A, A.settings.preset, true);
  ahWrite("Configure Aetherheart", ahBuildConfigure(A), AH_TYPE);
  ahWrite("Help", ahBuildHelp(), AH_TYPE);
  ahWrite("Keywords", ahBuildKeywords(), AH_TYPE);
  if (A.settings.timeEnabled) {
    ahWrite("Configure Time", ahBuildTime(A), AH_TYPE);
    ahWrite("Events", ahBuildEvents(A), AH_TYPE);
    ahWrite("Holidays", ahBuildHolidays(A), AH_TYPE);
  }
  if (A.settings.scheduling) ahWrite("Schedule Time Blocks", ahBuildSchedule(A), AH_TYPE);
  if (A.settings.currencyEnabled) {
    ahWrite("Prices & Goods", ahBuildGoods(A), AH_TYPE);
    ahWrite("Ledger", ahBuildLedger(A), AH_TYPE);
  }
  if (A.settings.billsEnabled) ahWrite("Bills", ahBuildBills(A), AH_TYPE);
  if (A.settings.inventoryEnabled) ahWrite("Inventory", ahBuildInventory(A), AH_TYPE);
  if (A.settings.rpSystem) {
    ahWrite("RP System", ahBuildRP(A), AH_TYPE);
    if (A.settings.vitals || A.settings.survival) ahWrite("Vitals", ahBuildVitals(A), AH_TYPE);
    if (A.settings.leveling) ahWrite("Character Sheet", ahBuildSheet(A), AH_TYPE);
  }
  if (A.settings.innerThoughts) ahWrite("Inner Thoughts", ahBuildThoughts(A), AH_TYPE);
  if (A.settings.innerOpinions) ahWrite("Inner Opinions", ahBuildOpinions(A), AH_TYPE);
  if (A.settings.bountyBoard) ahWrite("Bounty Board", ahBuildBounty(A), AH_TYPE);
  if (A.settings.jobBoard) ahWrite("Job Board", ahBuildJob(A), AH_TYPE);
  if (A.settings.quests) ahWrite("Quests", ahBuildQuests(A), AH_TYPE);
  if (A.settings.cardCreator) ahWrite("Card Creator", ahBuildCardCreator(), AH_TYPE);
  if (A.settings.narrationSystem) ahWrite("Narration", ahBuildNarration(A), AH_TYPE);
  if (A.settings.storySplice) ahWrite("Story Splice", ahBuildSplice(A), AH_TYPE);
}

function ahInject(A) {
  try {
    if (!state.memory) state.memory = {};
    var parts = [];
    if (A.settings.timeEnabled && A.time) {
      parts.push(ahMonth(A.time.month) + " " + A.time.day + ", " + A.time.year + " " + ahHour(A.time.hour));
    }
    if (A.settings.vitals && A.vitals) {
      parts.push("HP " + A.vitals.hp + "/" + A.vitals.maxHp + " MP " + A.vitals.mp + "/" + A.vitals.maxMp + " STA " + A.vitals.stamina + "/" + A.vitals.maxStamina);
    }
    if (A.settings.currencyEnabled && A.settings.currencyContext) {
      parts.push((A.currencySymbol || "G") + (A.balance || 0));
    }
    state.memory.frontMemory = parts.length ? ("[Status: " + parts.join(" | ") + "]") : "";
    var notes = [];
    if (A.settings.informationFirewall) notes.push("Characters only know in-world knowledge. No meta or script awareness.");
    if (A.settings.standardRules) notes.push("Keep pronouns consistent. Avoid purple prose and sentient glowing objects.");
    if (A.settings.narratePlayer) notes.push("Narrate NPCs only; do not write the player character's actions or dialogue.");
    if (A.settings.presentTense) notes.push("Write in present tense.");
    else notes.push("Write in past tense.");
    if (A.settings.storySplice && A.splices && A.splices.length) {
      notes.push("Narrative flavor only from: " + A.splices.join(", ") + ". Do not change plot.");
    }
    var r = String(A.settings.rating || "E").toUpperCase();
    if (r === "E") notes.push("Content rating E.");
    else if (r === "TEEN" || r === "T") notes.push("Content rating Teen.");
    else if (r === "NSFW" || r === "M") notes.push("Mature content allowed.");
    else notes.push("Unrated content.");
    state.memory.authorsNote = notes.join(" ");
  } catch (e) {}
}

function onInput_Aetherheart(text) {
  try {
    var A = ahEnsure();
    ahSync(A);
    if (!A.settings.scriptEnabled) return text;
    if (text === undefined || text === null) return "";
    var cmd = String(text).trim().toLowerCase();
    if (cmd === "/help") { state.message = ahBuildHelp(); return text; }
    if (cmd === "/keywords") { state.message = ahBuildKeywords(); return text; }
    if (cmd === "/balance") { state.message = "Balance: " + (A.currencySymbol || "G") + (A.balance || 0); return text; }
    if (cmd === "/time") {
      var t = A.time;
      state.message = ahMonth(t.month) + " " + t.day + ", Year " + t.year + " | " + ahHour(t.hour);
      return text;
    }
    if (cmd === "/inventory") { state.message = ahBuildInventory(A); return text; }
    if (cmd === "/ledger") { state.message = ahBuildLedger(A); return text; }
    if (cmd === "/ah enable") { A.settings.scriptEnabled = true; ahMsg(A, "Script ON"); return text; }
    if (cmd === "/ah disable") { A.settings.scriptEnabled = false; ahMsg(A, "Script OFF"); return text; }
    if (cmd === "/ah toggle") {
      A.settings.scriptEnabled = !A.settings.scriptEnabled;
      ahMsg(A, "Script " + (A.settings.scriptEnabled ? "ON" : "OFF"));
      return text;
    }
    if (ahHandleCardCmd(text, A)) { ahUpdateCards(A); return text; }
    var mins = ahParseMins(A);
    ahAdvance(A, mins);
    ahTickSurvival(A, mins);
    var msgs = [].concat(ahHandleAdds(text, A), ahHandleSpeech(text, A));
    for (var i = 0; i < msgs.length; i++) ahMsg(A, msgs[i]);
    ahUpdateCards(A);
  } catch (e) {
    try { state.message = "AH Input: " + (e && e.message ? e.message : String(e)); } catch (e2) {}
  }
  return text;
}

function onContext_Aetherheart(text) {
  try {
    var A = ahEnsure();
    ahSync(A);
    if (A.settings.scriptEnabled) ahInject(A);
  } catch (e) {}
  return text;
}

function onOutput_Aetherheart(text) {
  try {
    var A = ahEnsure();
    ahSync(A);
    if (!A.settings.scriptEnabled) return text;
    ahInject(A);
    ahUpdateCards(A);
    if (A.settings.vitals && A.vitals && A.vitals.hp <= 0) {
      text = "GAME OVER\nYour story has ended.\n[ Restart ] [ Load ] [ Journal ]";
    }
  } catch (e) {
    try { state.message = "AH Output: " + (e && e.message ? e.message : String(e)); } catch (e2) {}
  }
  return text;
}

function ahApplyPreset(A, preset, force) {
  var pack = ahPresetPack(preset);
  A.settings.preset = (preset || "fantasy").toLowerCase();
  if (force || !A.presetSeeded) {
    A.currencyName = pack.currencyName;
    A.currencySymbol = pack.currencySymbol;
    A.settings.fuelName = pack.fuelName;
    A.balance = pack.balance;
    if (A.time) A.time.year = pack.year;
    A.goods = pack.goods.slice();
    A.holidays = pack.holidays.slice();
    A.bills = pack.bills.slice();
    A.income = pack.income.slice();
    A.presetSeeded = true;
  }
}

function ahFind(title) {
  try {
    if (typeof storyCards === "undefined" || !storyCards) return null;
    for (var i = 0; i < storyCards.length; i++) {
      if (storyCards[i] && storyCards[i].title === title) {
        return { card: storyCards[i], index: i };
      }
    }
  } catch (e) {}
  return null;
}

function ahWrite(title, entry, type) {
  type = type || AH_TYPE;
  try {
    var found = ahFind(title);
    if (found) {
      try {
        found.card.entry = entry;
        found.card.keys = title;
        found.card.title = title;
        found.card.type = type;
      } catch (e1) {}
      try {
        if (typeof updateStoryCard === "function") {
          updateStoryCard(found.index, title, entry, type, title, "");
        }
      } catch (e2) {}
      return true;
    }
    if (typeof addStoryCard === "function") {
      try {
        addStoryCard(title, entry, type, title);
        return true;
      } catch (e3) {
        try {
          addStoryCard(title, entry, type);
          return true;
        } catch (e4) {}
      }
    }
  } catch (e) {}
  return false;
}

function ahMsg(A, msg) {
  try {
    if (!msg) return;
    if (A && A.settings && A.settings.silentMode) return;
    state.message = (state.message ? state.message + "\n" : "") + "[SYSTEM] " + msg;
  } catch (e) {}
}

function ahMonth(m) {
  var n = ["January","February","March","April","May","June","July","August","September","October","November","December"];
  return n[(m || 1) - 1] || "Unknown";
}

function ahHour(h) {
  var hr = Math.floor(h || 0);
  var ap = hr >= 12 ? "PM" : "AM";
  var d = hr % 12 === 0 ? 12 : hr % 12;
  return d + ":00 " + ap;
}

function ahOnOff(block, key) {
  if (!block) return null;
  var re = new RegExp(key.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&") + "\\s*:\\s*(ON|OFF)", "i");
  var m = block.match(re);
  if (!m) return null;
  return m[1].toUpperCase() === "ON";
}

function ahVal(block, key) {
  if (!block) return null;
  var re = new RegExp(key.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&") + "\\s*:\\s*([^\\n]+)", "i");
  var m = block.match(re);
  return m ? m[1].trim() : null;
}

function ahBuildEvents(A) {
  var lines = ["== EVENTS ==", "[ADD EVENT: Name | start | end | description]", "[DEL: Event Name]", "", "-- ACTIVE --"];
  var list = A.events || [];
  if (!list.length) lines.push("(none yet)");
  else for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) lines.push("- " + list[i]);
  return lines.join("\n");
}

function ahBuildHolidays(A) {
  var lines = ["== HOLIDAYS ==", "[ADD: Holiday Name | Month Day]", "Priority: Holiday > Day > Weekend/Weekday > Week", "", "-- LIST --"];
  var list = A.holidays || [];
  if (!list.length) lines.push("(none yet)");
  else for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) lines.push("- " + list[i]);
  return lines.join("\n");
}

function ahBuildGoods(A) {
  var lines = ["== PRICES & GOODS ==", "Currency: " + (A.currencyName || "Gold") + " (" + (A.currencySymbol || "G") + ")", "", "-- GOODS --"];
  var list = A.goods || [];
  if (!list.length) lines.push("(none — switch preset or add lines)");
  else for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) lines.push("- " + list[i]);
  lines.push("", "[Drugs from Configure also belong here]", "[Preset change reseeds this list]");
  return lines.join("\n");
}

function ahBuildBills(A) {
  var lines = ["== BILLS ==", "[ADD BILL: Name | amount | period]", "[ADD INCOME: Name | amount | period]", "", "-- BILLS --"];
  var bills = A.bills || [];
  if (!bills.length) lines.push("(none)");
  else for (var i = 0; i < bills.length; i++) lines.push("- " + bills[i]);
  lines.push("", "-- INCOME --");
  var inc = A.income || [];
  if (!inc.length) lines.push("(none)");
  else for (var j = 0; j < inc.length; j++) lines.push("- " + inc[j]);
  return lines.join("\n");
}
