  return "== SCHEDULE TIME BLOCKS ==\n" +
    "Today: " + ahMonth(t.month) + " " + t.day + ", Year " + t.year + ", " + ahHour(t.hour) + "\n\n" +
    "[ADD: blockName | Day/Weekdays/Week/Weekend/Holiday/Birthday | startTime | endTime | description]\n" +
    "repeat: ON\n[DEL: blockName]\n\n-- ALL SCHEDULED DAYS --\n[OFF] Monday\n[OFF] Weekend\n[OFF] Week\n\n[Accepts 12-hour and 24-hour time.]";
}

function ahBuildThoughts(A) {
  var lines = ["== INNER THOUGHTS ==", "[Memory notes — stable auto-card style]", "", "Tracked cards use: {title: Name}", "Memories dump into that card's Notes field.", "A few accurate sentences per person.", "", "-- TRACKED --"];
  var th = A.thoughts || {}, keys = Object.keys(th);
  if (!keys.length) lines.push("(none yet)");
  else for (var i = 0; i < keys.length && i < 12; i++) lines.push(keys[i] + ": " + th[keys[i]]);
  lines.push("", "Cooldown for note updates: 12 turns", "Detect titles from player input: ON", "Exclude ALL-CAPS titles: ON", "[Memory only. Relationships = Inner Opinions.]");
  return lines.join("\n");
}

function ahBuildOpinions(A) {
  var lines = ["== INNER OPINIONS ==", "[Relationships + social layer — not raw memory]", "", "-- TRACKED CHARACTERS (up to 5) --"];
  var op = A.opinions || {}, keys = Object.keys(op);
  if (!keys.length) lines.push("(none yet)");
  else for (var i = 0; i < keys.length && i < 5; i++) lines.push(keys[i] + " : " + op[keys[i]]);
  lines.push("", "-- OVERALL VIBE --", "tense, hopeful, suspicious, warm, cold, playful, grim", "[Edit this list.]", "", "Favors / debts / secrets / pressure update from play.", "[Living-characters social features live here.]");
  return lines.join("\n");
}

function ahBuildBounty(A) {
  var lines = ["== BOUNTY BOARD ==", "Wanted: Dead, Alive, or Either", ""];
  var list = A.bounties || [];
  if (!list.length) lines.push("(no active bounties)");
  else for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
    var b = list[i];
    lines.push((i + 1) + ". " + b.name + " — " + (b.condition || "Either") + " — " + (b.reward || "?") + (b.taken ? " [TAKEN]" : ""));
  }
  lines.push("", "[ADD BOUNTY: Name | Dead/Alive/Either | reward]", "[Speech: check the bounty board, take the bounty on X, turn in the bounty]", "[Taking a bounty can create a Quest]");
  return lines.join("\n");
}

function ahBuildJob(A) {
  var lines = ["== JOB BOARD ==", "Available work", ""];
  var list = A.jobs || [];
  if (!list.length) lines.push("(no jobs posted)");
  else for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
    var j = list[i];
    lines.push((i + 1) + ". " + j.title + " — " + (j.pay || "?") + " — " + (j.desc || ""));
  }
  lines.push("", "[ADD JOB: Title | pay | description]", "[Speech: check the job board, look for work, take the job, complete the job]");
  return lines.join("\n");
}

function ahBuildQuests(A) {
  var list = A.quests || [];
  var lines = ["== QUESTS ==", "Active: " + list.length + " / 5", ""];
  if (!list.length) lines.push("(none)");
  else for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) lines.push((i + 1) + ". " + list[i].title + " (" + (list[i].progress || 0) + "%)");
  lines.push("", "[ADD QUEST: Title | description]", "[Bounties can become quests when taken]");
  return lines.join("\n");
}

function ahBuildInventory(A) {
  function sec(title, obj) {
    var ks = Object.keys(obj || {});
    var out = title + "\n";
    if (!ks.length) return out + "(none)\n";
    for (var i = 0; i < ks.length; i++) out += ks[i] + (obj[ks[i]] > 1 ? " x" + obj[ks[i]] : "") + "\n";
    return out;
  }
  var inv = A.inventory || {}, eq = A.equipped || {};
  return "== INVENTORY ==\n" + sec("-- CLOTHES --", inv.clothes) + "\n" + sec("-- ARMOR --", inv.armor) + "\n" +
    sec("-- WEAPONS --", inv.weapons) + "\n" + sec("-- AMMO --", inv.ammo) + "\n" + sec("-- OTHER --", inv.other) + "\n" +
    "Equipped: W:" + (eq.weapon || "—") + " A:" + (eq.armor || "—") + " C:" + (eq.clothes || "—") +
    "\n\n[Speech: give, take, equip, unequip, reload, buy]\n[Armor/weapons permanent with #]";
}

function ahBuildLedger(A) {
  var lines = ["== LEDGER ==", "Balance: " + (A.currencySymbol || "G") + (A.balance || 0), ""];
  var led = A.ledger || [];
  if (!led.length) lines.push("(no transactions)");
  else {
    var start = Math.max(0, led.length - 12);
    for (var i = start; i < led.length; i++) lines.push(led[i]);
  }
  lines.push("", "[Auto-updates on pay / buy / bounty / job]");
  return lines.join("\n");
}

function ahLootName(A, base) {
  var lvl = A.level || 1;
  var adj = A.lootAdjectives || ["Worn", "Sturdy", "Fine", "Masterwork", "Legendary"];
  var idx = Math.min(adj.length - 1, Math.floor((lvl - 1) / 3));
  return adj[idx] + " " + base;
}

function ahRollWeather(A) {
  if (!A.settings.weather) return;
  var opts = ["Clear", "Cloudy", "Rain", "Storm", "Fog", "Windy"];
  var temps = ["Cold", "Cool", "Mild", "Warm", "Hot"];
  if (Math.random() < 0.15) {
    A.weather.current = opts[Math.floor(Math.random() * opts.length)];
    A.weather.temp = temps[Math.floor(Math.random() * temps.length)];
  }
}

function ahTickJail(A) {
  if (!A.settings.jail) return;
  if ((A.jailTurns || 0) > 0) {
    A.jailTurns--;
    if (A.jailTurns <= 0) ahMsg(A, "Released from jail");
  }
}

function ahTickDrugs(A) {
  if (!A.drugTimers || !A.drugTimers.length) return;
  var kept = [];
  for (var i = 0; i < A.drugTimers.length; i++) {
    var d = A.drugTimers[i];
    d.turnsLeft--;
    if (d.turnsLeft > 0) kept.push(d);
    else ahMsg(A, "Drug effect ended: " + (d.name || "unknown"));
  }
  A.drugTimers = kept;
}

// AETHERHEART — LIBRARY
// Functions only. No modifier. No top-level boot.

var AH_TYPE = "Aetherheart";

function ahEnsure() {
  if (!state.aether) {
    state.aether = {
      settings: {
        scriptEnabled: true, preset: "fantasy", rating: "E",
        inventoryEnabled: false, currencyEnabled: false, timeEnabled: false,
        billsEnabled: false, currencyContext: false, narrationSystem: false,
        silentMode: false, rpSystem: false, vitals: false, survival: false,
        leveling: false, skills: false, abilities: false, powers: false,
        loot: false, d20: false, fuel: false, fuelName: "Stamina", ammo: false,
        reputation: false, jail: false, momentum: false, deusEx: false, antiDeusEx: false,
        bountyBoard: false, jobBoard: false, quests: false,
        innerThoughts: false, innerOpinions: false, cardCreator: false,
        scheduling: false, storySplice: false, isekai: false, shift: false, sleeveJump: false,

function ahApplyPreset(A, preset, force) {
  var pack = ahPresetPack(preset);
  A.settings.preset = (preset || "fantasy").toLowerCase();
  if (force || !A.presetSeeded) {
    A.currencyName = pack.currencyName;
    A.currencySymbol = pack.currencySymbol;
    A.settings.fuelName = pack.fuelName;
    A.balance = pack.balance;
    if (A.time) A.time.year = pack.year;
    A.goods = pack.goods.slice();
    A.holidays = pack.holidays.slice();
    A.bills = pack.bills.slice();
    A.income = pack.income.slice();
    A.contraceptionTypes = {};
    var cl = pack.contraception || [];
    for (var ci = 0; ci < cl.length; ci++) {
      var parts = cl[ci].split("|");
      if (parts.length >= 3) {
        A.contraceptionTypes[parts[0].trim().toLowerCase()] = { type: parts[1].trim(), residual: parseInt(parts[2].trim(), 10) || 0 };
      }
    }
    A.presetSeeded = true;
  }
}

function ahFind(title) {
  try {
    if (typeof storyCards === "undefined" || !storyCards) return null;
    for (var i = 0; i < storyCards.length; i++) {
      if (storyCards[i] && storyCards[i].title === title) return { card: storyCards[i], index: i };
    }
  } catch (e) {}
  return null;
}

function ahWrite(title, entry, type) {
  type = type || AH_TYPE;
  try {
    var found = ahFind(title);
    if (found) {
      try {
        found.card.entry = entry;
        found.card.keys = title;
        found.card.title = title;
        found.card.type = type;
      } catch (e1) {}
      try {
        if (typeof updateStoryCard === "function") updateStoryCard(found.index, title, entry, type, title, "");
      } catch (e2) {}
      return true;
    }
    if (typeof addStoryCard === "function") {
      try { addStoryCard(title, entry, type, title); return true; }
      catch (e3) { try { addStoryCard(title, entry, type); return true; } catch (e4) {} }
    }
  } catch (e) {}
  return false;
}

function ahMsg(A, msg) {
  try {
    if (!msg) return;
    if (A && A.settings && A.settings.silentMode) return;
    state.message = (state.message ? state.message + "\n" : "") + "[SYSTEM] " + msg;
  } catch (e) {}
}

function ahMonth(m) {
  var n = ["January","February","March","April","May","June","July","August","September","October","November","December"];
  return n[(m || 1) - 1] || "Unknown";
}

function ahHour(h) {
  var hr = Math.floor(h || 0);
  var ap = hr >= 12 ? "PM" : "AM";
  var d = hr % 12 === 0 ? 12 : hr % 12;
  return d + ":00 " + ap;
}

function ahOnOff(block, key) {
  if (!block) return null;
  var re = new RegExp(key.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&") + "\\s*:\\s*(ON|OFF)", "i");
  var m = block.match(re);
  if (!m) return null;
  return m[1].toUpperCase() === "ON";
}

function ahVal(block, key) {
  if (!block) return null;
  var re = new RegExp(key.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&") + "\\s*:\\s*([^\\n]+)", "i");
  var m = block.match(re);
  return m ? m[1].trim() : null;
}

function ahBuildInventory(A) {
  function sec(title, obj) {
    var ks = Object.keys(obj || {}), out = title + "\n";
    if (!ks.length) return out + "(none)\n";

    return out;
  }
  var inv = A.inventory || {}, eq = A.equipped || {};
  return "== INVENTORY ==\n" + sec("-- CLOTHES --", inv.clothes) + "\n" + sec("-- ARMOR --", inv.armor) + "\n" + sec("-- WEAPONS --", inv.weapons) + "\n" + sec("-- AMMO --", inv.ammo) + "\n" + sec("-- OTHER --", inv.other) + "\nEquipped: W:" + (eq.weapon || "—") + " A:" + (eq.armor || "—") + " C:" + (eq.clothes || "—") + "\n\n[Speech: give, take, equip, unequip, reload, buy]\n[Armor/weapons permanent with #]";

function ahRollWeather(A) {
  if (!A.settings.weather) return;
  var opts = ["Clear", "Cloudy", "Rain", "Storm", "Fog", "Windy"];
  var temps = ["Cold", "Cool", "Mild", "Warm", "Hot"];
  if (Math.random() < 0.15) {
    A.weather.current = opts[Math.floor(Math.random() * opts.length)];
    A.weather.temp = temps[Math.floor(Math.random() * temps.length)];
  }
}

function ahTickJail(A) {
  if (!A.settings.jail) return;
  if ((A.jailTurns || 0) > 0) {
    A.jailTurns--;
    if (A.jailTurns <= 0) ahMsg(A, "Released from jail");
  }
}

function ahTickDrugs(A) {
  if (!A.drugTimers || !A.drugTimers.length) return;
  var kept = [];
  for (var i = 0; i < A.drugTimers.length; i++) {
    var d = A.drugTimers[i];
    d.turnsLeft--;
    if (d.turnsLeft > 0) kept.push(d);
    else ahMsg(A, "Drug effect ended: " + (d.name || "unknown"));
  }
  A.drugTimers = kept;
}

function ahTickWereMer(A) {
  if (!A.settings.wereMer || !A.wereMer) return;
  var w = A.wereMer;
  var hour = (A.time && A.time.hour) || 0;
  var isNight = hour >= 20 || hour < 6;
  if (w.transformTrigger === "night" && isNight && w.form === "human" && !w.daywalker) {
    w.form = "transformed";
    ahMsg(A, "Transformation triggered (night)");
  } else if (w.transformTrigger === "night" && !isNight && w.form === "transformed" && !w.daywalker) {
    w.form = "human";
    ahMsg(A, "Returned to human form (day)");
  }
}

function ahSafeEncode(obj) {
  try {
    var s = JSON.stringify(obj);
    if (typeof btoa === "function") return btoa(unescape(encodeURIComponent(s)));
    return encodeURIComponent(s);
  } catch (e) { return ""; }
}

function ahSafeDecode(str) {
  try {
    var s = str;
    if (typeof atob === "function") {
      try { s = decodeURIComponent(escape(atob(str))); }
      catch (e1) { s = decodeURIComponent(str); }
    } else s = decodeURIComponent(str);
    return JSON.parse(s);
  } catch (e) { return null; }
}

function ahDoSave(A) {
  var payload = ahSafeEncode({
    settings: A.settings, time: A.time, vitals: A.vitals, survival: A.survival, stats: A.stats,
    fuel: A.fuel, level: A.level, xp: A.xp, balance: A.balance, currencyName: A.currencyName,
    currencySymbol: A.currencySymbol, inventory: A.inventory, equipped: A.equipped,
    reputation: A.reputation, jailTurns: A.jailTurns, wereMer: A.wereMer,
    scheduleBlocks: A.scheduleBlocks, journal: A.journal, splices: A.splices, cycle: A.cycle
  });

function ahDoLoad(A, raw) {
  var data = ahSafeDecode(String(raw || "").replace(/^SAVE DATA[^\n]*\n/, "").trim());
  if (!data) { ahMsg(A, "Load failed — bad data"); return; }
  if (data.settings) A.settings = data.settings;
  if (data.time) A.time = data.time;
  if (data.vitals) A.vitals = data.vitals;
  if (data.survival) A.survival = data.survival;
  if (data.stats) A.stats = data.stats;
  if (typeof data.fuel === "number") A.fuel = data.fuel;
  if (typeof data.level === "number") A.level = data.level;
  if (typeof data.xp === "number") A.xp = data.xp;
  if (typeof data.balance === "number") A.balance = data.balance;
  if (data.currencyName) A.currencyName = data.currencyName;
  if (data.currencySymbol) A.currencySymbol = data.currencySymbol;
  if (data.inventory) A.inventory = data.inventory;
  if (data.equipped) A.equipped = data.equipped;
  if (data.reputation) A.reputation = data.reputation;
  if (typeof data.jailTurns === "number") A.jailTurns = data.jailTurns;
  if (data.wereMer) A.wereMer = data.wereMer;
  if (data.scheduleBlocks) A.scheduleBlocks = data.scheduleBlocks;
  if (data.journal) A.journal = data.journal;
  if (data.splices) A.splices = data.splices;
  if (data.cycle) A.cycle = data.cycle;
  ahMsg(A, "Load complete");
}

function ahParseScheduleAdd(line, A) {
  var m = line.match(/\[ADD:\s*([^\]|]+)\|\s*([^\]|]+)\|\s*([^\]|]+)\|\s*([^\]|]+)\|\s*([^\]]+)\]/i);
  if (!m) return null;
  var block = { name: m[1].trim(), when: m[2].trim(), start: m[3].trim(), end: m[4].trim(), desc: m[5].trim(), on: true };
  A.scheduleBlocks = A.scheduleBlocks || [];
  A.scheduleBlocks.push(block);
  var dayKey = block.when;
  if (!A.schedule[dayKey]) A.schedule[dayKey] = [];
  A.schedule[dayKey].push(block);
  var cardTitle = "Schedule: " + dayKey;
  var entry = "== " + cardTitle.toUpperCase() + " ==\n";
  for (var i = 0; i < A.schedule[dayKey].length; i++) {
    var b = A.schedule[dayKey][i];
    entry += (b.on ? "[ON] " : "[OFF] ") + b.name + " | " + b.start + " | " + b.end + " | " + b.desc + "\n";
  }
  entry += "\n[Replace ON with DEL on a line to remove that block]";
  ahWrite(cardTitle, entry, AH_TYPE);
  return "Schedule block added: " + block.name + " → " + dayKey;
}

function ahDoIsekai(A) {
  if (!A.settings.isekai) return "Isekai OFF";
  A.isekaiState = A.isekaiState || { active: false, stage: "origin", originPreset: "modern", destPreset: "fantasy" };
  if (A.isekaiState.stage === "origin") {
    A.isekaiState.stage = "crossed";
    A.isekaiState.active = true;
    ahApplyPreset(A, A.isekaiState.destPreset || "fantasy", true);
    A.journal = A.journal || [];
    A.journal.push("Crossed into another world");
    return "Isekai crossed — now in " + (A.isekaiState.destPreset || "fantasy");
  }
  return "Already crossed";
}

function ahTravel(A, from, to) {
  var key = from + "->" + to, key2 = to + "->" + from;
  var dist = (A.distances && (A.distances[key] || A.distances[key2])) || 10;
  if (A.settings.fuel) {
    var drain = Math.min(100, Math.max(1, Math.floor(dist / 5)));
    A.fuel = Math.max(0, (A.fuel || 100) - drain);
    return "Traveled " + from + " to " + to + " (" + dist + "). Fuel -" + drain + "%";
  }
  return "Traveled " + from + " to " + to + " (" + dist + ")";
}

function ahParseCardMarkers(A) {
  try {
    if (typeof storyCards === "undefined" || !storyCards) return;
    for (var i = 0; i < storyCards.length; i++) {
      var c = storyCards[i];
      if (!c || !c.entry) continue;
      var hm = c.entry.match(/\{hours:\s*([^}|]+)\|([^}]+)\}/i);
      if (hm) A.locationHours[c.title] = { open: hm[1].trim(), close: hm[2].trim() };
      var sm = c.entry.match(/\{shift:\s*([^}|]+)\|([^}|]+)\|([^}]+)\}/i);
      if (sm) A.characterShifts[c.title] = { place: sm[1].trim(), start: sm[2].trim(), end: sm[3].trim() };
      var sp = c.entry.match(/\{speech:\s*([^}]+)\}/i);
      if (sp && A.settings.speechPatterns) A.speechPattern = sp[1].trim();
    }
  } catch (e) {}
}

function ahLunarPhase(lunarDay, lunarCycle) {
  var c = lunarCycle || 28;
  var d = ((lunarDay || 1) - 1) % c;
  var q = d / c;
  if (q < 0.1 || q >= 0.95) return "menstrual";
  if (q < 0.4) return "follicular";
  if (q < 0.6) return "fertile";
  return "luteal";
}

function ahTickCycle(A) {
  if (!A.settings.cycle) return;
  var t = A.time || {}, c = A.cycle || {};
  t.lunarDay = (t.lunarDay || 1) + 1;
  if (t.lunarDay > (t.lunarCycle || 28)) t.lunarDay = 1;
  c.lunarDay = t.lunarDay;
  c.phase = ahLunarPhase(t.lunarDay, t.lunarCycle || 28);
  if (A.settings.survival && c.phase === "menstrual" && !c.pregnant) A.survival.tiredness = Math.min(100, (A.survival.tiredness || 0) + 2);
  if (c.pregnant && A.settings.pregnancy) {
    c.pregnancyDay = (c.pregnancyDay || 0) + 1;
    if (A.settings.survival) {
      A.survival.hunger = Math.min(100, (A.survival.hunger || 0) + 1);
      A.survival.tiredness = Math.min(100, (A.survival.tiredness || 0) + 1);
    }
    if (c.pregnancyDay > (c.pregnancyLength || 280) * 0.7 && A.settings.vitals) A.vitals.stamina = Math.max(0, A.vitals.stamina - 1);
    if (A.settings.miscarriage && c.pregnancyDay < 90 && Math.random() < 0.002) {
      c.pregnant = false; c.pregnancyDay = 0;
      ahMsg(A, "Pregnancy ended early");
      A.journal = A.journal || []; A.journal.push("Pregnancy ended early");
    }
    if (c.pregnancyDay >= (c.pregnancyLength || 280)) {
      c.pregnant = false; c.pregnancyDay = 0;
      ahMsg(A, "Labor — delivery due (auto). Story may still plan delivery.");
      A.journal = A.journal || []; A.journal.push("Labor began");
      A.events = A.events || []; A.events.push("Birth | " + ahMonth(t.month) + " " + t.day + " Year " + t.year);
    }
  }
  A.cycle = c; A.time = t;
}

function ahConceptionCheck(A, usedProtection) {
  if (!A.settings.conception || !A.settings.cycle) return null;
  var c = A.cycle || {};
  if (c.pregnant) return null;
  if (c.phase !== "fertile") return "Not fertile window";
  var residual = 100;
  if (usedProtection && A.contraceptionTypes) {
    var name = String(usedProtection).toLowerCase();
    if (A.contraceptionTypes[name]) residual = A.contraceptionTypes[name].residual;
    else residual = 15;
  }
  var male = (c.maleFertility != null) ? c.maleFertility : 0.15;
  var chance = (residual / 100) * male;
  if (!usedProtection) chance = 0.20 * male / 0.15;
  if (Math.random() < chance) {
    c.pregnant = true; c.pregnancyDay = 1;
    var t = A.time || {}, add = c.pregnancyLength || 280;
    var day = (t.day || 1) + add, month = t.month || 1, year = t.year || 1;
    while (day > 30) { day -= 30; month++; }
    while (month > 12) { month -= 12; year++; }
    c.dueDay = day; c.dueMonth = month; c.dueYear = year;
    A.cycle = c;
    A.events = A.events || [];
    A.events.push("Pregnancy start | " + ahMonth(t.month) + " " + t.day + " Year " + t.year + " | due " + ahMonth(month) + " " + day + " Year " + year);
    A.journal = A.journal || []; A.journal.push("Pregnancy began");
    return "Conception — pregnancy started. Due " + ahMonth(month) + " " + day + ", Year " + year;
  }
  return "No conception";
}

function ahReadConfig(A) {
  var found = ahFind("Configure Aetherheart");
  if (!found || !found.card || !found.card.entry) return;
  var e = found.card.entry;
  var prev = A.settings.preset;
  var p = ahVal(e, "Preset");
  if (p) {
    var np = p.split(/\s|\|/)[0].toLowerCase();
    if (np && np !== prev) ahApplyPreset(A, np, true);
    else A.settings.preset = np || prev;
  }
  var r = ahVal(e, "Rating");
  if (r) A.settings.rating = r.split(/\s|\|/)[0];
  var pairs = [
    ["Script", "scriptEnabled"], ["Inventory", "inventoryEnabled"], ["Currency", "currencyEnabled"],
    ["Time", "timeEnabled"], ["Bills", "billsEnabled"], ["Currency context", "currencyContext"],
    ["Narration System", "narrationSystem"], ["Silent Mode", "silentMode"], ["RP System", "rpSystem"],
    ["Inner Thoughts", "innerThoughts"], ["Inner Opinions", "innerOpinions"], ["Card Creator", "cardCreator"],
    ["Scheduling", "scheduling"], ["Bounty Board", "bountyBoard"], ["Job Board", "jobBoard"],
    ["Quests", "quests"], ["Story Splice", "storySplice"], ["Were / Mer", "wereMer"], ["Weather", "weather"],
    ["Speech Patterns", "speechPatterns"], ["Confessional", "confessional"], ["Deadpool Break", "deadpoolBreak"],
    ["Bombastic", "bombastic"], ["Isekai", "isekai"], ["Shift", "shift"], ["Sleeve Jump", "sleeveJump"],
    ["Distance Travel", "distanceTravel"], ["Cycle", "cycle"], ["Conception", "conception"],
    ["Pregnancy", "pregnancy"], ["Miscarriage", "miscarriage"]
  ];
  for (var i = 0; i < pairs.length; i++) {
    var v = ahOnOff(e, pairs[i][0]);
    if (v !== null) A.settings[pairs[i][1]] = v;
  }
  var cn = ahVal(e, "Currency name");
  if (cn) A.currencyName = cn.split(/\n/)[0].trim();
  var cs = ahVal(e, "Currency symbol");
  if (cs) A.currencySymbol = cs.split(/\n/)[0].trim();
}

function ahReadRP(A) {
  var found = ahFind("RP System");
  if (!found || !found.card || !found.card.entry) {
    if (A.settings.rpSystem) { A.settings.vitals = true; A.settings.survival = true; }
    return;
  }
  var e = found.card.entry;
  var pairs = [
    ["Vitals", "vitals"], ["Survival", "survival"], ["Leveling", "leveling"], ["Skills", "skills"],
    ["Abilities", "abilities"], ["Powers", "powers"], ["Loot", "loot"], ["Ammo", "ammo"], ["d20", "d20"],
    ["Fuel", "fuel"], ["Reputation", "reputation"], ["Jail", "jail"], ["Momentum", "momentum"],
    ["Deus Ex", "deusEx"], ["Anti-Deus Ex", "antiDeusEx"]
  ];
  for (var i = 0; i < pairs.length; i++) {
    var v = ahOnOff(e, pairs[i][0]);
    if (v !== null) A.settings[pairs[i][1]] = v;
  }
  var fn = ahVal(e, "Fuel Name");
  if (fn) A.settings.fuelName = fn.split(/\n/)[0].trim();
  var mm = ahVal(e, "Magic Mode");
  if (mm) {
    mm = mm.toLowerCase();
    if (mm.indexOf("wizard") === 0) A.settings.magicMode = "wizarding";
    else if (mm.indexOf("sorc") === 0) A.settings.magicMode = "sorcery";
  }
  if (!A.settings.leveling) {
    A.settings.skills = false; A.settings.abilities = false; A.settings.powers = false; A.settings.loot = false;
  }
}

function ahReadTime(A) {
  var found = ahFind("Configure Time");
  if (!found || !found.card || !found.card.entry) return;
  var e = found.card.entry;
  var tpt = ahVal(e, "Time/Turn");
  if (tpt) A.time.timePerTurn = tpt.split(/\s/)[0];
  var y = ahVal(e, "Year"); if (y && !isNaN(parseInt(y, 10))) A.time.year = parseInt(y, 10);
  var mo = ahVal(e, "Month"); if (mo && !isNaN(parseInt(mo, 10))) A.time.month = parseInt(mo, 10);
  var d = ahVal(e, "Day"); if (d && !isNaN(parseInt(d, 10))) A.time.day = parseInt(d, 10);
  var h = ahVal(e, "Hour"); if (h && !isNaN(parseFloat(h))) A.time.hour = parseFloat(h);
}

function ahSync(A) {
  try { ahReadConfig(A); } catch (e) {}
  try { ahReadRP(A); } catch (e) {}
  try { ahReadTime(A); } catch (e) {}
}

function ahParseMins(A) {
  var str = (A.time && A.time.timePerTurn) || "5m";
  var m = String(str).match(/^(\d+)\s*(m|min|h|hr|hrs)?/i);
  if (!m) return 5;
  var n = parseInt(m[1], 10);
  var u = (m[2] || "m").toLowerCase();
  if (u.indexOf("h") === 0) return n * 60;
  return n;
}

function ahAdvance(A, mins) {
  if (!A.settings.timeEnabled) return;
  var t = A.time;
  var total = Math.floor((t.hour || 0) * 60) + (mins || 0);
  var days = Math.floor(total / 1440);
  total = total % 1440;
  t.hour = total / 60;
  t.day = (t.day || 1) + days;
  while (t.day > 30) { t.day -= 30; t.month++; }
  while (t.month > 12) { t.month -= 12; t.year++; }
}

function ahTickSurvival(A, mins) {
  if (!A.settings.survival) return;
  var f = Math.max(1, Math.floor((mins || 5) / 5));
  A.survival.hunger = Math.min(100, (A.survival.hunger || 0) + f);
  A.survival.thirst = Math.min(100, (A.survival.thirst || 0) + f + 1);
  A.survival.tiredness = Math.min(100, (A.survival.tiredness || 0) + Math.floor(f / 2));
}

function ahInvAdd(A, cat, name, qty) {
  if (!A.inventory[cat]) A.inventory[cat] = {};
  var perm = /#/.test(name) || /\b(armor|sword|gun|rifle|blade|vest|plate)\b/i.test(name);
  var clean = String(name).replace(/#/g, "").trim();
  if (perm) A.inventory[cat][clean + " #"] = 1;
  else A.inventory[cat][clean] = (A.inventory[cat][clean] || 0) + (qty || 1);
}

function ahLedger(A, note, amount) {
  A.ledger = A.ledger || [];
  A.ledger.push((amount >= 0 ? "+" : "") + amount + "  " + note);
  if (A.ledger.length > 40) A.ledger = A.ledger.slice(-30);
  A.balance = (A.balance || 0) + amount;
}

function ahHandleAdds(text, A) {
  var msgs = [], lines = String(text).split(/\n/);
  for (var i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
    var line = lines[i], m;
    m = line.match(/\[ADD BOUNTY:\s*([^\]|]+)\|\s*([^\]|]+)\|\s*([^\]]+)\]/i);
    if (m) { A.bounties.push({ name: m[1].trim(), condition: m[2].trim(), reward: m[3].trim(), taken: false, expires: 40 }); msgs.push("Bounty posted: " + m[1].trim()); }
    m = line.match(/\[ADD JOB:\s*([^\]|]+)\|\s*([^\]|]+)\|\s*([^\]]+)\]/i);
    if (m) { A.jobs.push({ title: m[1].trim(), pay: m[2].trim(), desc: m[3].trim() }); msgs.push("Job posted: " + m[1].trim()); }
    m = line.match(/\[ADD QUEST:\s*([^\]|]+)(?:\|\s*([^\]]+))?\]/i);
    if (m) { if (ahQuestAdd(A, m[1].trim(), (m[2] || "").trim())) msgs.push("Quest: " + m[1].trim()); }
    m = line.match(/\[SPLICE ON:\s*([^\]]+)\]/i);
    if (m) { var n = m[1].trim(); if (A.splices.indexOf(n) < 0) A.splices.push(n); msgs.push("Splice ON: " + n); }
    m = line.match(/\[SPLICE OFF:\s*([^\]]+)\]/i);
    if (m) { var off = m[1].trim().toLowerCase(); A.splices = A.splices.filter(function (s) { return s.toLowerCase() !== off; }); msgs.push("Splice OFF"); }
    if (/\[SPLICE CLEAR\]/i.test(line)) { A.splices = []; msgs.push("Splices cleared"); }
    var sch = ahParseScheduleAdd(line, A); if (sch) msgs.push(sch);
    m = line.match(/\[ADD DRUG:\s*([^\]|]+)(?:\|\s*(\d+))?\]/i);
    if (m) { A.drugTimers = A.drugTimers || []; A.drugTimers.push({ name: m[1].trim(), turnsLeft: m[2] ? parseInt(m[2], 10) : 5 }); msgs.push("Drug effect started: " + m[1].trim()); }
    m = line.match(/\[LOOT:\s*([^\]]+)\]/i);
    if (m && A.settings.loot) { var item = ahLootName(A, m[1].trim()); ahInvAdd(A, "other", item, 1); msgs.push("Looted: " + item); }
    m = line.match(/\[ADD SKILL:\s*([^\]]+)\]/i);
    if (m) { A.skills = A.skills || []; A.skills.push(m[1].trim()); msgs.push("Skill: " + m[1].trim()); }
    m = line.match(/\[ADD ABILITY:\s*([^\]]+)\]/i);
    if (m) { A.abilitiesList = A.abilitiesList || []; A.abilitiesList.push(m[1].trim()); msgs.push("Ability: " + m[1].trim()); }
    m = line.match(/\[ADD POWER:\s*([^\]]+)\]/i);
    if (m) { A.powersList = A.powersList || []; A.powersList.push(m[1].trim()); msgs.push("Power: " + m[1].trim()); }
    m = line.match(/\[ADD FACTION:\s*([^\]|]+)(?:\|\s*([^\]]+))?\]/i);
    if (m) { A.factions = A.factions || {}; A.factions[m[1].trim()] = (m[2] || "Recruit").trim(); msgs.push("Faction: " + m[1].trim()); }
    m = line.match(/\[ADD ROUTE:\s*([^\]|]+)\|\s*([^\]|]+)\|\s*([^\]]+)\]/i);
    if (m) { A.distances = A.distances || {}; A.distances[m[1].trim() + "->" + m[2].trim()] = m[3].trim(); msgs.push("Route: " + m[1].trim() + " → " + m[2].trim()); }
    m = line.match(/\[ADD RACE:\s*([^\]|]+)\|\s*([^\]]+)\]/i);
    if (m) { A.raceMods = A.raceMods || {}; A.raceMods[m[1].trim()] = m[2].trim(); msgs.push("Race defined: " + m[1].trim()); }
  }
  return msgs;
}

function ahHandleSpeech(text, A) {
  var t = String(text).toLowerCase(), msgs = [], m;
  if (A.settings.bountyBoard) {
    if (/bounty board|wanted posters/.test(t)) msgs.push("Bounty Board checked");
    m = t.match(/take (?:the )?bounty on ([a-z0-9\s\-']{2,40})/);
    if (m) {
      var name = m[1].trim();
      A.bounties.push({ name: name, condition: "Either", reward: "TBD", taken: true });
      if (A.settings.quests) ahQuestAdd(A, "Bounty: " + name, "Taken from board");
      msgs.push("Bounty taken: " + name);
    }
    m = t.match(/turn in (?:the )?bounty on ([a-z0-9\s\-']{2,40})/);
    if (m) { if (A.settings.currencyEnabled) ahLedger(A, "Bounty " + m[1].trim(), 50); msgs.push("Bounty turned in"); }
  }
  if (A.settings.jobBoard) {
    if (/job board|look for work/.test(t)) msgs.push("Job Board checked");
    if (/take (?:the )?job|accept (?:the )?job/.test(t)) msgs.push("Job accepted");
    if (/complete (?:the )?job|finish (?:the )?job/.test(t)) {
      if (A.settings.currencyEnabled) ahLedger(A, "Job pay", 25);
      msgs.push("Job completed");
    }
  }
  if (A.settings.vitals && /\b(rest|sleep|camp)\b/.test(t)) {
    A.vitals.stamina = A.vitals.maxStamina;
    A.vitals.mp = Math.min(A.vitals.maxMp, A.vitals.mp + Math.floor(A.vitals.maxMp * 0.3));
    if (A.settings.survival) A.survival.tiredness = Math.max(0, A.survival.tiredness - 40);
    ahAdvance(A, 360);
    msgs.push("Rested");
  }
  if (A.settings.fuel && /\b(refuel|fill up|recharge)\b/.test(t)) { A.fuel = 100; msgs.push((A.settings.fuelName || "Fuel") + " restored"); }
  if (A.settings.currencyEnabled) {
    if (/check (my )?(balance|wallet|money)/.test(t)) msgs.push("Balance: " + (A.currencySymbol || "G") + (A.balance || 0));
    m = t.match(/(?:buy|purchase)\s+(?:a |an |the )?([a-z0-9\s\-']{2,40})(?:\s+for\s+(\d+))?/);
    if (m) {
      var price = m[2] ? parseInt(m[2], 10) : 10;
      if ((A.balance || 0) >= price) { ahLedger(A, "Bought " + m[1].trim(), -price); ahInvAdd(A, "other", m[1].trim(), 1); msgs.push("Bought " + m[1].trim()); }
      else msgs.push("Cannot afford");
    }
  }
  if (A.settings.inventoryEnabled) {
    m = t.match(/\b(?:take|grab|pick up|loot|get|collect)\s+(?:the\s+)?([a-z0-9\s\-']{2,40})/);
    if (m) { ahInvAdd(A, "other", m[1].trim(), 1); msgs.push("Took " + m[1].trim()); }
    m = t.match(/\b(?:give|hand|pass|offer)\s+(?:the\s+)?([a-z0-9\s\-']{2,40})\s+to\s+/);
    if (m) {
      var giveName = m[1].trim(), cats = ["other", "weapons", "armor", "clothes", "ammo"];
      for (var gi = 0; gi < cats.length; gi++) {
        if (A.inventory[cats[gi]] && A.inventory[cats[gi]][giveName]) {
          if (A.inventory[cats[gi]][giveName] > 1) A.inventory[cats[gi]][giveName]--;
          else delete A.inventory[cats[gi]][giveName];
          msgs.push("Gave " + giveName); break;
        }
      }
    }
    m = t.match(/\b(?:equip|wear|put on|draw|ready)\s+(?:the\s+)?([a-z0-9\s\-']{2,40})/);
    if (m) {
      var item = m[1].trim();
      if (/armor|vest|mail|plate|helmet/i.test(item)) A.equipped.armor = item;
      else if (/sword|gun|rifle|pistol|bow|knife|blade|staff|axe|spear/i.test(item)) A.equipped.weapon = item;
      else A.equipped.clothes = item;
      msgs.push("Equipped " + item);
    }
    m = t.match(/\b(?:unequip|remove|stow|sheathe)\s+(?:the\s+)?([a-z0-9\s\-']{2,40})/);
    if (m) {
      var u = m[1].trim().toLowerCase();
      if (A.equipped.weapon && A.equipped.weapon.toLowerCase().indexOf(u) >= 0) A.equipped.weapon = null;
      else if (A.equipped.armor && A.equipped.armor.toLowerCase().indexOf(u) >= 0) A.equipped.armor = null;
      else if (A.equipped.clothes && A.equipped.clothes.toLowerCase().indexOf(u) >= 0) A.equipped.clothes = null;
      msgs.push("Unequipped");
    }
    if (/\breload\b/.test(t) && A.settings.ammo) msgs.push("Reloaded");
  }
  if (A.settings.d20) {
    m = String(text).match(/roll for (attack|saving|ability check|initiative)/i);
    if (m) msgs.push("d20 " + m[1] + " → " + (Math.floor(Math.random() * 20) + 1));
  }
  if (/\b(check (the )?menu|look at (the )?menu|check prices|price list|what'?s on (the )?menu)\b/.test(t)) msgs.push("MENU — story suspend for price list at current location");
  if (A.settings.sleeveJump && /\b(sleeve jump|new sleeve|resleeve)\b/.test(t)) msgs.push(ahDoSleeve(A));
  if (A.settings.shift && /\b(shift timeline|timeline shift|shift the timeline)\b/.test(t)) msgs.push(ahDoShift(A));
  if (A.settings.isekai && /\b(isekai trigger|cross (into|to) (another|the other) world)\b/.test(t)) msgs.push(ahDoIsekai(A));
  m = t.match(/\b(?:travel|go|ride|drive|fly)(?:\s+from)?\s+([a-z0-9\s\-']{2,30})\s+to\s+([a-z0-9\s\-']{2,30})/);
  if (m && A.settings.distanceTravel) msgs.push(ahTravel(A, m[1].trim(), m[2].trim()));
  if (A.settings.momentum) {
    if (/\b(strike|attack|hit|slash|shoot)\b/.test(t)) {
      A.momentum = Math.min(10, (A.momentum || 0) + 1);
      msgs.push("Momentum " + A.momentum);
      if (A.settings.leveling) {
        A.xp = (A.xp || 0) + 10;
        if (A.xp >= (A.xpToNext || 1000)) {
          A.level = (A.level || 1) + 1; A.xp = 0;
          A.xpToNext = Math.floor((A.xpToNext || 1000) * 1.25);
          A.vitals.maxHp += 5; A.vitals.hp = A.vitals.maxHp;
          msgs.push("LEVEL UP → " + A.level);
        }
      }
    }
    if (/\b(miss|fumble|stumble)\b/.test(t)) { A.momentum = Math.max(0, (A.momentum || 0) - 1); msgs.push("Momentum " + A.momentum); }
    if (/\b(recover|catch breath|regroup)\b/.test(t)) { A.momentum = Math.max(0, (A.momentum || 0) - 2); msgs.push("Momentum " + A.momentum); }
  }
  if (A.settings.deusEx && /\b(deus ex|god mode|fix it)\b/.test(t)) {
    A.vitals.hp = A.vitals.maxHp; A.vitals.mp = A.vitals.maxMp; A.vitals.stamina = A.vitals.maxStamina;
    msgs.push("Deus Ex — restored");
  }
  if (A.settings.antiDeusEx && /\b(deus ex|god mode|fix it)\b/.test(t)) msgs.push("Anti-Deus Ex — no free fixes");
  if (A.settings.reputation) {
    if (/\b(help|save|donate|protect)\b/.test(t)) { A.reputation.social = (A.reputation.social || 0) + 1; A.reputation.law = (A.reputation.law || 0) + 1; }
    if (/\b(steal|murder|assault|rob)\b/.test(t)) { A.reputation.bounty = (A.reputation.bounty || 0) + 2; A.reputation.law = (A.reputation.law || 0) - 2; }
    if (A.settings.jail && (A.reputation.bounty || 0) >= 10 && (A.jailTurns || 0) <= 0) {
      A.jailTurns = 5; A.reputation.bounty = Math.max(0, A.reputation.bounty - 5); msgs.push("Arrested — jail 5 turns");
    }
  }
  if (A.settings.wereMer && A.wereMer && /\b(feed|drink blood|hunt prey)\b/.test(t)) {
    var fr = A.wereMer.feedRestores || "hp";
    if (fr === "hp" || fr === "all") A.vitals.hp = Math.min(A.vitals.maxHp, A.vitals.hp + 20);
    if (fr === "mp" || fr === "all") A.vitals.mp = Math.min(A.vitals.maxMp, A.vitals.mp + 15);
    if (fr === "stamina" || fr === "all") A.vitals.stamina = Math.min(A.vitals.maxStamina, A.vitals.stamina + 20);
    msgs.push("Fed — restored " + fr);
  }
  if (A.settings.conception && A.settings.cycle && /\b(have sex|sleep with|make love|conceive)\b/.test(t)) {
    var protection = null, ctKeys = Object.keys(A.contraceptionTypes || {});
    for (var ci = 0; ci < ctKeys.length; ci++) { if (t.indexOf(ctKeys[ci]) >= 0) { protection = ctKeys[ci]; break; } }
    if (!protection && A.cycle && A.cycle.lastContraception) protection = A.cycle.lastContraception;
    var result = ahConceptionCheck(A, protection);
    if (result) msgs.push(result);
  }
  if (A.settings.conception) {
    var ck = Object.keys(A.contraceptionTypes || {});
    for (var cj = 0; cj < ck.length; cj++) {
      if (new RegExp("\\b(use|take|drink)\\b.*\\b" + ck[cj].replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&") + "\\b").test(t)) {
        A.cycle = A.cycle || {}; A.cycle.lastContraception = ck[cj]; msgs.push("Contraception used: " + ck[cj]); break;
      }
    }
  }
  return msgs;
}

function ahHandleCardCmd(text, A) {
  var m = String(text).match(/^\/card\s+(character|location|other)?\s*(.+)$/i);
  if (!m) return false;
  var type = (m[1] || "other");
  type = type.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + type.slice(1).toLowerCase();
  var rest = m[2].trim().split(/\s+/);
  if (!m[1] && rest.length && /^(character|location|other)$/i.test(rest[0])) {
    type = rest.shift(); type = type.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + type.slice(1).toLowerCase();
  }
  var title = rest[0] || "Untitled", details = rest.slice(1).join(" "), entry = "";
  if (A.settings.innerThoughts) entry += "{title: " + title + "}\n";
  if (type === "Character") {
    entry += "Name: " + title + "\nAppearance: height, weight, hair, build, distinguishing features\nPersonality: ten short adjectives\nBackground: \n";
    if (details) entry += "Notes: " + details + "\n";
  } else entry += "Name: " + title + "\nDescription: " + (details || "") + "\n";
  ahWrite(title, entry, AH_TYPE);
  ahMsg(A, "Card created: " + title + " (" + type + ")");
  return true;
}

function ahUpdateCards(A) {
  if (!A.presetSeeded) ahApplyPreset(A, A.settings.preset, true);
  ahWrite("Configure Aetherheart", ahBuildConfigure(A), AH_TYPE);
  ahWrite("Help", ahBuildHelp(), AH_TYPE);
  ahWrite("Keywords", ahBuildKeywords(), AH_TYPE);
  if (A.settings.timeEnabled) {
    ahWrite("Configure Time", ahBuildTime(A), AH_TYPE);
    ahWrite("Events", ahBuildEvents(A), AH_TYPE);
    ahWrite("Holidays", ahBuildHolidays(A), AH_TYPE);
  }
  if (A.settings.scheduling) ahWrite("Schedule Time Blocks", ahBuildSchedule(A), AH_TYPE);
  if (A.settings.currencyEnabled) { ahWrite("Prices & Goods", ahBuildGoods(A), AH_TYPE); ahWrite("Ledger", ahBuildLedger(A), AH_TYPE); }
  if (A.settings.billsEnabled) ahWrite("Bills", ahBuildBills(A), AH_TYPE);
  if (A.settings.inventoryEnabled) ahWrite("Inventory", ahBuildInventory(A), AH_TYPE);
  if (A.settings.rpSystem) {
    ahWrite("RP System", ahBuildRP(A), AH_TYPE);
    if (A.settings.vitals || A.settings.survival) ahWrite("Vitals", ahBuildVitals(A), AH_TYPE);
    if (A.settings.leveling) ahWrite("Character Sheet", ahBuildSheet(A), AH_TYPE);
  }
  if (A.settings.innerThoughts) ahWrite("Inner Thoughts", ahBuildThoughts(A), AH_TYPE);
  if (A.settings.innerOpinions) ahWrite("Inner Opinions", ahBuildOpinions(A), AH_TYPE);
  if (A.settings.bountyBoard) ahWrite("Bounty Board", ahBuildBounty(A), AH_TYPE);
  if (A.settings.jobBoard) ahWrite("Job Board", ahBuildJob(A), AH_TYPE);
  if (A.settings.quests) ahWrite("Quests", ahBuildQuests(A), AH_TYPE);
  if (A.settings.cardCreator) ahWrite("Card Creator", ahBuildCardCreator(), AH_TYPE);
  if (A.settings.narrationSystem) ahWrite("Narration", ahBuildNarration(A), AH_TYPE);
  if (A.settings.storySplice) ahWrite("Story Splice", ahBuildSplice(A), AH_TYPE);
  if (A.settings.wereMer) ahWrite("Were / Mer", ahBuildWereMer(A), AH_TYPE);
  if (A.settings.reputation || A.settings.jail) ahWrite("Reputation", ahBuildReputation(A), AH_TYPE);
  if (A.settings.timeEnabled && A.settings.weather !== false) ahWrite("Weather", ahBuildWeather(A), AH_TYPE);
  if (A.settings.leveling && (A.settings.skills || A.settings.abilities || A.settings.powers)) ahWrite("Skills Abilities Powers", ahBuildSkills(A), AH_TYPE);
  if (A.settings.reputation) ahWrite("Factions", ahBuildFactions(A), AH_TYPE);
  if (A.settings.isekai || A.settings.shift || A.settings.sleeveJump) ahWrite("Jumps", ahBuildJumps(A), AH_TYPE);
  if (A.settings.distanceTravel) ahWrite("Distances", ahBuildDistances(A), AH_TYPE);
  if (A.settings.momentum) ahWrite("Momentum", ahBuildMomentum(A), AH_TYPE);
  if (A.settings.cycle || A.settings.conception || A.settings.pregnancy) ahWrite("Cycle / Pregnancy", ahBuildCycle(A), AH_TYPE);
  if (A.settings.rpSystem) ahWrite("Race Stats", ahBuildRaceStats(A), AH_TYPE);
  if (A.settings.standardRules) ahWrite("Preset Rules", ahBuildRules(A), AH_TYPE);
  if (A.settings.speechPatterns) ahWrite("Speech Patterns", ahBuildSpeechList(), AH_TYPE);
  if (A.settings.scriptEnabled) {
    var apiCard = ahFind("Data Source");
    if (!apiCard) ahWrite("Data Source", ahBuildApiStub(), AH_TYPE);
  }
}

function ahInject(A) {
  try {
    if (!state.memory) state.memory = {};
    var parts = [];
    if (A.settings.timeEnabled && A.time) parts.push(ahMonth(A.time.month) + " " + A.time.day + ", " + A.time.year + " " + ahHour(A.time.hour));
    if (A.settings.weather !== false && A.weather) parts.push(A.weather.current + ", " + A.weather.temp);
    if (A.settings.vitals && A.vitals) parts.push("HP " + A.vitals.hp + "/" + A.vitals.maxHp + " MP " + A.vitals.mp + "/" + A.vitals.maxMp + " STA " + A.vitals.stamina + "/" + A.vitals.maxStamina);
    if (A.settings.currencyEnabled && A.settings.currencyContext) parts.push((A.currencySymbol || "G") + (A.balance || 0));
    if (A.settings.wereMer && A.wereMer) parts.push("Form: " + (A.wereMer.form || "human"));

    if (A.settings.speechPatterns && A.speechPattern) notes.push("Active speech pattern: " + A.speechPattern + ". Apply to matching characters only.");

    if (A.settings.deadpoolBreak) notes.push("Player-only fourth-wall breaks allowed rarely and randomized.");
    if (A.settings.bombastic) notes.push("Bombastic declarative style allowed for matching characters: short sharp lines, optional pose beats.");

function onInput_Aetherheart(text) {
  try {
    var A = ahEnsure();
    ahSync(A);
    try { ahParseCardMarkers(A); } catch (e0) {}
    if (!A.settings.scriptEnabled) return text;
    if (text === undefined || text === null) return "";
    var cmd = String(text).trim().toLowerCase();
    if (cmd === "/help") { state.message = ahBuildHelp(); return text; }
    if (cmd === "/keywords") { state.message = ahBuildKeywords(); return text; }
    if (cmd === "/balance") { state.message = "Balance: " + (A.currencySymbol || "G") + (A.balance || 0); return text; }
    if (cmd === "/time") { var t = A.time; state.message = ahMonth(t.month) + " " + t.day + ", Year " + t.year + " | " + ahHour(t.hour); return text; }
    if (cmd === "/inventory") { state.message = ahBuildInventory(A); return text; }
    if (cmd === "/ledger") { state.message = ahBuildLedger(A); return text; }
    if (cmd === "/stats") { state.message = ahBuildSheet(A) + "\n\n" + (A.settings.vitals ? ahBuildVitals(A) : ""); return text; }
    if (cmd === "/ah enable") { A.settings.scriptEnabled = true; ahMsg(A, "Script ON"); return text; }
    if (cmd === "/ah disable") { A.settings.scriptEnabled = false; ahMsg(A, "Script OFF"); return text; }
    if (cmd === "/ah toggle") { A.settings.scriptEnabled = !A.settings.scriptEnabled; ahMsg(A, "Script " + (A.settings.scriptEnabled ? "ON" : "OFF")); return text; }
    if (cmd === "/quest yes" || cmd === "/quest no") {
      if (cmd === "/quest yes" && A.pendingQuestUpdate) {
        var pq = A.pendingQuestUpdate;
        for (var qi = 0; qi < (A.quests || []).length; qi++) {
          if (A.quests[qi].title === pq.title) { A.quests[qi].progress = pq.progress; ahMsg(A, "Quest updated: " + pq.title + " → " + pq.progress + "%"); break; }
        }
        A.pendingQuestUpdate = null;
      } else if (cmd === "/quest no") { A.pendingQuestUpdate = null; ahMsg(A, "Quest update rejected"); }
      ahUpdateCards(A); return text;
    }
    if (cmd === "/save") { ahDoSave(A); ahUpdateCards(A); return text; }
    if (cmd.indexOf("/load") === 0) {
      var foundSave = ahFind("Aetherheart Save");
      if (foundSave && foundSave.card && foundSave.card.entry) ahDoLoad(A, foundSave.card.entry);
      else ahMsg(A, "No Aetherheart Save card found");
      ahUpdateCards(A); return text;
    }
    if (ahHandleCardCmd(text, A)) { ahUpdateCards(A); return text; }
    var mins = ahParseMins(A), prevDay = A.time.day;
    ahAdvance(A, mins); ahTickSurvival(A, mins); ahTickDrugs(A); ahTickJail(A); ahTickWereMer(A);
    if (A.time.day !== prevDay) { ahRollWeather(A); ahTickCycle(A); }
    var msgs = [].concat(ahHandleAdds(text, A), ahHandleSpeech(text, A));
    for (var i = 0; i < msgs.length; i++) ahMsg(A, msgs[i]);
    if (A.settings.innerThoughts && msgs.length) {
      A.journal = A.journal || [];
      for (var j = 0; j < msgs.length; j++) {
        if (/bounty|quest|bought|looted|rested|transformation|conception|pregnancy/i.test(msgs[j])) {
          A.journal.push(msgs[j]);
          if (A.journal.length > 30) A.journal = A.journal.slice(-25);
        }
      }
    }
    ahUpdateCards(A);
  } catch (e) {
    try { state.message = "AH Input: " + (e && e.message ? e.message : String(e)); } catch (e2) {}
  }
  return text;
}

    }
  } catch (e) {
    try { state.message = "AH Output: " + (e && e.message ? e.message : String(e)); } catch (e2) {}
  }
  return text;
}

function ahApplyPreset(A, preset, force) {
  var pack = ahPresetPack(preset);
  A.settings.preset = (preset || "fantasy").toLowerCase();
  if (force || !A.presetSeeded) {
    A.currencyName = pack.currencyName;
    A.currencySymbol = pack.currencySymbol;
    A.settings.fuelName = pack.fuelName;
    A.balance = pack.balance;
    if (A.time) A.time.year = pack.year;
    A.goods = pack.goods.slice();
    A.holidays = pack.holidays.slice();
    A.bills = pack.bills.slice();
    A.income = pack.income.slice();
    A.contraceptionTypes = {};
    var cl = pack.contraception || [];
    for (var ci = 0; ci < cl.length; ci++) {
      var parts = cl[ci].split("|");
      if (parts.length >= 3) {
        A.contraceptionTypes[parts[0].trim().toLowerCase()] = { type: parts[1].trim(), residual: parseInt(parts[2].trim(), 10) || 0 };
      }
    }
    A.presetSeeded = true;
  }
}

function ahFind(title) {
  try {
    if (typeof storyCards === "undefined" || !storyCards) return null;
    for (var i = 0; i < storyCards.length; i++) {
      if (storyCards[i] && storyCards[i].title === title) return { card: storyCards[i], index: i };
    }
  } catch (e) {}
  return null;
}

function ahWrite(title, entry, type) {
  type = type || AH_TYPE;
  try {
    var found = ahFind(title);
    if (found) {
      try { found.card.entry = entry; found.card.keys = title; found.card.title = title; found.card.type = type; } catch (e1) {}
      try { if (typeof updateStoryCard === "function") updateStoryCard(found.index, title, entry, type, title, ""); } catch (e2) {}
      return true;
    }
    if (typeof addStoryCard === "function") {
      try { addStoryCard(title, entry, type, title); return true; }
      catch (e3) { try { addStoryCard(title, entry, type); return true; } catch (e4) {} }
    }
  } catch (e) {}
  return false;
}

function ahMsg(A, msg) {
  try {
    if (!msg) return;
    if (A && A.settings && A.settings.silentMode) return;
    state.message = (state.message ? state.message + "\n" : "") + "[SYSTEM] " + msg;
  } catch (e) {}
}

function ahMonth(m) {
  var n = ["January","February","March","April","May","June","July","August","September","October","November","December"];
  return n[(m || 1) - 1] || "Unknown";
}

function ahHour(h) {
  var hr = Math.floor(h || 0);
  var ap = hr >= 12 ? "PM" : "AM";
  var d = hr % 12 === 0 ? 12 : hr % 12;
  return d + ":00 " + ap;
}

function ahOnOff(block, key) {
  if (!block) return null;
  var re = new RegExp(key.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&") + "\\s*:\\s*(ON|OFF)", "i");
  var m = block.match(re);
  if (!m) return null;
  return m[1].toUpperCase() === "ON";
}

function ahVal(block, key) {
  if (!block) return null;
  var re = new RegExp(key.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&") + "\\s*:\\s*([^\\n]+)", "i");
  var m = block.match(re);
  return m ? m[1].trim() : null;
}

function ahRollWeather(A) {
  if (!A.settings.weather) return;
  var opts = ["Clear", "Cloudy", "Rain", "Storm", "Fog", "Windy"], temps = ["Cold", "Cool", "Mild", "Warm", "Hot"];
  if (Math.random() < 0.15) {
    A.weather.current = opts[Math.floor(Math.random() * opts.length)];
    A.weather.temp = temps[Math.floor(Math.random() * temps.length)];
  }
}

function ahTickJail(A) {
  if (!A.settings.jail) return;
  if ((A.jailTurns || 0) > 0) { A.jailTurns--; if (A.jailTurns <= 0) ahMsg(A, "Released from jail"); }
}

function ahTickDrugs(A) {
  if (!A.drugTimers || !A.drugTimers.length) return;
  var kept = [];
  for (var i = 0; i < A.drugTimers.length; i++) {
    var d = A.drugTimers[i]; d.turnsLeft--;
    if (d.turnsLeft > 0) kept.push(d); else ahMsg(A, "Drug effect ended: " + (d.name || "unknown"));
  }
  A.drugTimers = kept;
}

function ahTickWereMer(A) {
  if (!A.settings.wereMer || !A.wereMer) return;
  var w = A.wereMer;
  var hour = (A.time && A.time.hour) || 0;
  var isNight = hour >= 20 || hour < 6;
  if (w.transformTrigger === "night" && isNight && w.form === "human" && !w.daywalker) {
    w.form = "transformed"; ahMsg(A, "Transformation triggered (night)");
  } else if (w.transformTrigger === "night" && !isNight && w.form === "transformed" && !w.daywalker) {
    w.form = "human"; ahMsg(A, "Returned to human form (day)");
  }
}

function ahSafeEncode(obj) {
  try {
    var s = JSON.stringify(obj);
    if (typeof btoa === "function") return btoa(unescape(encodeURIComponent(s)));
    return encodeURIComponent(s);
  } catch (e) { return ""; }
}

function ahSafeDecode(str) {
  try {
    var s = str;
    if (typeof atob === "function") {
      try { s = decodeURIComponent(escape(atob(str))); } catch (e1) { s = decodeURIComponent(str); }
    } else s = decodeURIComponent(str);
    return JSON.parse(s);
  } catch (e) { return null; }
}

function ahDoSave(A) {
  var payload = ahSafeEncode({
    settings: A.settings, time: A.time, vitals: A.vitals, survival: A.survival, stats: A.stats,
    fuel: A.fuel, level: A.level, xp: A.xp, balance: A.balance, currencyName: A.currencyName,
    currencySymbol: A.currencySymbol, inventory: A.inventory, equipped: A.equipped,
    reputation: A.reputation, jailTurns: A.jailTurns, wereMer: A.wereMer,
    scheduleBlocks: A.scheduleBlocks, journal: A.journal, splices: A.splices, cycle: A.cycle,
    learningLog: A.learningLog, craftingLog: A.craftingLog
  });
  ahWrite("Aetherheart Save", "SAVE DATA (copy this whole entry to load elsewhere):\n" + payload, AH_TYPE);
  ahMsg(A, "Saved to story card: Aetherheart Save");
}

function ahDoLoad(A, raw) {
  var data = ahSafeDecode(String(raw || "").replace(/^SAVE DATA[^\n]*\n/, "").trim());
  if (!data) { ahMsg(A, "Load failed — bad data"); return; }
  if (data.settings) A.settings = data.settings;
  if (data.time) A.time = data.time;
  if (data.vitals) A.vitals = data.vitals;
  if (data.survival) A.survival = data.survival;
  if (data.stats) A.stats = data.stats;
  if (typeof data.fuel === "number") A.fuel = data.fuel;
  if (typeof data.level === "number") A.level = data.level;
  if (typeof data.xp === "number") A.xp = data.xp;
  if (typeof data.balance === "number") A.balance = data.balance;
  if (data.currencyName) A.currencyName = data.currencyName;
  if (data.currencySymbol) A.currencySymbol = data.currencySymbol;
  if (data.inventory) A.inventory = data.inventory;
  if (data.equipped) A.equipped = data.equipped;
  if (data.reputation) A.reputation = data.reputation;
  if (typeof data.jailTurns === "number") A.jailTurns = data.jailTurns;
  if (data.wereMer) A.wereMer = data.wereMer;
  if (data.scheduleBlocks) A.scheduleBlocks = data.scheduleBlocks;
  if (data.journal) A.journal = data.journal;
  if (data.splices) A.splices = data.splices;
  if (data.cycle) A.cycle = data.cycle;
  if (data.learningLog) A.learningLog = data.learningLog;
  if (data.craftingLog) A.craftingLog = data.craftingLog;
  ahMsg(A, "Load complete");
}

function ahParseScheduleAdd(line, A) {
  var m = line.match(/\[ADD:\s*([^\]|]+)\|\s*([^\]|]+)\|\s*([^\]|]+)\|\s*([^\]|]+)\|\s*([^\]]+)\]/i);
  if (!m) return null;
  var block = { name: m[1].trim(), when: m[2].trim(), start: m[3].trim(), end: m[4].trim(), desc: m[5].trim(), on: true };
  A.scheduleBlocks = A.scheduleBlocks || [];
  A.scheduleBlocks.push(block);
  var dayKey = block.when;
  if (!A.schedule[dayKey]) A.schedule[dayKey] = [];
  A.schedule[dayKey].push(block);
  var cardTitle = "Schedule: " + dayKey;
  var entry = "== " + cardTitle.toUpperCase() + " ==\n";
  for (var i = 0; i < A.schedule[dayKey].length; i++) {
    var b = A.schedule[dayKey][i];
    entry += (b.on ? "[ON] " : "[OFF] ") + b.name + " | " + b.start + " | " + b.end + " | " + b.desc + "\n";
  }
  entry += "\n[Replace ON with DEL on a line to remove that block]";
  ahWrite(cardTitle, entry, AH_TYPE);
  return "Schedule block added: " + block.name + " → " + dayKey;
}

function ahCollectUserRules() {
  var out = [];
  try {
    if (typeof storyCards === "undefined" || !storyCards) return out;
    for (var i = 0; i < storyCards.length; i++) {
      var c = storyCards[i];
      if (c && c.title && /^AH Rules/i.test(c.title) && c.entry) out.push(String(c.entry).replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim());
    }
  } catch (e) {}
  return out;
}

function ahDoSleeve(A) {
  if (!A.settings.sleeveJump) return "Sleeve jump OFF";
  A.sleeve = A.sleeve || { jumps: 0 };
  A.sleeve.jumps++;
  A.stats.STR = 8 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 8);
  A.stats.DEX = 8 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 8);
  A.stats.CON = 8 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 8);
  A.vitals.hp = A.vitals.maxHp; A.vitals.stamina = A.vitals.maxStamina;
  return "Sleeve jump #" + A.sleeve.jumps + " — new body, mind kept";
}

function ahDoIsekai(A) {
  if (!A.settings.isekai) return "Isekai OFF";
  A.isekaiState = A.isekaiState || { active: false, stage: "origin", originPreset: "modern", destPreset: "fantasy" };
  if (A.isekaiState.stage === "origin") {
    A.isekaiState.stage = "crossed"; A.isekaiState.active = true;
    ahApplyPreset(A, A.isekaiState.destPreset || "fantasy", true);
    A.journal = A.journal || []; A.journal.push("Crossed into another world");
    return "Isekai crossed — now in " + (A.isekaiState.destPreset || "fantasy");
  }
  return "Already crossed";
}

function ahTravel(A, from, to) {
  var key = from + "->" + to, key2 = to + "->" + from;
  var dist = (A.distances && (A.distances[key] || A.distances[key2])) || 10;
  if (A.settings.fuel) {
    var drain = Math.min(100, Math.max(1, Math.floor(dist / 5)));
    A.fuel = Math.max(0, (A.fuel || 100) - drain);
    return "Traveled " + from + " to " + to + " (" + dist + "). Fuel -" + drain + "%";
  }
  return "Traveled " + from + " to " + to + " (" + dist + ")";
}

function ahParseCardMarkers(A) {
  try {
    if (typeof storyCards === "undefined" || !storyCards) return;
    for (var i = 0; i < storyCards.length; i++) {
      var c = storyCards[i];
      if (!c || !c.entry) continue;
      var hm = c.entry.match(/\{hours:\s*([^}|]+)\|([^}]+)\}/i);
      if (hm) A.locationHours[c.title] = { open: hm[1].trim(), close: hm[2].trim() };
      var sm = c.entry.match(/\{shift:\s*([^}|]+)\|([^}|]+)\|([^}]+)\}/i);
      if (sm) A.characterShifts[c.title] = { place: sm[1].trim(), start: sm[2].trim(), end: sm[3].trim() };
      var sp = c.entry.match(/\{speech:\s*([^}]+)\}/i);
      if (sp && A.settings.speechPatterns) A.speechPattern = sp[1].trim();
    }
  } catch (e) {}
}

function ahLunarPhase(lunarDay, lunarCycle) {
  var c = lunarCycle || 28, d = ((lunarDay || 1) - 1) % c, q = d / c;
  if (q < 0.1 || q >= 0.95) return "menstrual";
  if (q < 0.4) return "follicular";
  if (q < 0.6) return "fertile";
  return "luteal";
}

function ahBuildCycle(A) {
  var c = A.cycle || {}, t = A.time || {};
  var lines = ["== CYCLE / PREGNANCY ==", "Cycle: " + (A.settings.cycle ? "ON" : "OFF"), "Conception: " + (A.settings.conception ? "ON" : "OFF"), "Pregnancy: " + (A.settings.pregnancy ? "ON" : "OFF"), "Miscarriage chance: " + (A.settings.miscarriage ? "ON" : "OFF") + " (default OFF — lean safe)", "", "Lunar Day: " + (t.lunarDay || c.lunarDay || 1) + " / " + (t.lunarCycle || 28), "Phase: " + (c.phase || "follicular"), "Pregnancy Length (days): " + (c.pregnancyLength || 280), "Pregnant: " + (c.pregnant ? "YES day " + (c.pregnancyDay || 0) : "no")];
  if (c.pregnant) lines.push("Due: " + ahMonth(c.dueMonth) + " " + c.dueDay + ", Year " + c.dueYear);
  lines.push("", "-- CONTRACEPTION (preset names) --");
  var ct = A.contraceptionTypes || {}, keys = Object.keys(ct);
  if (!keys.length) lines.push("(none — switch preset or add)");
  else for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) lines.push(keys[i] + " | " + ct[keys[i]].type + " | residual " + ct[keys[i]].residual + "%");
  lines.push("", "[Player = full system. NPCs = lightweight only.]");
  return lines.join("\n");
}

function ahTickCycle(A) {
  if (!A.settings.cycle) return;
  var t = A.time || {}, c = A.cycle || {};
  t.lunarDay = (t.lunarDay || 1) + 1;
  if (t.lunarDay > (t.lunarCycle || 28)) t.lunarDay = 1;
  c.lunarDay = t.lunarDay;
  c.phase = ahLunarPhase(t.lunarDay, t.lunarCycle || 28);
  if (A.settings.survival && c.phase === "menstrual" && !c.pregnant) A.survival.tiredness = Math.min(100, (A.survival.tiredness || 0) + 2);
  if (c.pregnant && A.settings.pregnancy) {
    c.pregnancyDay = (c.pregnancyDay || 0) + 1;
    if (A.settings.survival) {
      A.survival.hunger = Math.min(100, (A.survival.hunger || 0) + 1);
      A.survival.tiredness = Math.min(100, (A.survival.tiredness || 0) + 1);
    }
    if (c.pregnancyDay > (c.pregnancyLength || 280) * 0.7 && A.settings.vitals) A.vitals.stamina = Math.max(0, A.vitals.stamina - 1);
    if (A.settings.miscarriage && c.pregnancyDay < 90 && Math.random() < 0.002) {
      c.pregnant = false; c.pregnancyDay = 0;
      ahMsg(A, "Pregnancy ended early");
      A.journal = A.journal || []; A.journal.push("Pregnancy ended early");
    }
    if (c.pregnancyDay >= (c.pregnancyLength || 280)) {
      c.pregnant = false; c.pregnancyDay = 0;
      ahMsg(A, "Labor — delivery due (auto). Story may still plan delivery.");
      A.journal = A.journal || []; A.journal.push("Labor began");
      A.events = A.events || []; A.events.push("Birth | " + ahMonth(t.month) + " " + t.day + " Year " + t.year);
    }
  }
  A.cycle = c; A.time = t;
}

function ahConceptionCheck(A, usedProtection) {
  if (!A.settings.conception || !A.settings.cycle) return null;
  var c = A.cycle || {};
  if (c.pregnant) return null;
  if (c.phase !== "fertile") return "Not fertile window";
  var residual = 100;
  if (usedProtection && A.contraceptionTypes) {
    var name = String(usedProtection).toLowerCase();
    if (A.contraceptionTypes[name]) residual = A.contraceptionTypes[name].residual;
    else residual = 15;
  }
  var male = (c.maleFertility != null) ? c.maleFertility : 0.15;
  var chance = (residual / 100) * male;
  if (!usedProtection) chance = 0.20 * male / 0.15;
  if (Math.random() < chance) {
    c.pregnant = true; c.pregnancyDay = 1;
    var t = A.time || {}, add = c.pregnancyLength || 280;
    var day = (t.day || 1) + add, month = t.month || 1, year = t.year || 1;
    while (day > 30) { day -= 30; month++; }
    while (month > 12) { month -= 12; year++; }
    c.dueDay = day; c.dueMonth = month; c.dueYear = year;
    A.cycle = c;
    A.events = A.events || [];
    A.events.push("Pregnancy start | " + ahMonth(t.month) + " " + t.day + " Year " + t.year + " | due " + ahMonth(month) + " " + day + " Year " + year);
    A.journal = A.journal || []; A.journal.push("Pregnancy began");
    return "Conception — pregnancy started. Due " + ahMonth(month) + " " + day + ", Year " + year;
  }
  return "No conception";
}

  ahMsg(A, "NEW QUEST: " + title);
  return true;
}

function ahReadConfig(A) {
  var found = ahFind("Configure Aetherheart");
  if (!found || !found.card || !found.card.entry) return;
  var e = found.card.entry;
  var prev = A.settings.preset;
  var p = ahVal(e, "Preset");
  if (p) {
    var np = p.split(/\s|\|/)[0].toLowerCase();
    if (np && np !== prev) ahApplyPreset(A, np, true);
    else A.settings.preset = np || prev;
  }
  var r = ahVal(e, "Rating");
  if (r) A.settings.rating = r.split(/\s|\|/)[0];
  var pairs = [
    ["Script", "scriptEnabled"], ["Inventory", "inventoryEnabled"], ["Currency", "currencyEnabled"],
    ["Time", "timeEnabled"], ["Bills", "billsEnabled"], ["Currency context", "currencyContext"],
    ["Narration System", "narrationSystem"], ["Silent Mode", "silentMode"], ["RP System", "rpSystem"],
    ["Inner Thoughts", "innerThoughts"], ["Inner Opinions", "innerOpinions"], ["Card Creator", "cardCreator"],
    ["Scheduling", "scheduling"], ["Bounty Board", "bountyBoard"], ["Job Board", "jobBoard"],
    ["Quests", "quests"], ["Story Splice", "storySplice"], ["Were / Mer", "wereMer"], ["Weather", "weather"],
    ["Speech Patterns", "speechPatterns"], ["Confessional", "confessional"], ["Deadpool Break", "deadpoolBreak"],
    ["Bombastic", "bombastic"], ["Isekai", "isekai"], ["Shift", "shift"], ["Sleeve Jump", "sleeveJump"],
    ["Distance Travel", "distanceTravel"], ["Cycle", "cycle"], ["Conception", "conception"],
    ["Pregnancy", "pregnancy"], ["Miscarriage", "miscarriage"], ["Learning", "learning"],
    ["Crafting", "crafting"], ["Lore Books", "loreBooks"], ["Pacing", "pacing"],
    ["Auto-Cards Mode", "autoCardsMode"], ["Character Continuity", "characterContinuity"],
    ["Narrative Governor", "narrativeGovernor"], ["Multiplayer", "multiplayer"], ["Metric Units", "metricUnits"]
  ];
  for (var i = 0; i < pairs.length; i++) {
    var v = ahOnOff(e, pairs[i][0]);
    if (v !== null) A.settings[pairs[i][1]] = v;
  }
  var cn = ahVal(e, "Currency name"); if (cn) A.currencyName = cn.split(/\n/)[0].trim();
  var cs = ahVal(e, "Currency symbol"); if (cs) A.currencySymbol = cs.split(/\n/)[0].trim();
  var dn = ahVal(e, "Drug name"), dc = ahVal(e, "Drug consumables"), de = ahVal(e, "Drug effects");
  if (dn && A.goods) {
    var drugLine = dn.trim() + " (" + (dc || "consumable") + ") | effects: " + (de || "");
    var has = false;
    for (var gi = 0; gi < A.goods.length; gi++) {
      if (A.goods[gi].toLowerCase().indexOf(dn.trim().toLowerCase()) === 0) { has = true; break; }
    }
    if (!has) A.goods.push(drugLine);
  }
}

function ahReadRP(A) {
  var found = ahFind("RP System");
  if (!found || !found.card || !found.card.entry) {
    if (A.settings.rpSystem) { A.settings.vitals = true; A.settings.survival = true; }
    return;
  }
  var e = found.card.entry;
  var pairs = [
    ["Vitals", "vitals"], ["Survival", "survival"], ["Leveling", "leveling"], ["Skills", "skills"],
    ["Abilities", "abilities"], ["Powers", "powers"], ["Loot", "loot"], ["Ammo", "ammo"], ["d20", "d20"],
    ["Fuel", "fuel"], ["Reputation", "reputation"], ["Jail", "jail"], ["Momentum", "momentum"],
    ["Deus Ex", "deusEx"], ["Anti-Deus Ex", "antiDeusEx"]
  ];
  for (var i = 0; i < pairs.length; i++) {
    var v = ahOnOff(e, pairs[i][0]);
    if (v !== null) A.settings[pairs[i][1]] = v;
  }
  var fn = ahVal(e, "Fuel Name"); if (fn) A.settings.fuelName = fn.split(/\n/)[0].trim();
  var mm = ahVal(e, "Magic Mode");
  if (mm) {
    mm = mm.toLowerCase();
    if (mm.indexOf("wizard") === 0) A.settings.magicMode = "wizarding";
    else if (mm.indexOf("sorc") === 0) A.settings.magicMode = "sorcery";
  }
  if (!A.settings.leveling) {
    A.settings.skills = false; A.settings.abilities = false; A.settings.powers = false; A.settings.loot = false;
  }
}

function ahReadTime(A) {
  var found = ahFind("Configure Time");
  if (!found || !found.card || !found.card.entry) return;
  var e = found.card.entry;
  var tpt = ahVal(e, "Time/Turn"); if (tpt) A.time.timePerTurn = tpt.split(/\s/)[0];
  var y = ahVal(e, "Year"); if (y && !isNaN(parseInt(y, 10))) A.time.year = parseInt(y, 10);
  var mo = ahVal(e, "Month"); if (mo && !isNaN(parseInt(mo, 10))) A.time.month = parseInt(mo, 10);
  var d = ahVal(e, "Day"); if (d && !isNaN(parseInt(d, 10))) A.time.day = parseInt(d, 10);
  var h = ahVal(e, "Hour"); if (h && !isNaN(parseFloat(h))) A.time.hour = parseFloat(h);
}
