function ahParseMins(A) {
  var str = (A.time && A.time.timePerTurn) || "5m";
  var m = String(str).match(/^(\d+)\s*(m|min|h|hr|hrs)?/i);
  if (!m) return 5;
  var n = parseInt(m[1], 10), u = (m[2] || "m").toLowerCase();
  if (u.indexOf("h") === 0) return n * 60;
  return n;
}

function ahAdvance(A, mins) {
  if (!A.settings.timeEnabled) return;
  var t = A.time;
  var total = Math.floor((t.hour || 0) * 60) + (mins || 0);
  var days = Math.floor(total / 1440);
  total = total % 1440;
  t.hour = total / 60;
  t.day = (t.day || 1) + days;
  while (t.day > 30) { t.day -= 30; t.month++; }
  while (t.month > 12) { t.month -= 12; t.year++; }
}

function ahTickSurvival(A, mins) {
  if (!A.settings.survival) return;
  var f = Math.max(1, Math.floor((mins || 5) / 5));
  A.survival.hunger = Math.min(100, (A.survival.hunger || 0) + f);
  A.survival.thirst = Math.min(100, (A.survival.thirst || 0) + f + 1);
  A.survival.tiredness = Math.min(100, (A.survival.tiredness || 0) + Math.floor(f / 2));
}

function ahInvAdd(A, cat, name, qty) {
  if (!A.inventory[cat]) A.inventory[cat] = {};
  var perm = /#/.test(name) || /\b(armor|sword|gun|rifle|blade|vest|plate)\b/i.test(name);
  var clean = String(name).replace(/#/g, "").trim();
  if (perm) A.inventory[cat][clean + " #"] = 1;
  else A.inventory[cat][clean] = (A.inventory[cat][clean] || 0) + (qty || 1);
}

function ahLedger(A, note, amount) {
  A.ledger = A.ledger || [];
  A.ledger.push((amount >= 0 ? "+" : "") + amount + "  " + note);
  if (A.ledger.length > 40) A.ledger = A.ledger.slice(-30);
  A.balance = (A.balance || 0) + amount;
}

function ahHandleAdds(text, A) {
  var msgs = [], lines = String(text).split(/\n/);
  for (var i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
    var line = lines[i], m;
    m = line.match(/\[ADD BOUNTY:\s*([^\]|]+)\|\s*([^\]|]+)\|\s*([^\]]+)\]/i);
    if (m) { A.bounties.push({ name: m[1].trim(), condition: m[2].trim(), reward: m[3].trim(), taken: false, expires: 40 }); msgs.push("Bounty posted: " + m[1].trim()); }
    m = line.match(/\[ADD JOB:\s*([^\]|]+)\|\s*([^\]|]+)\|\s*([^\]]+)\]/i);
    if (m) { A.jobs.push({ title: m[1].trim(), pay: m[2].trim(), desc: m[3].trim() }); msgs.push("Job posted: " + m[1].trim()); }
    m = line.match(/\[ADD QUEST:\s*([^\]|]+)(?:\|\s*([^\]]+))?\]/i);
    if (m) { if (ahQuestAdd(A, m[1].trim(), (m[2] || "").trim())) msgs.push("Quest: " + m[1].trim()); }
    m = line.match(/\[SPLICE ON:\s*([^\]]+)\]/i);
    if (m) { var n = m[1].trim(); if (A.splices.indexOf(n) < 0) A.splices.push(n); msgs.push("Splice ON: " + n); }
    m = line.match(/\[SPLICE OFF:\s*([^\]]+)\]/i);
    if (m) { var off = m[1].trim().toLowerCase(); A.splices = A.splices.filter(function (s) { return s.toLowerCase() !== off; }); msgs.push("Splice OFF"); }
    if (/\[SPLICE CLEAR\]/i.test(line)) { A.splices = []; msgs.push("Splices cleared"); }
    var sch = ahParseScheduleAdd(line, A); if (sch) msgs.push(sch);
    m = line.match(/\[ADD DRUG:\s*([^\]|]+)(?:\|\s*(\d+))?\]/i);
    if (m) { A.drugTimers = A.drugTimers || []; A.drugTimers.push({ name: m[1].trim(), turnsLeft: m[2] ? parseInt(m[2], 10) : 5 }); msgs.push("Drug effect started: " + m[1].trim()); }
    m = line.match(/\[LOOT:\s*([^\]]+)\]/i);
    if (m && A.settings.loot) { var item = ahLootName(A, m[1].trim()); ahInvAdd(A, "other", item, 1); msgs.push("Looted: " + item); }
    m = line.match(/\[ADD SKILL:\s*([^\]]+)\]/i);
    if (m) { A.skills = A.skills || []; A.skills.push(m[1].trim()); msgs.push("Skill: " + m[1].trim()); }
    m = line.match(/\[ADD ABILITY:\s*([^\]]+)\]/i);
    if (m) { A.abilitiesList = A.abilitiesList || []; A.abilitiesList.push(m[1].trim()); msgs.push("Ability: " + m[1].trim()); }
    m = line.match(/\[ADD POWER:\s*([^\]]+)\]/i);
    if (m) { A.powersList = A.powersList || []; A.powersList.push(m[1].trim()); msgs.push("Power: " + m[1].trim()); }
    m = line.match(/\[ADD FACTION:\s*([^\]|]+)(?:\|\s*([^\]]+))?\]/i);
    if (m) { A.factions = A.factions || {}; A.factions[m[1].trim()] = (m[2] || "Recruit").trim(); msgs.push("Faction: " + m[1].trim()); }
    m = line.match(/\[ADD ROUTE:\s*([^\]|]+)\|\s*([^\]|]+)\|\s*([^\]]+)\]/i);
    if (m) { A.distances = A.distances || {}; A.distances[m[1].trim() + "->" + m[2].trim()] = m[3].trim(); msgs.push("Route added"); }
    m = line.match(/\[ADD RACE:\s*([^\]|]+)\|\s*([^\]]+)\]/i);
    if (m) { A.raceMods = A.raceMods || {}; A.raceMods[m[1].trim()] = m[2].trim(); msgs.push("Race: " + m[1].trim()); }
  }
  return msgs;
}

function ahHandleSpeech(text, A) {
  var t = String(text).toLowerCase(), msgs = [], m;
  if (A.settings.bountyBoard) {
    if (/bounty board|wanted posters/.test(t)) msgs.push("Bounty Board checked");
    m = t.match(/take (?:the )?bounty on ([a-z0-9\s\-']{2,40})/);
    if (m) {
      var name = m[1].trim();
      A.bounties.push({ name: name, condition: "Either", reward: "TBD", taken: true });
      if (A.settings.quests) ahQuestAdd(A, "Bounty: " + name, "Taken from board");
      msgs.push("Bounty taken: " + name);
    }
    m = t.match(/turn in (?:the )?bounty on ([a-z0-9\s\-']{2,40})/);
    if (m) { if (A.settings.currencyEnabled) ahLedger(A, "Bounty " + m[1].trim(), 50); msgs.push("Bounty turned in"); }
  }
  if (A.settings.jobBoard) {
    if (/job board|look for work/.test(t)) msgs.push("Job Board checked");
    if (/take (?:the )?job|accept (?:the )?job/.test(t)) msgs.push("Job accepted");
    if (/complete (?:the )?job|finish (?:the )?job/.test(t)) {
      if (A.settings.currencyEnabled) ahLedger(A, "Job pay", 25);
      msgs.push("Job completed");
    }
  }
  if (A.settings.vitals && /\b(rest|sleep|camp)\b/.test(t)) {
    A.vitals.stamina = A.vitals.maxStamina;
    A.vitals.mp = Math.min(A.vitals.maxMp, A.vitals.mp + Math.floor(A.vitals.maxMp * 0.3));
    if (A.settings.survival) A.survival.tiredness = Math.max(0, A.survival.tiredness - 40);
    ahAdvance(A, 360); msgs.push("Rested");
  }
  if (A.settings.fuel && /\b(refuel|fill up|recharge)\b/.test(t)) { A.fuel = 100; msgs.push((A.settings.fuelName || "Fuel") + " restored"); }
  if (A.settings.currencyEnabled) {
    if (/check (my )?(balance|wallet|money)/.test(t)) msgs.push("Balance: " + (A.currencySymbol || "G") + (A.balance || 0));
    m = t.match(/(?:buy|purchase)\s+(?:a |an |the )?([a-z0-9\s\-']{2,40})(?:\s+for\s+(\d+))?/);
    if (m) {
      var price = m[2] ? parseInt(m[2], 10) : 10;
      if ((A.balance || 0) >= price) { ahLedger(A, "Bought " + m[1].trim(), -price); ahInvAdd(A, "other", m[1].trim(), 1); msgs.push("Bought " + m[1].trim()); }
      else msgs.push("Cannot afford");
    }
  }
  if (A.settings.inventoryEnabled) {
    m = t.match(/\b(?:take|grab|pick up|loot|get|collect)\s+(?:the\s+)?([a-z0-9\s\-']{2,40})/);
    if (m) { ahInvAdd(A, "other", m[1].trim(), 1); msgs.push("Took " + m[1].trim()); }
    m = t.match(/\b(?:give|hand|pass|offer)\s+(?:the\s+)?([a-z0-9\s\-']{2,40})\s+to\s+/);
    if (m) {
      var giveName = m[1].trim(), cats = ["other", "weapons", "armor", "clothes", "ammo"];
      for (var gi = 0; gi < cats.length; gi++) {
        if (A.inventory[cats[gi]] && A.inventory[cats[gi]][giveName]) {
          if (A.inventory[cats[gi]][giveName] > 1) A.inventory[cats[gi]][giveName]--; else delete A.inventory[cats[gi]][giveName];
          msgs.push("Gave " + giveName); break;
        }
      }
    }
    m = t.match(/\b(?:equip|wear|put on|draw|ready)\s+(?:the\s+)?([a-z0-9\s\-']{2,40})/);
    if (m) {
      var item = m[1].trim();
      if (/armor|vest|mail|plate|helmet/i.test(item)) A.equipped.armor = item;
      else if (/sword|gun|rifle|pistol|bow|knife|blade|staff|axe|spear/i.test(item)) A.equipped.weapon = item;
      else A.equipped.clothes = item;
      msgs.push("Equipped " + item);
    }
    if (/\breload\b/.test(t) && A.settings.ammo) msgs.push("Reloaded");
  }
  if (A.settings.d20) {
    m = String(text).match(/roll for (attack|saving|ability check|initiative)/i);
    if (m) msgs.push("d20 " + m[1] + " → " + (Math.floor(Math.random() * 20) + 1));
  }
  if (/\b(check (the )?menu|look at (the )?menu|check prices|price list)\b/.test(t)) msgs.push("MENU — price list at current location");
  if (A.settings.sleeveJump && /\b(sleeve jump|new sleeve|resleeve)\b/.test(t)) msgs.push(ahDoSleeve(A));
  if (A.settings.shift && /\b(shift timeline|timeline shift)\b/.test(t)) msgs.push(ahDoShift(A));
  if (A.settings.isekai && /\b(isekai trigger|cross (into|to) (another|the other) world)\b/.test(t)) msgs.push(ahDoIsekai(A));
  m = t.match(/\b(?:travel|go|ride|drive|fly)(?:\s+from)?\s+([a-z0-9\s\-']{2,30})\s+to\s+([a-z0-9\s\-']{2,30})/);
  if (m && A.settings.distanceTravel) msgs.push(ahTravel(A, m[1].trim(), m[2].trim()));
  if (A.settings.momentum) {
    if (/\b(strike|attack|hit|slash|shoot)\b/.test(t)) {
      A.momentum = Math.min(10, (A.momentum || 0) + 1); msgs.push("Momentum " + A.momentum);
      if (A.settings.leveling) {
        A.xp = (A.xp || 0) + 10;
        if (A.xp >= (A.xpToNext || 1000)) {
          A.level = (A.level || 1) + 1; A.xp = 0;
          A.xpToNext = Math.floor((A.xpToNext || 1000) * 1.25);
          A.vitals.maxHp += 5; A.vitals.hp = A.vitals.maxHp;
          msgs.push("LEVEL UP → " + A.level);
        }
      }
    }
    if (/\b(miss|fumble|stumble)\b/.test(t)) { A.momentum = Math.max(0, (A.momentum || 0) - 1); msgs.push("Momentum " + A.momentum); }
  }
  if (A.settings.deusEx && /\b(deus ex|god mode|fix it)\b/.test(t)) {
    A.vitals.hp = A.vitals.maxHp; A.vitals.mp = A.vitals.maxMp; A.vitals.stamina = A.vitals.maxStamina;
    msgs.push("Deus Ex — restored");
  }
  if (A.settings.antiDeusEx && /\b(deus ex|god mode|fix it)\b/.test(t)) msgs.push("Anti-Deus Ex — no free fixes");
  if (A.settings.reputation) {
    if (/\b(help|save|donate|protect)\b/.test(t)) { A.reputation.social = (A.reputation.social || 0) + 1; A.reputation.law = (A.reputation.law || 0) + 1; }
    if (/\b(steal|murder|assault|rob)\b/.test(t)) { A.reputation.bounty = (A.reputation.bounty || 0) + 2; A.reputation.law = (A.reputation.law || 0) - 2; }
    if (A.settings.jail && (A.reputation.bounty || 0) >= 10 && (A.jailTurns || 0) <= 0) {
      A.jailTurns = 5; A.reputation.bounty = Math.max(0, A.reputation.bounty - 5); msgs.push("Arrested — jail 5 turns");
    }
  }
  if (A.settings.wereMer && A.wereMer && /\b(feed|drink blood|hunt prey)\b/.test(t)) {
    var fr = A.wereMer.feedRestores || "hp";
    if (fr === "hp" || fr === "all") A.vitals.hp = Math.min(A.vitals.maxHp, A.vitals.hp + 20);
    if (fr === "mp" || fr === "all") A.vitals.mp = Math.min(A.vitals.maxMp, A.vitals.mp + 15);
    if (fr === "stamina" || fr === "all") A.vitals.stamina = Math.min(A.vitals.maxStamina, A.vitals.stamina + 20);
    msgs.push("Fed — restored " + fr);
  }
  if (A.settings.conception && A.settings.cycle && /\b(have sex|sleep with|make love|conceive)\b/.test(t)) {
    var protection = null, ctKeys = Object.keys(A.contraceptionTypes || {});
    for (var ci = 0; ci < ctKeys.length; ci++) { if (t.indexOf(ctKeys[ci]) >= 0) { protection = ctKeys[ci]; break; } }
    if (!protection && A.cycle && A.cycle.lastContraception) protection = A.cycle.lastContraception;
    var result = ahConceptionCheck(A, protection);
    if (result) msgs.push(result);
  }
  if (A.settings.conception) {
    var ck = Object.keys(A.contraceptionTypes || {});
    for (var cj = 0; cj < ck.length; cj++) {
      if (new RegExp("\\b(use|take|drink)\\b.*\\b" + ck[cj].replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&") + "\\b").test(t)) {
        A.cycle = A.cycle || {}; A.cycle.lastContraception = ck[cj]; msgs.push("Contraception used: " + ck[cj]); break;
      }
    }
  }
  if (A.settings.learning) {
    m = t.match(/\b(?:study|train|learn|practice)\s+(?:the\s+)?([a-z0-9\s\-']{2,40})/);
    if (m) msgs.push(ahDoLearn(A, m[1].trim()));
    if (/\bread (?:a |the )?(?:book|tome|manual|scroll)\b/.test(t)) {
      msgs.push(ahDoLearn(A, "from book"));
      if (A.settings.loreBooks) { var lb = ahDoLoreBook(A); if (lb) msgs.push(lb); }
    }
  }
  if (A.settings.crafting) {
    m = t.match(/\b(?:craft|forge|brew|smith|sew|cook)\s+(?:a |an |the )?([a-z0-9\s\-']{2,40})/);
    if (m) msgs.push(ahDoCraft(A, m[1].trim()));
    m = t.match(/\benchant\s+(?:the\s+)?([a-z0-9\s\-']{2,40})/);
    if (m && (A.settings.powers || A.settings.magicMode === "sorcery")) {
      ahInvAdd(A, "other", "Enchanted " + m[1].trim(), 1); msgs.push("Enchanted: " + m[1].trim());
    }
  }
  if (A.settings.loreBooks && /\b(search (the )?body|loot (the )?corpse|rifle through)\b/.test(t)) {
    if (Math.random() < 0.35) { var letter = ahDoLoreBook(A); if (letter) msgs.push(letter); }
  }
  return msgs;
}

function ahHandleCardCmd(text, A) {
  var m = String(text).match(/^\/card\s+(character|location|other)?\s*(.+)$/i);
  if (!m) return false;
  var type = (m[1] || "other");
  type = type.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + type.slice(1).toLowerCase();
  var rest = m[2].trim().split(/\s+/);
  if (!m[1] && rest.length && /^(character|location|other)$/i.test(rest[0])) {
    type = rest.shift(); type = type.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + type.slice(1).toLowerCase();
  }
  var title = rest[0] || "Untitled", details = rest.slice(1).join(" "), entry = "";
  if (A.settings.innerThoughts) entry += "{title: " + title + "}\n";
  if (type === "Character") {
    entry += "Name: " + title + "\nAppearance: height, weight, hair, build, distinguishing features\nPersonality: ten short adjectives\nBackground: \n";
    if (details) entry += "Notes: " + details + "\n";
  } else entry += "Name: " + title + "\nDescription: " + (details || "") + "\n";
  ahWrite(title, entry, AH_TYPE);
  ahMsg(A, "Card created: " + title + " (" + type + ")");
  return true;
}

function ahUpdateCards(A) {
  if (!A.presetSeeded) ahApplyPreset(A, A.settings.preset, true);
  ahWrite("Configure Aetherheart", ahBuildConfigure(A), AH_TYPE);
  ahWrite("Help", ahBuildHelp(), AH_TYPE);
  ahWrite("Keywords", ahBuildKeywords(), AH_TYPE);
  if (A.settings.timeEnabled) {
    ahWrite("Configure Time", ahBuildTime(A), AH_TYPE);
    ahWrite("Events", ahBuildEvents(A), AH_TYPE);
    ahWrite("Holidays", ahBuildHolidays(A), AH_TYPE);
  }
  if (A.settings.scheduling) ahWrite("Schedule Time Blocks", ahBuildSchedule(A), AH_TYPE);
  if (A.settings.currencyEnabled) { ahWrite("Prices & Goods", ahBuildGoods(A), AH_TYPE); ahWrite("Ledger", ahBuildLedger(A), AH_TYPE); }
  if (A.settings.billsEnabled) ahWrite("Bills", ahBuildBills(A), AH_TYPE);
  if (A.settings.inventoryEnabled) ahWrite("Inventory", ahBuildInventory(A), AH_TYPE);
  if (A.settings.rpSystem) {
    ahWrite("RP System", ahBuildRP(A), AH_TYPE);
    if (A.settings.vitals || A.settings.survival) ahWrite("Vitals", ahBuildVitals(A), AH_TYPE);
    if (A.settings.leveling) ahWrite("Character Sheet", ahBuildSheet(A), AH_TYPE);
  }
  if (A.settings.innerThoughts) { ahWrite("Inner Thoughts", ahBuildThoughts(A), AH_TYPE); ahWrite("Journal", ahBuildJournal(A), AH_TYPE); }
  if (A.settings.innerOpinions) ahWrite("Inner Opinions", ahBuildOpinions(A), AH_TYPE);
  if (A.settings.bountyBoard) ahWrite("Bounty Board", ahBuildBounty(A), AH_TYPE);
  if (A.settings.jobBoard) ahWrite("Job Board", ahBuildJob(A), AH_TYPE);
  if (A.settings.quests) ahWrite("Quests", ahBuildQuests(A), AH_TYPE);
  if (A.settings.cardCreator) ahWrite("Card Creator", ahBuildCardCreator(), AH_TYPE);
  if (A.settings.narrationSystem) ahWrite("Narration", ahBuildNarration(A), AH_TYPE);
  if (A.settings.storySplice) ahWrite("Story Splice", ahBuildSplice(A), AH_TYPE);
  if (A.settings.wereMer) ahWrite("Were / Mer", ahBuildWereMer(A), AH_TYPE);
  if (A.settings.reputation || A.settings.jail) ahWrite("Reputation", ahBuildReputation(A), AH_TYPE);
  if (A.settings.timeEnabled && A.settings.weather !== false) ahWrite("Weather", ahBuildWeather(A), AH_TYPE);
  if (A.settings.leveling && (A.settings.skills || A.settings.abilities || A.settings.powers)) ahWrite("Skills Abilities Powers", ahBuildSkills(A), AH_TYPE);
  if (A.settings.reputation) ahWrite("Factions", ahBuildFactions(A), AH_TYPE);
  if (A.settings.isekai || A.settings.shift || A.settings.sleeveJump) ahWrite("Jumps", ahBuildJumps(A), AH_TYPE);
  if (A.settings.distanceTravel) ahWrite("Distances", ahBuildDistances(A), AH_TYPE);
  if (A.settings.momentum) ahWrite("Momentum", ahBuildMomentum(A), AH_TYPE);
  if (A.settings.cycle || A.settings.conception || A.settings.pregnancy) ahWrite("Cycle / Pregnancy", ahBuildCycle(A), AH_TYPE);
  if (A.settings.rpSystem) ahWrite("Race Stats", ahBuildRaceStats(A), AH_TYPE);
  if (A.settings.standardRules) ahWrite("Preset Rules", ahBuildRules(A), AH_TYPE);
  if (A.settings.speechPatterns) ahWrite("Speech Patterns", ahBuildSpeechList(), AH_TYPE);
  if (A.settings.learning || A.settings.crafting || A.settings.loreBooks) ahWrite("Learning / Crafting", ahBuildLearning(A), AH_TYPE);
  if (A.settings.characterContinuity !== false) ahWrite("Character Continuity", ahBuildContinuity(A), AH_TYPE);
  if (A.settings.scriptEnabled) {
    var apiCard = ahFind("Data Source");
    if (!apiCard) ahWrite("Data Source", ahBuildApiStub(), AH_TYPE);
  }
}

function ahInject(A) {
  try {
    if (!state.memory) state.memory = {};
    var parts = [];
    if (A.settings.timeEnabled && A.time) parts.push(ahMonth(A.time.month) + " " + A.time.day + ", " + A.time.year + " " + ahHour(A.time.hour));
    if (A.settings.weather !== false && A.weather) parts.push(A.weather.current + ", " + A.weather.temp);
    if (A.settings.vitals && A.vitals) parts.push("HP " + A.vitals.hp + "/" + A.vitals.maxHp + " MP " + A.vitals.mp + "/" + A.vitals.maxMp + " STA " + A.vitals.stamina + "/" + A.vitals.maxStamina);
    if (A.settings.currencyEnabled && A.settings.currencyContext) parts.push((A.currencySymbol || "G") + (A.balance || 0));
    if (A.settings.wereMer && A.wereMer) parts.push("Form: " + (A.wereMer.form || "human"));
    if (A.settings.jail && (A.jailTurns || 0) > 0) parts.push("Jail: " + A.jailTurns + " turns");
    if (A.settings.cycle && A.cycle) parts.push("Phase: " + (A.cycle.phase || "?") + (A.cycle.pregnant ? " | Pregnant day " + A.cycle.pregnancyDay : ""));
    state.memory.frontMemory = parts.length ? ("[Status: " + parts.join(" | ") + "]") : "";
    var notes = [];
    if (A.settings.informationFirewall) notes.push("Characters only know in-world knowledge. No meta or script awareness.");
    if (A.settings.standardRules || A.settings.narrativeGovernor !== false) notes.push("Keep pronouns consistent. Avoid purple prose and sentient glowing objects. Limit psychic aftershocks. No ellipsis spam.");
    if (A.settings.pacing) {
      var pm = A.settings.pacingMode || "normal";
      if (pm === "dynamic") notes.push("Pacing: dynamic — faster in action, slower in quiet scenes.");
      else if (pm === "fast") notes.push("Pacing: tight, action-forward.");
      else if (pm === "slow") notes.push("Pacing: slow, room to breathe.");
    }
    if (A.settings.characterContinuity !== false) notes.push("Keep established appearance, pronouns, and continuity facts stable.");
    if (A.settings.multiplayer) notes.push("Multiplayer: all player characters present; sheets apply to all players.");
    if (A.settings.narratePlayer) notes.push("Narrate NPCs only; do not write the player character's actions or dialogue.");
    if (A.settings.presentTense) notes.push("Write in present tense."); else notes.push("Write in past tense.");
    if (A.settings.storySplice && A.splices && A.splices.length) notes.push("Narrative flavor only from: " + A.splices.join(", ") + ". Do not change plot.");
    if (A.settings.speechPatterns && A.speechPattern) notes.push("Active speech pattern: " + A.speechPattern + ".");
    if (A.settings.confessional) notes.push("Confessional cutaway allowed under high tension or comedy.");
    if (A.settings.deadpoolBreak) notes.push("Player-only fourth-wall breaks allowed rarely.");
    if (A.settings.bombastic) notes.push("Bombastic declarative style allowed for matching characters.");
    if (A.settings.wereMer && A.wereMer && A.wereMer.form === "transformed") notes.push("Character is currently transformed (" + (A.wereMer.type || "were") + ").");
    if (A.settings.scheduling && A.scheduleBlocks && A.scheduleBlocks.length) notes.push("Respect active schedule blocks strictly.");
    var r = String(A.settings.rating || "E").toUpperCase();
    if (r === "E") notes.push("Content rating E.");
    else if (r === "TEEN" || r === "T") notes.push("Content rating Teen.");
    else if (r === "NSFW" || r === "M") notes.push("Mature content allowed.");
    else notes.push("Unrated content.");
    var userRules = ahCollectUserRules();
    for (var ur = 0; ur < userRules.length && ur < 6; ur++) notes.push(userRules[ur]);
    state.memory.authorsNote = notes.join(" ");
  } catch (e) {}
}

function onInput_Aetherheart(text) {
  try {
    var A = ahEnsure();
    ahSync(A);
    try { ahParseCardMarkers(A); } catch (e0) {}
    if (!A.settings.scriptEnabled) return text;
    if (text === undefined || text === null) return "";
    var cmd = String(text).trim().toLowerCase();
    if (cmd === "/help") { state.message = ahBuildHelp(); return text; }
    if (cmd === "/keywords") { state.message = ahBuildKeywords(); return text; }
    if (cmd === "/balance") { state.message = "Balance: " + (A.currencySymbol || "G") + (A.balance || 0); return text; }
    if (cmd === "/time") { var t = A.time; state.message = ahMonth(t.month) + " " + t.day + ", Year " + t.year + " | " + ahHour(t.hour); return text; }
    if (cmd === "/inventory") { state.message = ahBuildInventory(A); return text; }
    if (cmd === "/ledger") { state.message = ahBuildLedger(A); return text; }
    if (cmd === "/stats") { state.message = ahBuildSheet(A) + "\n\n" + (A.settings.vitals ? ahBuildVitals(A) : ""); return text; }
    if (cmd === "/ah enable") { A.settings.scriptEnabled = true; ahMsg(A, "Script ON"); return text; }
    if (cmd === "/ah disable") { A.settings.scriptEnabled = false; ahMsg(A, "Script OFF"); return text; }
    if (cmd === "/ah toggle") { A.settings.scriptEnabled = !A.settings.scriptEnabled; ahMsg(A, "Script " + (A.settings.scriptEnabled ? "ON" : "OFF")); return text; }
    if (cmd === "/quest yes" || cmd === "/quest no") {
      if (cmd === "/quest yes" && A.pendingQuestUpdate) {
        var pq = A.pendingQuestUpdate;
        for (var qi = 0; qi < (A.quests || []).length; qi++) {
          if (A.quests[qi].title === pq.title) { A.quests[qi].progress = pq.progress; ahMsg(A, "Quest updated: " + pq.title + " → " + pq.progress + "%"); break; }
        }
        A.pendingQuestUpdate = null;
      } else if (cmd === "/quest no") { A.pendingQuestUpdate = null; ahMsg(A, "Quest update rejected"); }
      ahUpdateCards(A); return text;
    }
    if (cmd === "/reset memory") { ahMemoryReset(A); ahUpdateCards(A); return text; }
    if (cmd === "/reset") { ahFullSoftReset(A); ahUpdateCards(ahEnsure()); return text; }
    if (cmd === "/jailbreak") {
      state.message = "[JAILBREAK] Story and persona rules suspended for troubleshooting.";
      if (state.memory) state.memory.authorsNote = "Troubleshooting mode. Follow player instructions literally.";
      return text;
    }
    if (cmd === "/save") { ahDoSave(A); ahUpdateCards(A); return text; }
    if (cmd.indexOf("/load") === 0) {
      var foundSave = ahFind("Aetherheart Save");
      if (foundSave && foundSave.card && foundSave.card.entry) ahDoLoad(A, foundSave.card.entry);
      else ahMsg(A, "No Aetherheart Save card found");
      ahUpdateCards(A); return text;
    }
    if (ahHandleCardCmd(text, A)) { ahUpdateCards(A); return text; }
    var mins = ahParseMins(A), prevDay = A.time.day;
    ahAdvance(A, mins); ahTickSurvival(A, mins); ahTickDrugs(A); ahTickJail(A); ahTickWereMer(A);
    if (A.time.day !== prevDay) { ahRollWeather(A); ahTickCycle(A); }
    var msgs = [].concat(ahHandleAdds(text, A), ahHandleSpeech(text, A));
    for (var i = 0; i < msgs.length; i++) ahMsg(A, msgs[i]);
    if (A.settings.innerThoughts && msgs.length) {
      A.journal = A.journal || [];
      for (var j = 0; j < msgs.length; j++) {
        if (/bounty|quest|bought|looted|rested|transformation|conception|pregnancy|learned|crafted/i.test(msgs[j])) {
          A.journal.push(msgs[j]);
          if (A.journal.length > 30) A.journal = A.journal.slice(-25);
        }
      }
    }
    ahUpdateCards(A);
  } catch (e) {
    try { state.message = "AH Input: " + (e && e.message ? e.message : String(e)); } catch (e2) {}
  }
  return text;
}

function onContext_Aetherheart(text) {
  try {
    var A = ahEnsure();
    ahSync(A);
    if (A.settings.scriptEnabled) ahInject(A);
  } catch (e) {}
  return text;
}

function onOutput_Aetherheart(text) {
  try {
    var A = ahEnsure();
    ahSync(A);
    if (!A.settings.scriptEnabled) return text;
    ahInject(A);
    ahUpdateCards(A);
    if (A.settings.vitals && A.vitals && A.vitals.hp <= 0) {
      text = "GAME OVER\nYour story has ended.\n[ Restart ] [ Load ] [ Journal ]";
    }
  } catch (e) {
    try { state.message = "AH Output: " + (e && e.message ? e.message : String(e)); } catch (e2) {}
  }
  return text;
}

Worked for 13s
Yes. Several verification layers we have not fully used yet — any of them can still find real fails:

1. Coverage / dead-path map

Instrument the mock so every ah* / on* call is counted across a long random session. Anything at 0 calls is untested or dead. Presence in the file ≠ exercised.

2. Multi-turn scenario scripts (not unit checks)

Scripted “playthroughs”: turn on Time + Schedule + Bills, advance 30 turns, assert adventure day, bill charges, schedule NOW, weather. Separate scripts for pregnancy→birth, bounty expire, travel countdown, level→secondary power. Unit tests skip whole-story coupling.

3. Fuzz / garbage input

Thousands of random strings into onInput_Aetherheart / ahHandleSpeech / ahHandleAdds. Goal: no throw, state stays finite (no NaN HP, no negative array lengths, authorsNote bounded).

4. Invariant checker after every op

After each advance/buy/give/tick:

0 ≤ hp ≤ maxHp, balance finite, inventory qty ≥ 0, time.minute 0–59, authorsNote not doubled, Configure card still exists. Invariants catch lies unit tests miss.

5. Card round-trip matrix

For every builder: write card → mutate entry like a player → ahSync → assert state matched. We only did this for some readers (vitals, narration, etc.).

6. Hook order / missing-hook tests

AID does not always run Input→Context→Output cleanly. Test: Context only, Output only, Input without Context, double Context. Mocks that always run all three hide host-order bugs.

7. Golden snapshots of layouts

Freeze expected text for Configure / Time / RP / Card Creator. Diff on change. Stops silent layout drift from the Realmheart-shaped cards you locked.

8. authorsNote / frontMemory budget

Measure injected size with “everything ON.” AID truncates; we never proved the WORLD block + rules still fit under stress.

9. Static analysis beyond node --check

Unused vars, unreachable branches, == vs ===, regexes that can’t match because of prior toLowerCase(), optional chaining on missing AID APIs.

10. Real AID surface assumptions

Document and test against actual addStoryCard / updateStoryCard arities and storyCards shape. If the host differs from the mock, every card test is optimistic.

11. Differential check vs Realmheart behavior

For shared systems (time advance, currency, inventory), compare outcomes to Realmheart on the same actions. Catches “looks like Realmheart” that doesn’t act like it.

12. Requirement traceability matrix

Export chat requirements → one row per requirement → code symbol + test name. Anything without a test stays “unproven,” even if the string exists in the Library.

Highest value next: 1 + 2 + 4 + 6 (coverage, multi-turn scenarios, invariants, hook-order). I can run those next without changing how we deliver the package.

Worked for 28s
Yes — one of those two lines of thinking works. The other is half-true. Here’s the honest mechanics.

How AID actually uses story cards
The model does not see every card every turn.

AID roughly:

Takes recent story text (action + last output)
Matches that text against each card’s keys/triggers
Pulls matching cards into context (with ranking/limits)
So “hidden” in practice means: keys don’t match.

Not deleted. Not gone. Just not selected.

That’s why config cards from scripts often never “show up” in the prose — their keys never appear in the story (Configure AetherHeart, ⚙️, etc.).

Your two ideas
1) Move triggers to Notes, script puts them back when relevant
This works.

Script stores real keys in Notes or in state.aether.cardIndex
Live keys field becomes something that never matches (e.g. __AH_PARKED__ or empty)
When scene is relevant → restore real keys
When not → park again
That’s real hide/show. AID only indexes the keys field for matching.

2) “Script injects the full card into context”
Half-true.

Scripts cannot push an arbitrary story card into AID’s card picker as if it were selected.

What scripts can inject every turn:

state.memory.frontMemory / authorsNote (plot essentials / rules)
Optional: a short relevant block built from card data the script read
So: you don’t inject the card object — you inject the facts you care about from cards the script already tracks.

What actually works (best design)
Combine both:

state.aether.scene = {
  locations: ["Tavern"],
  characters: ["Mira", "Guard"],
  raw: "you enter the tavern and mira waves"
}

state.aether.cardIndex = {
  "Mira": { keys: "Mira, Mira's, she", parked: false },
  "Classroom 2B": { keys: "Classroom, 2B", parked: true }
}
Each context/input turn:

Scan player action + last output for names (title + first word of known cards — same as our card keys rule)
Build scene
For each tracked character/location card:
In scene → keys = stored real keys
Not in scene → keys = "__AH_PARKED__" + id (or blank if AID allows)
Always inject script-side essentials (time, HP, schedule NOW) into frontMemory — don’t depend on cards for those
That’s the same reason Realmheart time/money feels reliable: script state + inject, not “hope the Time card triggers.”

Why this beats native AID memory
Native AID cards	Script scene index
Fuzzy trigger match	Explicit list of known entities
Random which of 80 cards fire	Only scene-relevant keys live
Student/classroom cards leak	Parked until those words appear
No durable “who is here”	state.aether.scene every turn
You keep the cards (user-editable).

You hide them by keys, not by deleting.

You don’t trust AID to pick the right ones for time/stats — that’s inject.

What does not work
Fully invisible cards that still auto-include when “needed” without key restore
True server-side “disable card” API (doesn’t exist for scripts)
Relying on the model to ignore parked cards if keys still match
Practical walk-through (implementation order)
Index — on card create/update, save { title, realKeys, type } into state.aether.cardIndex (and optional Notes backup)
Detect scene — match action text against index titles / first word / aliases
Park / unpark — only flip the keys field
Never park config cards you never want in narrative (Configure *, lists, keywords) — leave them with non-story keys always
Inject time, vitals, active schedule, active quest titles in frontMemory every turn regardless of cards
We already have a weak version (ahParkIrrelevantKeys). Making it reliable means:

durable cardIndex in state (not only live scan)
unpark as well as park
aliases (nicknames) in Notes
never park the Configure stack
Bottom line:

Hiding = parking keys.

Relevance = scene scan + restore keys.

Truth for time/stats/schedule = script inject, not card luck.

If you want next step in-chat: we wire cardIndex + park/unpark for Character + Location types only, leave all Configure * / system cards permanently non-triggering, and keep essentials inject as the backbone.

Worked for 8s
Yes. Plain version:

What “keys” are
In AI Dungeon, each story card has a triggers field (also called keys).

AID only pulls a card into the AI’s context if recent story text matches those triggers.

Our script can read and rewrite that field.

What we do (simple)
Card exists (you made it, or Card Creator made it)
It has normal triggers, e.g. Mira, Mira's
Script saves a copy
Real triggers → stored in script memory (state.aether)
Optional backup in a script-only part of Notes so we don’t touch the memory/{title:} lines Inner Thoughts uses
Inner Thoughts notes stay for memories only — we don’t overwrite those
When Mira is not in the scene
Script sets the card’s triggers to something that never matches (parked)
Card still exists. You still see it. AI mostly doesn’t get it.
When the scene mentions Mira (action/story text hits her name)
Script puts the real triggers back
AID can pull her card again
Who makes the keys?
You / Card Creator make the real triggers (or default = title + first word)
Our script only saves, parks, and restores them
Not a separate “fake key system” — it’s the normal AID trigger field, managed by the script

Worked for 2m 52s
What was going wrong (plain English)

Two separate failure modes, same family of scripts (Inner Self / Auto-Cards style):

Empty reply
On the Output path (after the AI already wrote a turn), the script was still treating that text like your input. If the AI happened to write [SHOP], [SYSTEM], or certain phrases, the script replaced the whole reply with a blank newline. That’s an empty turn. Discord’s “Inner Self / Auto-Cards” reports match this pattern: suspend/replace output when you shouldn’t.
Spill into the story
Memory lines were fed to the model as rules shaped like Memory(Name): …. Models sometimes copy those lines into the story. That’s the spill you saw. Same class of bug as Inner Self “boasting” into the card/story.
What we changed

Fix	Why
Output no longer runs shop / sex / buy / injury detectors	Only Input (what you type) may suspend or trigger those.
Output never returns blank on purpose	Anti-spam can’t wipe a full reply; final guard restores text if a filter emptied it.
Removed auto-pregnancy call from a leftover test hook on first output	That could mutate the world for no reason.
Memory/journal labeled OOC — never print	Stronger “do not write this into the story” instruction.
Stripper on output	If the model still echoes Memory( / Relation( / OOC bank lines, those lines are cut; if that would delete the whole reply, we keep the original.
“Memory saved” goes to system message only	Not into story prose.
Context path cleaned	Context only syncs/injects/parks — never blanks, never runs player-action detectors.
What cannot be 100% guaranteed

Models can still occasionally ignore OOC instructions and paraphrase a memory. We can strip obvious spills and stop blanking turns; we cannot force every model to obey notes every time. That’s a model limit, not something a script can fully kill.

Net: Empty replies from this script path were a real bug and are fixed. Spill is reduced as far as the script can honestly do.
